title_en: DistFlow: A Fully Distributed RL Framework for Scalable and Efficient LLM Post-Training
title_zh: DistFlow：用于可扩展高效大语言模型后训练的全分布式强化学习框架

sentences.en: Effectively scaling Reinforcement Learning (RL) is crucial for enhancing the reasoning and alignment of Large Language Models.
sentences.zh: 有效扩展强化学习（RL）对于增强大语言模型的推理与对齐至关重要。

sentences.en: The massive data and complex execution flows inherent in these tasks require a distributed architecture capable of efficient scaling.
sentences.zh: 这些任务固有的海量数据与复杂执行流要求能够高效扩展的分布式架构。

sentences.en: However, to simplify programming and dependency management, mainstream frameworks often rely on a centralized architecture where a single node dispatches both control and data.
sentences.zh: 然而，为简化编程与依赖管理，主流框架常常依赖单个节点既调度控制又调度数据的集中式架构。

sentences.en: This inherent coupling creates significant communication bottlenecks, severely limiting system scalability and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 这种固有耦合制造显著的通信瓶颈，严重限制系统的可扩展性与效率。

sentences.en: We present DistFlow, a novel, fully distributed RL framework that adopts a multi-controller paradigm.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DistFlow，一个采用多控制器范式的新颖完全分布式 RL 框架。

sentences.en: By decoupling data transmission from control dispatch, DistFlow establishes a parallelism-aware, decentralized Data Coordinator that leverages local caching, load balancing, and asynchronous double buffer to minimize communication overhead and mitigate straggler effects.
sentences.zh: 通过将数据传输与控制调度解耦，DistFlow 建立一个并行感知的去中心化数据协调器，它利用本地缓存、负载均衡与异步双缓冲来最小化通信开销并缓解落伍者效应。

sentences.en: For control logic, it introduces a task scheduler built upon Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) that facilitates fine-grained, independent execution.
sentences.zh: 对于控制逻辑，它引入一个构建在有向无环图（DAG）之上的任务调度器，支持细粒度的独立执行。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that DistFlow achieves near-linear scalability up to 512 GPUs and delivers up to a 2.63x throughput improvement over state-of-the-art (SOTA) frameworks.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，DistFlow 实现高达 512 个 GPU 的近线性扩展，并将吞吐量相较最先进（SOTA）框架提升至多 2.63 倍。

title_en: Distillation Models are Good Samplers for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 蒸馏模型是扩散强化学习的良好采样器

sentences.en: We present DMSampler, a framework that accelerates online diffusion reinforcement learning by replacing expensive training-time policy rollouts with a co-evolving few-step distilled sampler.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DMSampler，一个通过用共同演化的几步蒸馏采样器取代昂贵的训练时策略 rollout 来加速在线扩散强化学习的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of repeatedly sampling the policy model for roughly 50 denoising steps, DMSampler generates reward-evaluation samples in only 4--8 steps while periodically re-distilling the sampler from the updated policy, yielding an order-of-magnitude reduction in rollout cost.
sentences.zh: DMSampler 不是反复采样策略模型约 50 个去噪步骤，而是仅用 4-8 步生成奖励评估样本，同时定期从更新的策略重新蒸馏采样器，使 rollout 成本降低一个数量级。

sentences.en: The framework alternates between two stages: an RL phase that optimizes the policy using hybrid samples from the old policy and distilled sampler, and a distillation phase that realigns the few-step sampler to the improved policy.
sentences.zh: 该框架在两个阶段之间交替：一个 RL 阶段使用来自旧策略与蒸馏采样器的混合样本优化策略，以及一个蒸馏阶段将几步采样器与改进后的策略重新对齐。

sentences.en: Intuitively, the distilled sampler acts as a fast proxy for the current policy during RL, and is refreshed whenever the policy improves so that sampling remains both efficient and aligned.
sentences.zh: 直观上，蒸馏采样器在 RL 期间充当当前策略的快速代理，并且每当策略改进时被刷新，使采样既高效又对齐。

sentences.en: Two designs make this loop stable and effective: hybrid distillation sampling preserves on-policy structure during rollout, and reward-aware distillation reuses high-reward trajectories to reduce forgetting during compression.
sentences.zh: 两种设计使这一循环稳定而有效：混合蒸馏采样在 rollout 期间保留在策略结构，而奖励感知蒸馏复用高奖励轨迹以减少压缩期间的遗忘。

sentences.en: Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that DMSampler improves OCR, GenEval, and VBench performance while substantially reducing GPU hours, and that the same idea can be combined with multiple diffusion RL optimizers.
sentences.zh: 在文生图与文生视频上的实验表明，DMSampler 改进 OCR、GenEval 与 VBench 性能，同时大幅减少 GPU 小时数，并且同一思想可以与多种扩散 RL 优化器结合。

sentences.en: Our code will be available at: https://github.com/HiDream-ai/DMSampler.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将在 https://github.com/HiDream-ai/DMSampler 提供。

title_en: Distilling Linearized Behavior into Non-linear Fine-Tuning for Effective Task Arithmetic
title_zh: 将线性化行为蒸馏到非线性微调中，实现有效任务算术

sentences.en: Task vector composition has emerged as a promising paradigm for editing pre-trained models, enabling model merging through addition and unlearning through subtraction.
sentences.zh: 任务向量组合已成为编辑预训练模型的有前景范式，通过加法实现模型合并，通过减法实现反学习。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning in the tangent space of a pre-trained model (linear fine-tuning) has proven effective, as it produces task vectors that are naturally disentangled and resistant to interference.
sentences.zh: 在预训练模型的切空间中微调（线性微调）已被证明有效，因为它产生自然解缠且抗干扰的任务向量。

sentences.en: However, linearized models suffer from limited expressivity during training and incur higher computational costs at inference time, which restrict their practical applicability.
sentences.zh: 然而，线性化模型在训练期间遭受有限的表达力，并在推理时招致更高的计算成本，这限制了它们的实际适用性。

sentences.en: In this work, we bridge the gap between linear and standard non-linear fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们弥合线性与标准非线性微调之间的差距。

sentences.en: We show that linearity with respect to weight perturbations, a property defined in parameter space, can be enforced through constraints in activation space during training.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对权重扰动的线性性（一个在参数空间中定义的性质）可以在训练期间通过激活空间中的约束来强制执行。

sentences.en: Concretely, we distill hidden representations from a curvature-regularized linearized teacher into a non-linear student trained via conventional fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将来自曲率正则化线性化教师的隐藏表示蒸馏进一个通过常规微调训练的非线性学生。

sentences.en: We find that the resulting model inherits key properties of linearized models for task arithmetic, enabling effective composition of task vectors and achieving strong performance across vision and language benchmarks without incurring any inference-time overhead.
sentences.zh: 我们发现所得的模型继承了用于任务算术的线性化模型的关键性质，实现任务向量的有效组合，并在视觉与语言基准上取得强性能，而无任何推理时开销。

title_en: Distilling Neuro-Symbolic Programs into 3D Multi-modal LLMs
title_zh: 将神经符号程序蒸馏到三维多模态大语言模型中

sentences.en: Current 3D spatial reasoning methods face a fundamental trade-off: neuro-symbolic 3D (NS3D) concept learners achieve interpretable reasoning through compositional programs but are constrained to closed-set concept vocabularies and simple programs; end-to-end 3D multi-modal LLMs (3D MLLMs) could handle complex natural language and open-vocabulary concepts but suffer from black-box reasoning without explicit spatial verification.
sentences.zh: 当前的 3D 空间推理方法面临一个基本权衡：神经符号 3D（NS3D）概念学习器通过组合程序实现可解释推理，但受限于闭集概念词汇表与简单程序；端到端 3D 多模态 LLM（3D MLLM）可以处理复杂自然语言与开放词汇概念，但遭受无显式空间验证的黑盒推理。

sentences.en: We introduce APEIRIA, a neuro-symbolic 3D MLLM to bridge two paradigms by distilling symbolic reasoning patterns into MLLMs with natural language chain-of-thought.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 APEIRIA，一个通过将符号推理模式以自然语言思维链蒸馏进 MLLM 来桥接两种范式神经符号 3D MLLM。

sentences.en: Our three-stage curriculum progressively builds reasoning capabilities: a) 3D perception alignment grounds object visual-geometric features to the LLM,  b) CoT-SFT teaches query decomposition and stepwise verification from symbolic program traces,  and c) CoT-RL extends reasoning patterns to open-set concepts and deeply nested instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们的三阶段课程逐步构建推理能力：a) 3D 感知对齐将物体视觉-几何特征立足到 LLM，b) CoT-SFT 从符号程序轨迹教授查询分解与逐步验证，以及 c) CoT-RL 将推理模式扩展到开放集概念与深度嵌套指令。

sentences.en: By transferring reasoning patterns rather than concept-specific knowledge, APEIRIA preserves key NS3D virtues: transparent reasoning and modular interchangeability of planning and perception components.
sentences.zh: 通过迁移推理模式而非概念特定知识，APEIRIA 保留了关键的 NS3D 优点：透明推理以及规划与感知组件的模块化可互换性。

sentences.en: Evaluations on grounding, question answering, and captioning show that APEIRIA surpasses prior NS3D methods and matches state-of-the-art 3D MLLMs on 3D spatial reasoning datasets, unifying symbolic methods' systematic reasoning with MLLMs' flexibility.
sentences.zh: 在立足、问答与描述上的评估表明，APEIRIA 超越先前的 NS3D 方法，并在 3D 空间推理数据集上匹敌最先进的 3D MLLM，将符号方法的系统推理与 MLLM 的灵活性统一起来。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/APEIRIA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/APEIRIA 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Distilling Task-Level Coordination Policies for Generalizable Multi-Agent Cooperation
title_zh: 蒸馏任务级协调策略，实现可泛化的多智能体协作

sentences.en: Large language models have shown strong reasoning abilities and are increasingly explored as high-level coordinators for multi-agent systems.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的推理能力，并且正日益被探索作为多智能体系统的高层协调器。

sentences.en: However, directly deploying LLMs for coordination remains challenging, as effective policies often fail to reliably emerge at the low-level control stage, and inference costs limit scalability.
sentences.zh: 然而，直接部署 LLM 进行协调仍充满挑战，因为有效策略常常无法在低层控制阶段可靠涌现，而且推理成本限制了可扩展性。

sentences.en: We propose SynCoord (Synthetic Coordination Distillation), a self-supervised pipeline that distills task-level decision-making for cooperation from high-capacity reasoning models into lightweight agent policies.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SynCoord（综合协调蒸馏），一个自监督流水线，它将来自高容量推理模型的任务级协作决策蒸馏进轻量级智能体策略。

sentences.en: Our approach does not rely on explicit supervision or handcrafted coordination rules.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法不依赖显式监督或手工设计的协调规则。

sentences.en: Instead, we define a set of task-level tool interfaces that constrain LLM interaction and enable the collection of interaction trajectories, which are then used to train compact coordinated policies.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们定义一组任务级工具接口来约束 LLM 交互并支持收集交互轨迹，然后用这些轨迹训练紧凑的协调策略。

sentences.en: This distillation process transfers coordination behaviors that are difficult to elicit through prompting alone, while substantially reducing inference overhead at execution time.
sentences.zh: 这一蒸馏过程迁移了仅靠提示难以引发的协调行为，同时在执行时大幅减少推理开销。

sentences.en: We evaluate our method on cooperative multi-agent benchmarks including Overcooked-AI and Level-Based Foraging (LBF), under varying team sizes and environment scales.
sentences.zh: 我们在包括 Overcooked-AI 与基于等级觅食（LBF）的协作多智能体基准上评估我们的方法，涉及不同的团队规模与环境规模。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that the distilled policies achieve success rates and execution efficiency comparable to reinforcement learning–based methods, while exhibiting fewer erroneous or redundant actions.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，蒸馏策略实现了与基于强化学习的方法相当的成功率与执行效率，同时表现出更少的错误或冗余动作。

sentences.en: Moreover, the learned task-level coordination policy generalizes effectively to unseen team compositions and larger layouts without retraining.
sentences.zh: 此外，学到的任务级协调策略无需重训即可有效泛化到未见的团队构成与更大布局。

title_en: Distinguishable Deletion: Unifying Knowledge Erasure and Refusal for Large Language Model Unlearning
title_zh: 可区分删除：统一知识擦除与拒绝，实现大语言模型遗忘学习

sentences.en: Mitigating sensitive and harmful outputs is fundamental to ensuring safe deployment of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 减轻敏感与有害输出对于确保 LLM 的安全部署至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically follow two paradigms: Knowledge Deletion (KD), which erases undesirable information during training, and Distinguishable Refusal (DR), which steers models away from using sensitive knowledge during inference.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常遵循两种范式：知识删除（KD），在训练期间擦除不良信息；以及可区分拒绝（DR），在推理期间引导模型远离使用敏感知识。

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress, KD-based unlearning struggles with biased deletion due to suppressing specific token sequences as a substitute for complete knowledge removal, whereas DR-based unlearning risks the re-emergence of harmful knowledge because the underlying knowledge remains intact.
sentences.zh: 尽管进展迅速，基于 KD 的反学习因用抑制特定词元序列作为完整知识移除的替代而挣扎于有偏删除，而基于 DR 的反学习则因底层知识保持完整而具有有害知识重现的风险。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose Distinguishable Deletion ($\mathrm{D^2}$), a paradigm that restricts the response distribution in the latent representation rather than specific tokens to erase undesirable knowledge, while distinguishing it from retained knowledge, enabling a refusal mechanism to handle unlearned inputs safely and coherently.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出可区分删除（$\mathrm{D^2}$），一种在潜在表示而非特定词元上限制响应分布以擦除不良知识、同时将其与保留知识区分开来的范式，从而支持拒绝机制安全且连贯地处理未学习输入。

sentences.en: To implement $\mathrm{D^2}$, we introduce an energy index that quantifies the presence of knowledge and the separation between unlearned and retained content.
sentences.zh: 为实现 $\mathrm{D^2}$，我们引入一个能量指数，量化知识的存在性以及未学习与保留内容之间的分离。

sentences.en: Mathematical and empirical analyses show that energy is both accurate and efficient, enabling Energy-based Unlearning Alignment (EUA) to enforce energy-boundary unlearning during training and apply an energy-based refusal mechanism at inference.
sentences.zh: 数学与经验分析表明，能量既准确又高效，使基于能量的反学习对齐（EUA）能够在训练期间强制执行能量边界反学习，并在推理时应用基于能量的拒绝机制。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that EUA significantly outperforms previous methods, indicating the superiority of $\mathrm{D^2}$.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，EUA 显著超越先前方法，指示了 $\mathrm{D^2}$ 的优越性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Puning97/EUA-for-LLM-Unlearning.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Puning97/EUA-for-LLM-Unlearning 获取。

title_en: Distinguishing Imitation Error from Intrinsic Motion Learning Difficulty
title_zh: 区分模仿误差与运动学习的内在难度

sentences.en: Physics-based motion imitation is central to humanoid control, yet current evaluation metrics(e.g., MPJPE) only quantify imitation outcomes, not their underlying causes.
sentences.zh: 基于物理的运动模仿是类人控制的核心，然而当前的评估指标（例如 MPJPE）仅量化模仿结果，而非其根本原因。

sentences.en: This conflation obscures a critical diagnostic question: when imitation error occurs, does it stem from policy limitations or the intrinsic learning difficulty of the target motion?
sentences.zh: 这种混淆遮蔽了一个关键诊断问题：当模仿误差发生时，它源于策略局限还是目标运动的内在学习难度？

sentences.en: To resolve this ambiguity, we propose the Torque Variation Score (TVS), a physics-grounded metric that quantifies the inherent learning difficulty of a motion independently of any policy's performance.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一模糊性，我们提出转矩变化分数（TVS），一个物理立足的指标，它独立于任何策略的性能量化运动的固有学习难度。

sentences.en: TVS measures the magnitude of torque variation required to correct small pose perturbations, directly capturing how dynamical properties shape the reinforcement learning landscape.
sentences.zh: TVS 度量纠正小姿态扰动所需的转矩变化幅度，直接捕获动态属性如何塑造强化学习景观。

sentences.en: We establish that high-TV motions induce flat reward landscapes and vanishing policy gradients, explaining persistent imitation failures.
sentences.zh: 我们确立，高 TVS 运动诱导平坦的奖励景观与消失的策略梯度，解释了持续的模仿失败。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art methods (UHC, PHC+) confirm TVS strongly correlates with imitation error and enables principled error attribution: high error on low-TV motions indicates policy deficiency, while high error on high-TV motions reflects fundamental learning constraints.
sentences.zh: 使用最先进方法（UHC、PHC+）的大量实验证实，TVS 与模仿误差强相关，并支持有原则的误差归因：高 TVS 运动上的高误差指示策略缺陷，而高 TVS 运动上的高误差则反映基本学习约束。

sentences.en: Beyond error diagnosis, TVS facilitates three practical applications: Maximum Imitable Difficulty (MID) for policy capability assessment, Difficulty-Stratified Joint Error (DSJE) for granular performance profiling, and Flawed Motion Detection for identifying segments with abnormally high learning difficulty to support mocap data curation and quality control.
sentences.zh: 在误差诊断之外，TVS 促进三项实际应用：用于策略能力评估的最大可模仿难度（MID）、用于粒度性能剖析的难度分层关节误差（DSJE）以及用于识别学习难度异常高的片段以支持动作捕捉数据策展与质量控制的缺陷运动检测。

sentences.en: TVS provides a rigorous lens to distinguish policy-induced errors from motion-inherent challenges and enhances motion dataset reliability.
sentences.zh: TVS 为区分策略诱导的误差与运动固有的挑战提供了严谨的视角，并增强运动数据集的可靠性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Sequential, Network, and Time Series Modeling
title_en: DistMatch: Adaptive Binning  via Distribution Matching for Robust Sequential Conformal Prediction
title_zh: DistMatch：通过分布匹配自适应分箱，实现鲁棒序贯共形预测

sentences.en: Sequential conformal prediction (CP) provides valid uncertainty quantification under the assumption of residual exchangeability.
sentences.zh: 顺序共形预测（CP）在残差可交换性假设下提供有效的不确定性量化。

sentences.en: However, this assumption is often violated in real-world time series due to temporal dependencies and distributional shifts.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于时间依赖与分布偏移，这一假设在现实时间序列中常常被违反。

sentences.en: While recent methods attempt to approximate exchangeability through reweighting, identifying optimal weights remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期方法尝试通过重新加权近似可交换性，但识别最优权重仍是一个开放挑战。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose [DistMatch](https://github.com/enver1323/dist_match_conformal), a binning-based method that recursively partitions residuals within a binary tree using the Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出 DistMatch，一种基于分箱的方法，它使用 Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）统计量在二叉树内递归划分残差。

sentences.en: We theoretically show that this partitioning induces approximately exchangeable leaves, thereby avoiding the need for reweighting.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上表明，这种划分诱导近似可交换的叶子，从而避免重新加权的需要。

sentences.en: By applying quantile regression with online updates within each leaf, DistMatch enables locally adaptive inference and improves robustness to distributional shifts.
sentences.zh: 通过在每个叶子内应用带在线更新的分位数回归，DistMatch 实现局部自适应推断，并增强对分布偏移的稳健性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DistMatch outperforms existing sequential CP methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，DistMatch 超越现有的顺序 CP 方法。

title_en: Distortion of AI Alignment Revisited: RLHF is a Decent Utilitarian Aligner
title_zh: 重新审视 AI 对齐的扭曲：RLHF 是表现不错的功利主义对齐方法

sentences.en: While Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard paradigm for aligning large language models with human preferences, its effectiveness in pluralistic settings has been called into question.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是对齐大语言模型与人类偏好的标准范式，但其在多元情境中的有效性已受到质疑。

sentences.en: Notably, recent work by Gölz et al. (2025) demonstrated that the *distortion* — defined as the multiplicative gap between the average user utility of the RLHF policy and the optimal average utility — can scale exponentially with the Bradley-Terry temperature parameter $\beta$ when users have heterogeneous preferences.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，Gölz 等人 (2025) 的近期工作证明，*失真*——定义为 RLHF 策略的平均用户效用与最优平均效用之间的乘性差距——在用户具有异质偏好时可以随 Bradley-Terry 温度参数 $\beta$ 指数扩展。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a fine-grained analysis of the distortion of RLHF with reward clipping and demonstrate that such exponential degradation is not a fundamental property of the algorithm but rather a consequence of distribution mismatch between the distribution generating preference data ($\mu$) and the KL reference policy ($\pi_{\mathrm{ref}})$.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们对带奖励裁剪的 RLHF 失真进行细粒度分析，并表明此类指数退化并非算法的根本性质，而是生成偏好数据的分布（$\mu$）与 KL 参考策略（$\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}$）之间分布不匹配的结果。

sentences.en: To this end, we establish tight upper and lower bounds on the distortion of RLHF across multiple regimes of the KL regularization strength.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们在 KL 正则化强度的多个区间内确立 RLHF 失真的紧上下界。

sentences.en: We show that in a representative regime, under the Bradley–Terry model, the distortion is $\tilde{\Theta}(\beta B + \beta)$, where $B$ is an upper bound on the log density ratio between $\mu$ and $\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}$.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在一个代表性区间内，在 Bradley-Terry 模型下，失真为 $\tilde{\Theta}(\beta B + \beta)$，其中 B 是 $\mu$ 与 $\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}$ 之间对数密度比的上界。

sentences.en: In particular, when there is no distribution mismatch (i.e., $\mu = \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}$), RLHF achieves the optimal distortion of $O(\beta)$ up to a constant.
sentences.zh: 特别是，当不存在分布不匹配时（即 $\mu = \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}$），RLHF 实现 $O(\beta)$ 的最优失真（至多常数）。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that, to reasonably maximize average utility with RLHF, it is preferable to use on-policy sampled preference data or to fine-tune before RLHF on data from a source close to $\mu$.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，要用 RLHF 合理地最大化平均效用，更可取的是使用在策略采样的偏好数据，或在 RLHF 之前对来自接近 $\mu$ 源的数据进行微调。

title_en: Distributed Direct Preference Optimization
title_zh: 分布式直接偏好优化

sentences.en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (RL) is a key paradigm for aligning policies with human judgments, yet its theoretical behavior in distributed settings where preference data are fragmented across heterogeneous users remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 基于偏好的强化学习（RL）是对齐策略与人类判断的关键范式，然而其在偏好数据碎片化分布于异构用户的分布式情境中的理论行为仍未被充分理解。

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) avoids explicit reward modeling but lacks convergence guarantees under federated and decentralized training, where communication constraints and non-IID preferences fundamentally alter optimization dynamics.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）避免显式奖励建模，但在联邦与去中心化训练下缺乏收敛保证，其中通信约束与非 IID 偏好从根本上改变优化动态。

sentences.en: We provide the first convergence and time-complexity analysis of DPO in distributed environments.
sentences.zh: 我们提供 DPO 在分布式环境中首个收敛与时间复杂度分析。

sentences.en: Modeling personalized offline RL with user-specific preference distributions, we characterize the induced global optimization landscape.
sentences.zh: 通过建模带用户特定偏好分布的个性化离线 RL，我们刻画由此诱导的全局优化景观。

sentences.en: For federated DPO, we derive convergence rates that quantify the impact of client drift, communication frequency, and preference heterogeneity; for decentralized DPO, we establish convergence over general communication graphs and show how spectral connectivity governs optimization speed and consensus.
sentences.zh: 对于联邦 DPO，我们推导出量化客户端漂移、通信频率与偏好异质性影响的收敛速率；对于去中心化 DPO，我们建立一般通信图上的收敛，并展示谱连通性如何支配优化速度与共识。

sentences.en: Empirically, we corroborate our theoretical insights on standard alignment benchmarks, demonstrating that our proposed methods not only enjoy strong theoretical guarantees but also deliver robust and scalable performance in practice.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们在标准对齐基准上佐证我们的理论洞见，表明我们所提出的方法不仅享有强理论保证，还在实践中提供稳健且可扩展的性能。

sentences.en: The code base is available here.
sentences.zh: 代码库可在此获取。

title_en: Distributed Stochastic $K$-Level Optimization Over Networks
title_zh: 网络上的分布式随机 $K$ 层优化

sentences.en: In recent years, decentralized optimization has gained significant attention for solving machine learning problems where data are distributed across multiple devices.
sentences.zh: 近年来，去中心化优化在解决数据分布于多个设备上的机器学习问题方面获得显著关注。

sentences.en: However, existing decentralized optimization algorithms are primarily designed for single-level and two-level optimization tasks, limiting their application to more complex problems such as decentralized stochastic $K$-level optimization, where $K>2$.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的去中心化优化算法主要为单层与双层优化任务设计，限制了它们在 K>2 的去中心化随机 K 层优化等更复杂问题上的应用。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a novel decentralized stochastic $K$-level variance-reduced gradient descent algorithm to address the significant computation and communication overhead caused by the multi-level structure in decentralized stochastic $K$-level optimization problems.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种新颖的去中心化随机 K 层方差缩减梯度下降算法，以应对去中心化随机 K 层优化问题中多层结构造成的显著计算与通信开销。

sentences.en: Moreover, we propose a novel theoretical analysis to tackle the recursive dependence issue caused by the multi-level structure when establishing the convergence rate of our algorithm.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在建立算法收敛速率时，提出一种新的理论分析以解决多层结构造成的递归依赖问题。

sentences.en: Finally, the experimental results confirm the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.
sentences.zh: 最后，实验结果证实了我们所提出算法的有效性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Distribution Alignment for One-Shot Federated Learning via Optimal Transport
title_zh: 通过最优输运实现单轮联邦学习的分布对齐

sentences.en: One-Shot Federated Learning (OSFL) addresses extreme communication regimes in which clients interact with the server only once, amplifying the impact of heterogeneous client data distributions.
sentences.zh: 一次性联邦学习（OSFL）应对客户端仅与服务器交互一次的极端通信场景，放大了异构客户端数据分布的影响。

sentences.en: In particular, the interaction of domain shift and label shift across clients induces misaligned feature representations that cannot be corrected through iterative optimization.
sentences.zh: 特别是，客户端之间域偏移与标签偏移的交互诱导了无法通过迭代优化修正的错位特征表示。

sentences.en: Existing OSFL methods rely on distillation, server-side generation or ensemble-based aggregation, but assume aligned representations or address domain and label shift separately.
sentences.zh: 现有的 OSFL 方法依赖蒸馏、服务器端生成或基于集成的聚合，但假设已对齐的表示，或分别处理域与标签偏移。

sentences.en: We introduce SLOT-Align (Single-round, Learning-free Optimal Transport Alignment), a geometry-aware feature harmonization framework for OSFL.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 SLOT-Align（单轮、免学习的注引输运对齐），一个用于 OSFL 的几何感知特征调和框架。

sentences.en: SLOT-Align uses a shared frozen encoder to extract compact feature statistics, constructs a global reference via Bures–Wasserstein barycenters, and aligns local representations using closed-form geodesic optimal transport maps.
sentences.zh: SLOT-Align 使用一个共享冻结编码器提取紧凑特征统计量，通过 Bures-Wasserstein 重心构建全局参考，并使用闭式测地最优输运映射对齐局部表示。

sentences.en: The method is computationally efficient and can be combined with existing OSFL pipelines relying on frozen encoders without modifying their training procedures.
sentences.zh: 该方法计算高效，并且可以与依赖冻结编码器的现有 OSFL 流水线结合，而无需修改其训练过程。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, pretrained backbones, and OSFL methods show that SLOT-Align consistently improves accuracy and robustness under joint domain and label shift.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准、预训练主干与 OSFL 方法的大量实验表明，SLOT-Align 在联合域与标签偏移下一致地改善准确率与稳健性。

title_en: Distribution Matching Variational AutoEncoder
title_zh: 分布匹配变分自编码器

sentences.en: Most visual generative models compress images into a latent space before applying diffusion or autoregressive modelling.
sentences.zh: 大多数视觉生成模型在应用扩散或自回归建模之前将图像压缩到潜在空间。

sentences.en: Yet, existing approaches such as VAEs and foundation model aligned encoders implicitly constrain the latent space without explicitly shaping its distribution, making it unclear which types of distributions are optimal for modeling.
sentences.zh: 然而，诸如 VAE 与基础模型对齐编码器之类的现有方法隐式约束潜在空间，而没有显式塑造其分布，使得何种类型的分布对于建模最优变得不清楚。

sentences.en: We introduce **Distribution-Matching VAE** (**DMVAE**), which explicitly aligns the encoder’s latent distribution with an arbitrary reference distribution via a distribution matching constraint.
sentences.zh: 我们引入**分布匹配 VAE**（**DMVAE**），它通过分布匹配约束将编码器的潜在分布与任意参考分布显式对齐。

sentences.en: This generalizes beyond the Gaussian prior of conventional VAEs, enabling alignment with distributions derived from self-supervised features, diffusion noise, or other prior distributions.
sentences.zh: 这推广了常规 VAE 的高斯先验，支持与源自自监督特征、扩散噪声或其他先验分布的分布对齐。

sentences.en: With DMVAE, we can systematically investigate which latent distributions are more conducive to modeling, and we find that SSL-derived distributions provide an excellent balance between reconstruction fidelity and modeling efficiency, reaching a gFID of 3.2 on ImageNet with only 64 training epochs.
sentences.zh: 借助 DMVAE，我们可以系统性地研究哪些潜在分布更有利于建模，并发现 SSL 派生的分布在重建保真度与建模效率之间提供极佳的平衡，在仅 64 个训练周期内在 ImageNet 上达到 3.2 的 gFID。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that choosing a suitable latent distribution structure (achieved via distribution-level alignment), rather than relying on fixed priors, is key to bridging the gap between easy-to-model latents and high-fidelity image synthesis.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，选择合适的潜在分布结构（通过分布级对齐实现），而非依赖固定先验，是弥合易于建模的潜在变量与高保真图像合成之间差距的关键。

authors.name: Jianning Pei
authors.institution: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Distribution Transformers: Fast Approximate Bayesian Inference With On-The-Fly Prior Adaptation
title_zh: 分布 Transformer：通过即时先验适配实现快速近似贝叶斯推断

sentences.en: While Bayesian inference provides a principled framework for reasoning under uncertainty, its widespread adoption is limited by the intractability of exact posterior computation, necessitating the use of approximate inference.
sentences.zh: 虽然贝叶斯推断为不确定性下的推理提供了有原则的框架，但其广泛采用受限于精确后验计算的不可处理性，必须使用近似推断。

sentences.en: However, existing methods are often computationally expensive, or demand costly retraining when priors change, limiting their utility, particularly  in sequential inference problems such as real-time sensor fusion.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法常常计算昂贵，或当先验改变时需要昂贵的重训，限制了它们的效用，尤其是在实时传感器融合等顺序推断问题中。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce the Distribution Transformer---a novel architecture that can learn arbitrary distribution-to-distribution mappings.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入分布 Transformer——一种可以学习任意分布到分布映射的新颖架构。

sentences.en: Our method can be trained to map a prior to the corresponding posterior, conditioned on some dataset---thus performing approximate Bayesian inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法可以被训练为在给定某个数据集的条件下将先验映射到相应后验——从而执行近似贝叶斯推断。

sentences.en: Our novel architecture represents a prior distribution as a (universally-approximating) Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and transforms it into a GMM representation of the posterior.
sentences.zh: 我们新颖的架构将先验分布表示为（普适逼近的）高斯混合模型（GMM），并将其变换为后验的 GMM 表示。

sentences.en: The components of the GMM attend to each other via self-attention, and to the datapoints via cross-attention.
sentences.zh: GMM 的分量通过自注意力相互关注，并通过交叉注意力关注数据点。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that Distribution Transformers both maintain flexibility to vary the prior, and significantly reduces computation times—from minutes to milliseconds—while achieving expected log-likelihood performance on par with or superior to existing approximate inference methods across tasks such as sequential inference, quantum system parameter inference, and Gaussian Process predictive posterior inference with hyperpriors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明分布 Transformer 既保持改变先验的灵活性，又显著缩短计算时间——从分钟到毫秒——同时在顺序推断、量子系统参数推断与带超先验的高斯过程预测后验推断等任务上实现与现有近似推断方法相当或更优的期望对数似然性能。

title_en: Distribution-Calibrated Inference Time Compute for Thinking LLM-as-a-Judge
title_zh: 用于思考型大语言模型评判器的分布校准推理时计算

sentences.en: Thinking Large Language Models (LLMs) used as judges  for pairwise preferences remain noisy at the single-sample level, and common aggregation rules (majority vote, soft self-consistency, or instruction-based self-aggregation) are inconsistent when ties are allowed.
sentences.zh: 用作成对偏好法官的思考型大语言模型（LLM）在单样本层面仍然含噪，并且常见的聚合规则（多数投票、软自一致性或基于指令的自聚合）在允许平局时是不一致的。

sentences.en: We study inference-time compute (ITC) for evaluators that generate $n$ independent thinking--rating samples per item, and propose a principled, distribution-calibrated aggregation scheme.
sentences.zh: 我们研究生成每项物品 n 个独立思考-评分样本的评估器的推理时计算（ITC），并提议一个有原则的、分布校准的聚合方案。

sentences.en: Our method models three-way preferences with a Bradley–Terry-Davidson formulation on rating counts, leveraging both polarity (margin among non-ties) and decisiveness (non-tie rate) to distinguish narrow margins from strong consensus.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法用 Bradley-Terry-Davidson 表述对评分计数上的三向偏好建模，同时利用极性（非平局之间的间隔）与决定性（非平局率）来区分窄幅度与强共识。

sentences.en: Across various evaluation benchmarks, our approach consistently reduces MAE and increases pairwise accuracy versus standard baselines, and when evaluated against human-consensus meta-labels, matches or exceeds individual human raters.
sentences.zh: 在各种评估基准上，我们的方法一致降低 MAE 并相较标准基线提高成对准确率，并且当对照人类共识元标签评估时，匹配或超越个体人类评分者。

sentences.en: These results show that carefully allocating ITC and aggregating with distribution-aware methods turns noisy individual model judgments into reliable ratings for evaluation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，仔细分配 ITC 并用分布感知方法聚合，可以将含噪的个体模型判断转化为用于评估的可靠评分。

title_en: Distributional Active Inference
title_zh: 分布主动推断

sentences.en: Optimal control of complex environments with robotic systems faces two complementary and intertwined challenges: efficient organization of sensory state information and far-sighted action planning.
sentences.zh: 用机器人系统对复杂环境进行最优控制面临两个互补且交织的挑战：感觉状态信息的高效组织与远视动作规划。

sentences.en: Because the reinforcement learning framework addresses only the latter, it tends to deliver sample-inefficient solutions.
sentences.zh: 由于强化学习框架仅解决后者，它往往得到样本低效的解决方案。

sentences.en: Active inference is the state-of-the-art process theory that explains how biological brains handle this dual problem.
sentences.zh: 主动推断是解释生物大脑如何处理这一双重问题的最先进过程理论。

sentences.en: However, its applications to artificial intelligence have thus far been limited to extensions of existing model-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 然而，它在人工智能中的应用迄今仅限于现有基于模型方法的扩展。

sentences.en: We present a formal abstraction of reinforcement learning algorithms that spans model-based, distributional, and model-free approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们提出强化学习算法的形式化抽象，涵盖基于模型、分布式与免模型方法。

sentences.en: This abstraction seamlessly integrates active inference into the distributional reinforcement learning framework, making its performance advantages accessible without transition dynamics modeling.
sentences.zh: 这种抽象将主动推断无缝整合进分布式强化学习框架，使其性能优势在不进行转移动力学建模的情况下可用。

authors.name: Abdullah Akgül
authors.institution: Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Southern Denmark

title_en: Distributional Alignment Games for Answer-Level Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 用于答案级微调的分布对齐博弈

sentences.en: We focus on the problem of \emph{Answer-Level Fine-Tuning} (ALFT), where the   goal is to optimize a language model based on the correctness or properties of   its final answers, rather than the specific reasoning traces used to produce   them.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于*答案级微调*（ALFT）的问题，其目标是基于语言模型最终答案的正确性或性质来优化它，而非用于产生答案的特定推理轨迹。

sentences.en: Directly optimizing answer-level objectives is computationally   intractable due to the need to marginalize over the vast space of latent   reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 由于需要对巨大潜在推理路径空间求边际，直接优化答案级目标在计算上是不可处理的。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose a general game-theoretical   framework that lifts the problem to a *Distributional Alignment Game*.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一点，我们提出一个一般博弈论框架，将问题提升到*分布对齐博弈*。

sentences.en: We   formulate ALFT as a two-player game between a Policy (the generator) and a   Target (an auxiliary distribution).
sentences.zh: 我们将 ALFT 表述为策略（生成器）与目标（辅助分布）之间的双人博弈。

sentences.en: We prove that the Nash Equilibrium of this   game corresponds exactly to the solution of the original answer-level   optimization problem.
sentences.zh: 我们证明该博弈的纳什均衡恰好对应于原答案级优化问题的解。

sentences.en: This variational perspective transforms the intractable   marginalization problem into a tractable projection problem.
sentences.zh: 这一变分视角将不可处理的边际化问题转化为可处理的投影问题。

sentences.en: We demonstrate   that this framework unifies recent approaches to diversity and   self-improvement (coherence) and provide efficient algorithms compatible with   Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), such as   *Coherence-GRPO*, yielding significant complexity gains in   mathematical reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明该框架统一了近期用于多样性与自我改进（连贯性）的方法，并提供与组相对策略优化（GRPO）兼容的高效算法，例如*Coherence-GRPO*，在数学推理任务中带来显著的复杂度增益。

authors.name: Mehryar Mohri
authors.institution: Google Research and Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences

title_en: Distributional Inverse Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 分布逆强化学习

sentences.en: We propose a distributional framework for offline Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) that jointly models uncertainty over reward functions and full distributions of returns.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个用于离线逆强化学习（IRL）的分布式框架，它联合建模奖励函数上的不确定性收益分布的完整分布。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional IRL approaches that recover a deterministic reward estimate or match only expected returns, our method captures richer structure in expert behavior, particularly in learning the reward distribution, by minimizing first-order stochastic dominance (FSD) violations and thus integrating distortion risk measures (DRMs) into policy learning, enabling the recovery of both reward distributions and distribution-aware policies.
sentences.zh: 与恢复确定性奖励估计或仅匹配期望收益的常规 IRL 方法不同，我们的方法通过最小化一阶随机优势（FSD）违反来捕获专家行为中更丰富的结构，尤其是在学习奖励分布方面，从而将失真风险度量（DRM）整合进策略学习，支持恢复奖励分布与分布感知策略两者。

sentences.en: This formulation is well-suited for behavior analysis and risk-aware imitation learning.
sentences.zh: 这一表述非常适合行为分析与风险感知模仿学习。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis show that the algorithm converge with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ iteration complexity.
sentences.zh: 理论分析表明该算法以 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 的迭代复杂度收敛。

sentences.en: Empirical results on synthetic benchmarks, real-world neurobehavioral data, and MuJoCo control tasks demonstrate that our method recovers expressive reward representations and achieves state-of-the-art imitation performance.
sentences.zh: 在合成基准、真实世界神经行为数据与 MuJoCo 控制任务上的实证结果表明，我们的方法恢复富有表现力的奖励表示，并实现最先进的模仿性能。

title_en: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
title_zh: 基于价值码本与分布的大语言模型文化价值对齐开放式评估

sentences.en: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement.
sentences.zh: 随着 LLM 在全世界被部署，对齐其文化价值取向对于安全与用户参与至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context (C$^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基准面临构建-组合-上下文（C$^3$）挑战：依赖探测价值知识而非真实取向的判别式、多项选择格式，忽视亚文化异质性，并与现实世界的开放式生成不匹配。

sentences.en: We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DOVE，一个直接比较人类书写文本分布与 LLM 生成输出的分布评估框架。

sentences.en: DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise.
sentences.zh: DOVE 利用率失真变分优化目标，从 10K 文档构建紧凑的价值码本，将文本映射到结构化的价值空间以滤除语义噪声。

sentences.en: Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and subgroup diversity.
sentences.zh: 对齐使用不平衡最优输运度量，捕获文化内分布结构与子群体多样性。

sentences.en: Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.
sentences.zh: 跨 12 个 LLM 的实验表明，DOVE 实现优越的预测效度，达到与下游任务 31.56% 的相关性，同时每个文化仅需 500 个样本即可保持高可靠性。

authors.name: Roy Lee
authors.institution: Singapore University of Technology and Design

title_en: Distributionally Robust Causal Abstractions
title_zh: 分布鲁棒因果抽象

sentences.en: Causal Abstraction (CA) theory provides a principled framework for relating causal models that describe the same system at different levels of granularity while ensuring interventional consistency between them.
sentences.zh: 因果抽象（CA）理论为关联以不同粒度级别描述同一系统的因果模型提供了有原则框架，同时确保它们之间的干预一致性。

sentences.en: Recent methods for learning CAs, however, assume fixed and well-specified exogenous distributions, leaving them vulnerable to environmental shifts and model misspecification.
sentences.zh: 然而，学习 CA 的近期方法假设固定且良好指定的外生分布，使它们容易受到环境偏移与模型误设的影响。

sentences.en: In this work, we address these limitations by introducing the first class of distributionally robust CAs and their associated learning algorithms.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入首个分布稳健 CA 类别及其相关的学习算法来应对这些局限。

sentences.en: The latter cast robust causal abstraction learning as a constrained min-max optimization problem with Wasserstein ambiguity sets.
sentences.zh: 后者将稳健因果抽象学习投射为带 Wasserstein 模糊集的约束 min-max 优化问题。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees for both empirical and Gaussian environments, enabling principled selection of ambiguity-set radii and establish quantitative guarantees on worst-case abstraction error.
sentences.zh: 我们为经验与高斯环境提供理论保证，支持有原则的模糊集半径选择，并建立最坏情况抽象误差的定量保证。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we present empirical evidence across different problems and CA learning methods, demonstrating our framework’s robustness not only to environmental shifts but also to structural and intervention mapping misspecification.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们呈现跨不同问题与 CA 学习方法的实证证据，展示我们的框架不仅对环境偏移稳健，而且对结构与干预映射误设也稳健。

authors.name: Theodoros Damoulas
authors.institution: University of Warwick & The Alan Turing Institute

title_en: Distributionally Robust Markov Games with Average Reward
title_zh: 具有平均奖励的分布鲁棒马尔可夫博弈

sentences.en: We propose and study distributionally robust Markov games (DR‑MGs) with the average‑reward criterion as a crucial framework for multi-agent decision-making under model mismatches and over extended horizons.
sentences.zh: 我们提出并研究带平均奖励准则的分布稳健马尔可夫博弈（DR-MG），将其作为模型不匹配下与长期视界上多智能体决策的关键框架。

sentences.en: Under a standard irreducible assumption, we first derive a correspondence between the optimal policies and the solutions of the robust Bellman equation, based on which we further show the existence of a stationary Nash Equilibrium (NE) of the game.
sentences.zh: 在标准不可约假设下，我们首先推导最优策略与稳健 Bellman 方程解之间的对应关系，在此基础上进一步表明博弈存在平稳纳什均衡（NE）。

sentences.en: We further study DR-MGs under a more general weakly communicating setting.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步研究更一般的弱通信情境下的 DR-MG。

sentences.en: We construct a set-valued map based on the constant-gain optimal robust Bellman operator and show that its value is a subset of the best-response policies.
sentences.zh: 我们基于常数增益最优稳健 Bellman 算子构造一个集值映射，并表明其值是最佳响应策略的子集。

sentences.en: We further prove that this map admits a fixed point, which implies the existence of NE.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明该映射具有不动点，这意味着 NE 的存在性。

sentences.en: We then design two algorithms, Robust Nash‑Iteration and robust TD Descent, with provably convergent guarantees.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们设计两种算法，稳健 Nash 迭代与稳健 TD 下降，并带可证明的收敛保证。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that the NE under average‑reward can be approximated by the ones for the discounted DR-MGs as the discount factor approaches one.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明随着折扣因子趋近 1，平均奖励下的 NE 可以被折扣 DR-MG 的 NE 逼近。

sentences.en: Our studies provide a comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic foundation for decision-making in complex, uncertain, and long-running multi-player environments.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究为复杂、不确定且长期运行的多人环境中的决策提供全面的理论与算法基础。

title_en: Distributionally Robust Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
title_zh: 基于人类反馈的分布鲁棒强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has evolved to be one of the main methods for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已发展成为微调大语言模型（LLM）的主要方法之一。

sentences.en: However, existing RLHF methods are non-robust, and their performance deteriorates if the downstream task differs significantly from the preference dataset used in fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 RLHF 方法不稳健，如果下游任务与微调中使用的偏好数据集显著不同，其性能会恶化。

sentences.en: In order to mitigate this problem, we introduce a distributionally robust RLHF for fine-tuning LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们引入用于微调 LLM 的分布稳健 RLHF。

sentences.en: In particular, our goal is to ensure that a fine-tuned model retains its performance even when the distribution of prompts significantly differs from the distribution encountered during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我们的目标是确保即使提示分布与微调期间遇到的分布显著不同，微调后的模型也能保持其性能。

sentences.en: We formulate distributionally robust optimization (DRO) version of two popular fine-tuning methods -- (1) reward-based RLHF and (2) reward-free DPO (direct preference optimization).
sentences.zh: 我们为两种流行的微调方法制定分布稳健优化（DRO）版本——（1）基于奖励的 RLHF 与（2）免奖励的 DPO（直接偏好优化）。

sentences.en: We propose a minibatch gradient descent based algorithms for both of them, and theoretically prove convergence guarantees for the algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们为两者提出基于小批量梯度下降的算法，并在理论上证明算法的收敛保证。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we evaluate our algorithms on an out-of-distribution (OOD) task by first training the model on the Unified-Feedback dataset and evaluating its performance on two different datasets.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们通过先在 Unified-Feedback 数据集上训练模型并评估其在两个不同数据集上的性能，来评估我们的算法在一个分布外（OOD）任务上的表现。

sentences.en: The experimental results show that our robust training improves the accuracy of the learned reward models on average, and markedly on some tasks, such as reasoning.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的稳健训练平均改善了学习到的奖励模型的准确率，并且在某些任务（如推理）上显著改善。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that the robust versions of policy optimization methods, similarly improve performance on OOD tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明策略优化方法的稳健版本同样改善 OOD 任务上的性能。

authors.name: Goran Radanovic
authors.institution: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems

title_en: Distributionally Robust Set Representation Learning Under Inference-Time Element Corruption
title_zh: 推理时元素损坏下的分布鲁棒集合表征学习

sentences.en: Standard Set Representation Learning methods typically excel on curated data but often overlook the challenge of Inference-time Element Corruption.
sentences.zh: 标准集合表示学习方法通常在精心策划的数据上表现出色，但常常忽视推理时元素损坏的挑战。

sentences.en: This refers to scenarios where deployed models encounter element-level degradations, such as outliers or missing components, that may distort set representation and degrade performance.
sentences.zh: 这指部署模型遭遇元素级退化（如离群值或缺失组件）的情形，可能扭曲集合表示并降低性能。

sentences.en: We propose SW-DRSO, a distributionally robust optimization framework tailored for sets.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SW-DRSO，一个专为集含量身定制的分布稳健优化框架。

sentences.en: Rather than minimizing loss solely on observed training data, SW-DRSO optimizes a tractable surrogate of the worst-case expected loss over a family of plausible inference-time variations.
sentences.zh: SW-DRSO 不仅仅在观测训练数据上最小化损失，而是在一个合理的推理时变化族上优化最坏情况期望损失的可行替代。

sentences.en: We introduce a barycentric adversary that approximates the intractable search over corrupted sets by a differentiable training-time optimization over simplex weights.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个重心对抗者，它通过在单纯形权重上可微的训练时优化逼近不可处理的损坏集搜索。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across four tasks demonstrate that SW-DRSO effectively enhances robustness against corruption while maintaining high overall performance.
sentences.zh: 跨四个任务的大量实验表明，SW-DRSO 在保持高整体性能的同时有效增强对抗损坏的稳健性。

authors.name: Bowei He
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: DITING: A Weak Degradation Listener for Battery Lifetime Early Prediction
title_zh: DITING：用于电池寿命早期预测的微弱退化监听器

sentences.en: Battery lifetime early prediction is crucial for safety assessment and decision planning, yet early-stage degradation signals are extremely weak and difficult to distinguish from stochastic noise.
sentences.zh: 电池寿命早期预测对于安全评估与决策规划至关重要，然而早期退化信号极其微弱且难以与随机噪声区分。

sentences.en: Existing methods primarily rely on denoising or signal decomposition, which may lose critical degradation cues.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要依赖去噪或信号分解，这可能会丢失关键的退化线索。

sentences.en: In nature, most organisms exhibit the binaural effect, exploiting discrepancies between left and right auditory inputs to enhance perceptual reliability.
sentences.zh: 在自然界中，大多数生物表现出双耳效应，利用左右听觉输入之间的差异来增强感知可靠性。

sentences.en: Inspired by this, we propose DITING, a weak degradation listener for battery lifetime early prediction.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出 DITING，一个用于电池寿命早期预测的弱退化监听器。

sentences.en: We first employ optimal-transport-based selective matching to extract a robust health template from initial cycles, and further design a tri-coupled degradation manifestation mechanism to distinguish degradation signals from noise.
sentences.zh: 我们首先采用基于最优输运的选择性匹配，从初始周期提取稳健的健康模板，并进一步设计一个三重耦合的退化表现机制来区分退化信号与噪声。

sentences.en: By exploiting the randomness of noise, matched responses under symmetric coupling suppress stochastic fluctuations, while degradation-driven cumulative deviations propagate through the coupling process to form stable bilateral discrepancies, thereby amplifying weak early-stage cues for lifetime prediction.
sentences.zh: 通过利用噪声的随机性，对称耦合下的匹配响应抑制随机波动，而退化驱动的累积偏差在耦合过程中传播，形成稳定的双侧差异，从而放大弱早期线索用于寿命预测。

sentences.en: Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that DITING achieves state-of-the-art performance and provides more reliable early support for full-lifecycle battery management.
sentences.zh: 在各种数据集上的实验表明，DITING 取得最先进性能，并为全寿命电池管理提供更可靠的早期支持。

title_en: DITRON: Distributed Multi-level Tiling Compiler for Parallel Tensor Programs
title_zh: DITRON：并行张量程序的分布式多级分块编译器

sentences.en: The scaling of large language models (LLMs) is currently bottlenecked by the rigidity of distributed programming.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的扩展目前受限于分布式编程的僵化性。

sentences.en: While high-performance libraries like CuBLAS and NCCL provide optimized primitives, they lack the flexibility required for rapidly evolving model architectures.
sentences.zh: 虽然诸如 CuBLAS 与 NCCL 的高性能库提供优化的原语，但它们缺乏快速演化模型架构所需的灵活性。

sentences.en: Conversely, existing tensor compilers fail to address the complex memory hierarchy of distributed clusters effectively.
sentences.zh: 相反，现有的张量编译器未能有效应对分布式集群的复杂内存层级。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose DITRON, a scalable tile-level compiler that democratizes high-performance distributed kernel development.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 DITRON，一个可扩展的平铺级编译器，它使高性能分布式内核开发大众化。

sentences.en: DITRON introduces a novel hierarchical programming abstraction spanning Core, Device, and Task levels to map tensor programs efficiently onto heterogeneous distributed hardware.
sentences.zh: DITRON 引入一个涵盖 Core、Device 与 Task 级别的新颖层级编程抽象，将张量程序高效映射到异构分布式硬件。

sentences.en: This abstraction allows DITRON to support diverse parallelism strategies while abstracting away the complexity of inter-node and intra-node communication.
sentences.zh: 这种抽象使 DITRON 能够支持多样的并行性策略，同时抽象掉节点间与节点内通信的复杂性。

sentences.en: Evaluated across large-scale clusters, DITRON achieves performance parity with or exceeding expert-tuned CUDA libraries, delivering speedups of 6%–30% on isolated kernels and 5%–30% on end-to-end inference in vLLM.
sentences.zh: 在大规模集群上的评估表明，DITRON 达到与专家调优 CUDA 库相当或更优的性能，在隔离内核上实现 6%-30% 的加速，在 vLLM 端到端推断上实现 5%-30% 的加速。

sentences.en: Furthermore, DITRON demonstrates strong portability, achieving significant speedups on both NVIDIA and AMD platforms.
sentences.zh: 此外，DITRON 展现出强可移植性，在 NVIDIA 与 AMD 平台上都实现显著的加速。

authors.name: Haojie Duanmu
authors.institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University & ByteDance Seed

authors.name: Jin Fang
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: DIVA: Harnessing the Representation Divergence in Unified Multimodal Models for Mutual Reinforcement
title_zh: DIVA：利用统一多模态模型中的表征差异实现相互增强

sentences.en: Unified Multimodal models (UMMs) built on a single architecture have shown impressive performance in both understanding and generation.
sentences.zh: 构建在单一架构上的统一多模态模型（UMM）在理解与生成两方面都展现出令人印象深刻的性能。

sentences.en: We identify a fundamental challenge lies in inductive biases induced by distinct supervision signals: generation branch prefers high-fidelity, fine-grained representations capable of reconstruction, while the understanding favours semantically discriminative embeddings that remain invariant to task-irrelevant factors.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一个根本性挑战在于不同监督信号诱导的归纳偏差：生成分支偏好能够重建的高保真、细粒度表示，而理解分支偏好对任务无关因素保持不变的语义判别嵌入。

sentences.en: Consequently, optimizing these complementary but non-equivalent objectives within a monolithic backbone leads to mutual impairment instead of enhancement.
sentences.zh: 因此，在单体主干中优化这些互补但不等价的目标会导致相互损害而非增强。

sentences.en: In this paper, we first analyze the root cause of this interference in unified backbones and reveal a complementary structure in their internal representations.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们首先分析统一主干中这种干扰的根本原因，并揭示其内部表示中的互补结构。

sentences.en: Motivated by the observation, we propose DIVA, a self-improved post-training framework that transforms the representation divergence into interior synergy.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们提出 DIVA，一个将表示分歧转化为内部协同的自我改进后训练框架。

sentences.en: By explicitly factorizing the visual representation into shared and unique components based on two complementary information flow, DIVA enables both the understanding and generation branches to achieve beneficial transferring while preserving the integrity of unique information from cross-flow interference via mutual information estimation.
sentences.zh: 通过基于两种互补信息流将视觉表示显式分解为共享与独特组件，DIVA 使理解与生成分支两者都能实现有益迁移，同时通过互信息估计从跨流干扰中保持独特信息的完整性。

sentences.en: Despite its generality, our method consistently achieves improvements across visual understanding (+7.82%) and generation (+8.46%).
sentences.zh: 尽管具有通用性，我们的方法在视觉理解（+7.82%）与生成（+8.46%）上都实现一致的改进。

sentences.en: The official code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DIVA-D225.
sentences.zh: 官方代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DIVA-D225 获取。

authors.name: Shangfei Wang
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Dive into the Scene: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Vision-Language Decision Making via Focus Plan Generation
title_zh: 深入场景：通过焦点计划生成突破视觉语言决策中的感知瓶颈

sentences.en: In embodied vision-language decision making tasks such as robotic manipulation and navigation, Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models (VLMs \& VLAs) are powerful tools with different benefits: VLMs are better at long-term planning, while VLAs are better at reactive control.
sentences.zh: 在机器人操作与导航等具身视觉-语言决策任务中，视觉-语言与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLM 与 VLA）是优势互补的强大工具：VLM 更擅长长期规划，而 VLA 更擅长反应式控制。

sentences.en: However, their performance is limited by the same perceptual bottleneck: visual hallucinations arise due to the models’ inability to distinguish task-relevant objects from distractors.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的性能都受到同一感知瓶颈的限制：由于模型无法区分任务相关对象与干扰物，视觉幻觉出现。

sentences.en: In principle, accurate identification and focus on critical objects while filtering out irrelevant ones is the key to break this limitation.
sentences.zh: 原则上，准确识别并聚焦关键对象、同时滤除无关对象是打破这一局限的关键。

sentences.en: A straightforward solution is one-step focus: directly attending to essential objects.
sentences.zh: 一个直接的解决方案是单步聚焦：直接关注必要对象。

sentences.en: However, this approach proves ineffective because effective focus inherently requires deep scene understanding.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法被证明是无效的，因为有效的聚焦天生需要深度场景理解。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose ${\it SceneDiver}$, a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method for VLMs leveraging their long-term planning abilities, that first constructs a holistic scene graph to establish initial comprehension, then progressively decomposes the task into simpler sub-problems through an iterative cycle of recognition, understanding, and analysis.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出 \textit{SceneDiver}，一种利用 VLM 长期规划能力的由粗到细焦点计划生成方法，它首先构建一个整体场景图建立初步理解，然后通过识别、理解与分析的迭代循环逐步将任务分解为更简单的子问题。

sentences.en: To enable reactive control, we also design a lightweight adapter for distilling the deliberate focus ability into VLAs.
sentences.zh: 为支持反应式控制，我们还设计一个轻量级适配器，将深思熟虑的聚焦能力蒸馏进 VLA。

sentences.en: Evaluations on standard embodied AI benchmarks confirm that our method substantially reduces visual hallucinations for both VLMs and VLAs, while preserving computational efficiency in tasks requiring fast execution.
sentences.zh: 在标准具身 AI 基准上的评估证实，我们的方法大幅减少 VLM 与 VLA 两者的视觉幻觉，同时保持需要快速执行任务中的计算效率。

sentences.en: Our code and data are released at: https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据发布于 https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver。

title_en: DIVE: Scaling Diversity in Agentic Task Synthesis for Generalizable Tool Use
title_zh: DIVE：扩展智能体任务合成的多样性，实现可泛化工具使用

sentences.en: Recent work increasingly synthesizes agentic tasks for post-training tool-using LLMs, yet robust generalization under shifts in tasks and toolsets remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 近期研究越来越多地为后训练工具使用 LLM 综合智能体任务，然而在任务与工具集偏移下的稳健泛化仍是一个开放挑战。

sentences.en: We trace this brittleness to insufficient diversity in synthesized training tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种脆弱性追溯到合成训练任务中多样性的不足。

sentences.en: Scaling diversity is difficult because training requires tasks to remain executable and verifiable, while generalization demands diverse tool types, toolset combinations, and heterogeneous tool-use patterns.
sentences.zh: 扩展多样性是困难的，因为训练要求任务保持可执行与可验证，而泛化要求多样的工具类型、工具集组合与异构工具使用模式。

sentences.en: We propose DIVE, an evidence-driven recipe that inverts synthesis order, executing diverse real-world tools first and reverse-deriving tasks strictly entailed by the resulting traces, providing grounding by construction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DIVE，一个证据驱动的配方，它反转综合顺序，先执行多样真实世界的工具，再逆向推导由所得轨迹严格蕴涵的任务，通过构建提供立足。

sentences.en: DIVE scales structural diversity along two controllable axes, tool-pool coverage and per-task toolset variety, synthesizing 48k trajectories over 374 tools across five domains that cover 46,398 unique toolsets and 39,810 unique tool-call graphs.
sentences.zh: DIVE 沿两个可控轴扩展结构多样性——工具池覆盖度与每任务工具集多样性——涵盖五个领域中 374 个工具上的 48k 条轨迹，覆盖 46,398 个唯一工具集与 39,810 个唯一工具调用图。

sentences.en: Training Qwen3-8B on DIVE data (48k SFT + 3.2k RL) improves by +22 average points across 9 OOD benchmarks and outperforms the strongest 8B baseline by +68%.
sentences.zh: 在 DIVE 数据上训练 Qwen3-8B（48k SFT + 3.2k RL）在 9 个 OOD 基准上平均提高 +22 分，并以 +68% 超越最强的 8B 基线。

sentences.en: Under a fixed budget, controlled scaling shows diversity scaling consistently outperforms quantity scaling, even with 4× less data.
sentences.zh: 在固定预算下，受控扩展表明多样性扩展一致优于数量扩展，即使数据减少 4\times。

title_en: DIVER: Diving Deeper into Distilled Data via Expressive Semantic Recovery
title_zh: DIVER：通过高表达能力语义恢复深入挖掘蒸馏数据

sentences.en: Dataset distillation aims to synthesize a compact proxy dataset that is unreadable or non-raw from the original dataset for privacy protection and highly efficient learning.
sentences.zh: 数据集蒸馏旨在为隐私保护与高效学习综合一个紧凑的代理数据集，使其相对于原始数据不可读或非原始。

sentences.en: However, previous approaches typically adopt a single-stage distillation paradigm, which suffers from learning specific patterns that overfit on a prior architecture, consequently suppressing the expression of semantics and leading to performance degradation across heterogeneous architectures.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前方法通常采用单阶段蒸馏范式，它遭受学习特定模式、过拟合先前架构的问题，从而抑制语义表达并导致跨异构架构的性能退化。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a novel dual-stage distillation framework called ${\textbf{DIVER}}$, which leverages the pre-trained diffusion model to dive deeper into $\textbf{DI}$stilled data $\textbf{V}$ia $\textbf{E}$xpressive semantic $\textbf{R}$ecovery, an entire process of semantic inheritance, guidance, and fusion.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出一个称为 \textbf{DIVER} 的新颖双阶段蒸馏框架，它利用预训练扩散模型通过表达性语义恢复更深入潜入 \textbf{DI}stilled data \textbf{V}ia \textbf{E}xpressive semantic \textbf{R}ecovery，这是语义继承、引导与融合的完整过程。

sentences.en: Semantic inheritance distills high-level semantics of abstract distilled images into the latent space to filter out architecture-specific ``noise" and retain the intrinsic semantics.
sentences.zh: 语义继承将抽象蒸馏图像的高层语义蒸馏进潜在空间，以滤除架构特定的“噪声”并保留内在语义。

sentences.en: Furthermore, semantic guidance improves the preservation of the original semantics by directing the reverse procedure.
sentences.zh: 此外，语义引导通过引导逆向过程改善原始语义的保留。

sentences.en: Finally, semantic fusion is designed to provide semantic guidance only during the concrete phase of the reverse process, preventing semantic ambiguity and artifacts while maintaining the guidance information.
sentences.zh: 最后，语义融合被设计为仅在逆向过程的定型阶段提供语义引导，在保持引导信息的同时防止语义模糊与伪影。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method in improving classical distillation techniques and significantly improving cross-architecture generalization, requiring processing time comparable to raw DiT on ImageNet (256$\times$256) with only 4 GB of GPU memory usage.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了我们的方法在改进经典蒸馏技术与显著改善跨架构泛化方面的有效性与效率，在 ImageNet (256\times 256) 上仅需 4 GB GPU 内存用量，处理时间与原始 DiT 相当。

title_en: Divergence Decoding: Inference-Time Unlearning via Auxiliary Models
title_zh: 散度解码：通过辅助模型实现推理时遗忘学习

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently memorize sensitive training data thereby creating significant privacy and copyright risks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）经常记忆敏感训练数据，从而制造显著的隐私与版权风险。

sentences.en: Addressing these risks, i.e., removing such knowledge from an existing model checkpoint, has proven challenging as many unlearning methods lead to catastrophic utility loss or are ineffective for complex queries.
sentences.zh: 应对这些风险（即从现有模型检查点移除此类知识）已被证明充满挑战，因为许多反学习方法导致灾难性效用损失或对复杂查询无效。

sentences.en: We introduce **Divergence Decoding (DD)**, a mechanism that uses small auxiliary models to steer the logits of the LLM away from specific data during inference.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 **散度解码（DD）**，一种使用小型辅助模型在推理期间将 LLM 的 logits 引离特定数据的机制。

sentences.en: Training these models is straight forward, i.e., we use standard pre-training and fine-tuning setups.
sentences.zh: 训练这些模型是直截了当的，即我们使用标准的预训练与微调设置。

sentences.en: We find the method decisively outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines on unlearning benchmarks across a variety of model and training dataset scales consistent with DD being an effective and inexpensive solution to unlearning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现该方法在多种模型与训练数据集规模的反学习基准上果断超越最先进（SOTA）基线，这与 DD 是有效且廉价的反学习解决方案一致。

sentences.en: We then demonstrate that this steered distribution can be trivially distilled back into the base model.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们证明这种被引导的分布可以被平凡地蒸馏回基础模型。

sentences.en: Since the method is generally applicable to any probabilistic model, we explore its efficacy outside of text generation and find evidence of generalization to the domain of images.
sentences.zh: 由于该方法普遍适用于任何概率模型，我们探索其在文本生成之外的有效性，并找到推广到图像领域的证据。

title_en: Diversity Matters: Revisiting Test-Time Compute in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 多样性至关重要：重新审视视觉语言模型的测试时计算

sentences.en: Test-time compute (TTC) strategies have emerged as a lightweight approach to boost reasoning in large language models, but their applicability to vision-language models (VLMs) remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 测试时计算（TTC）策略已成为提升大语言模型推理的轻量级方法，但它们在视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的适用性仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We present a systematic study of TTC for visual reasoning across seven open-source VLMs and six benchmarks, revisiting two paradigms: (i) feature-based scoring of chain-of-thought (CoT) traces and (ii) confidence-based aggregation via majority voting (MV).
sentences.zh: 我们对跨七个开源 VLM 与六个基准的视觉推理 TTC 进行系统性研究，重新考察两种范式：（i）基于特征的思维链（CoT）轨迹评分与（ii）基于置信度的多数投票（MV）聚合。

sentences.en: In the single-model setting, feature cues (e.g., length, pivot words) fail to improve accuracy, while MV yields only modest, CoT-dependent gains.
sentences.zh: 在单一模型情境中，特征线索（例如长度、枢轴词）无法改善准确率，而 MV 仅产生适度的、依赖 CoT 的增益。

sentences.en: To explain this limitation, we theoretically show that the voting method’s effectiveness depends on prediction diversity: when outputs are highly correlated, the benefit of voting vanishes.
sentences.zh: 为解释这一局限，我们从理论上表明投票方法的有效性取决于预测多样性：当输出高度相关时，投票的好处消失。

sentences.en: In contrast, multi-model ensembles introduce stronger diversity through architectural differences, training data, and scale, making them both more realistic and more promising for TTC.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，多模型集成通过架构差异、训练数据与规模引入更强的多样性，使其对 TTC 既更现实又更有前景。

sentences.en: However, MV treats all models equally, leaving it vulnerable to correlated errors from weaker models.
sentences.zh: 然而，MV 平等对待所有模型，使其容易受到来自较弱模型的相关错误的影响。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Entropy-based TTC, which selects the most confident prediction based on predictive entropy.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出基于熵的 TTC，它基于预测熵选择最自信的预测。

sentences.en: Our method reduces to MV in the single-model case but, in ensembles, leverages confidence disparities to prioritize stronger models.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在单一模型情形下退化为 MV，但在集成中，利用置信度差异来优先更强的模型。

sentences.en: We prove that our method theoretically outperforms MV under mild dependence assumptions, and empirically show that it consistently surpasses both MV and the best individual model across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明我们的方法在温和依赖假设下理论上优于 MV，并在经验上表明，它在多样视觉推理基准上一致超越 MV 与最佳个体模型。

sentences.en: This demonstrates that smaller models can enhance, rather than hinder, larger ones when combined appropriately, unlocking ensemble gains not achievable with existing TTC strategies.
sentences.zh: 这证明较小模型在恰当组合时可以增强而非阻碍较大模型，解锁现有 TTC 策略无法实现的集成增益。

title_en: Diversity Over Frequency: Rethinking Tool Use in Visual Chain-of-Thought Agents
title_zh: 多样性优于频率：重新思考视觉思维链智能体的工具使用

sentences.en: Visual agents employ external visual tools within visual chains of thought to incorporate fine-grained evidence.
sentences.zh: 视觉智能体在视觉思维链中采用外部视觉工具以纳入细粒度证据。

sentences.en: While prior work has mainly studied these tools in visual search tasks, their role in more complex visual reasoning remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作主要在视觉搜索任务中研究这些工具，但它们在更复杂视觉推理中的作用仍未充分探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we move beyond simple visual search tasks to investigate more challenging tasks, including 3D spatial reasoning and medical visual question answering, where agents must integrate tool-acquired local evidence with the global context.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们超越简单的视觉搜索任务，研究更具挑战性的任务，包括 3D 空间推理与医学视觉问答，其中智能体必须将工具获取的局部证据与全局上下文整合。

sentences.en: We identify a \emph{tool-use collapse phenomenon}: models progressively stop using tools while still achieving higher task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出*工具使用坍缩现象*：模型逐步停止使用工具，同时仍实现更高的任务准确率。

sentences.en: Moreover, we observe a clear asymmetry: (i) completely eliminating tool use degrades performance, whereas (ii) incentivizing tool use yields only marginal gains despite substantially increasing usage.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们观察到明确的不对称性：（i）完全消除工具使用会降低性能，而（ii）激励工具使用尽管大幅增加使用量却仅产生边际增益。

sentences.en: We find that vanilla training and tool-use encouragement both reduce rollout diversity, explaining why higher tool use does not yield stronger reasoning performance.
sentences.zh: 我们发现普通训练与工具使用鼓励都降低 rollout 多样性，这解释了为何更高的工具使用不会产生更强的推理性能。

sentences.en: Motivated by these findings, we add an entropy regularization term to encourage diverse rollout exploration, achieving the best performance despite gradually declining tool usage.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现启发，我们添加一个熵正则化项以鼓励多样的 rollout 探索，尽管工具使用量逐渐下降，仍实现最佳性能。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings suggest a training-time view of tools as scaffolding, where broader exploration over language generation and visual tool invocation improves reasoning despite tool-use collapse.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现表明一种将工具视为脚手架的训练时视角，其中对语言生成与视觉工具调用的更广泛探索改善推理，尽管存在工具使用坍缩。

sentences.en: Project page: https://scaffolded-exploration.github.io
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://scaffolded-exploration.github.io

title_en: Diversity-Aware Recursive Feature Multiple Kernel Learning
title_zh: 多样性感知的递归特征多核学习

sentences.en: \textit{\underline{M}ultiple \underline{k}ernel \underline{l}earning}~(MKL) combines several base kernels in the spirit of ensemble learning, yet existing methods rarely model kernel diversity---a known cornerstone of ensembles---and most traditional kernels weight all features uniformly, ignoring feature-level discriminability.
sentences.zh: 多核学习（MKL）以集成学习的理念结合若干基础核，然而现有方法很少对核多样性建模——而多样性是集成的一个已知基石——并且大多数传统核统一加权所有特征，忽视特征级判别力。

sentences.en: We address both gaps with DARFMMKL: a data-driven kernel family (Recursive Feature Machine kernels) that learns feature importance directly from data, paired with a kernel selection method that jointly optimizes diversity and quality.
sentences.zh: 我们用 DARFMMKL 应对这两个空白：一个从数据直接学习特征重要性的数据驱动核族（递归特征机制核），配以一个联合优化多样性与质量的核选择方法。

sentences.en: The resulting NP-hard binary quadratic program is reformulated via Glover linearization and continuous relaxation into a linear program, and accelerated by Nystr\"om sketching, yielding a selector whose cost is decoupled from the sample size.
sentences.zh: 所得的 NP 难二元二次规划通过 Glover 线性化与连续松弛被重新表述为线性规划，并由 Nyström 草图化加速，产生一个成本与样本量脱钩的选择器。

sentences.en: We provide a covering-number generalization bound that explicitly relates kernel diversity to estimation error.
sentences.zh: 我们提供一个覆盖数泛化界，将核多样性与估计误差显式关联。

sentences.en: Experiments on 12 benchmark datasets show that DARFMMKL consistently outperforms 9 state-of-the-art MKL methods.
sentences.zh: 在 12 个基准数据集上的实验表明，DARFMMKL 一致超越 9 种最先进 MKL 方法。

title_en: Diversity-aware Weight Perturbation Promotes Robust Adaptation
title_zh: 多样性感知权重扰动促进鲁棒适配

sentences.en: Compute-In-Memory (CIM) accelerators are promising for energy-efficient edge inference, yet they faces fundamental challenges when deploying Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), as hardware-induced weight perturbations from intrinsic noise and device drift degrade accuracy and impede reliable inference.
sentences.zh: 存内计算（CIM）加速器对节能边缘推断有前景，然而它们在部署深度神经网络（DNN）时面临根本性挑战，因为由内在噪声与设备漂移引起的硬件诱导权重扰动会降低准确率并阻碍可靠推断。

sentences.en: To tackle this challenge, we propose Diversity-aware Weight  Perturbation (DWP), an immune-system-inspired training method that  emulates affinity-based selection by exploiting sample-level  prediction disagreement under diverse noise realizations to guide  adaptive sample weighting, building robustness to weight perturbation.
sentences.zh: 为攻克这一挑战，我们提出多样性感知权重扰动（DWP），一种受免疫系统启发的训练方法，它通过利用多样化噪声实现下样本级预测分歧来模拟亲合力选择，以引导自适应样本加权，构建对权重扰动的稳健性。

sentences.en: Experiments show that DWP-trained models consistently yield superior robustness, achieving over 15\% accuracy improvements compared to standard-trained models under severe weight perturbations (mismatch level up to 70\%) and maintaining  inference accuracy at 90\% over a simulated one-year CIM operation  with only 2\%–4\% variation in accuracy.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，DWP 训练的模型一致地产生卓越稳健性，在严重权重扰动（失配水平高达 70\%）下相较标准训练模型实现超过 15\% 的准确率改进，并在模拟一年的 CIM 运行中以仅 2\%-4\% 的准确率变化维持推理准确率在 90\%。

sentences.en: Moreover, under matched model and inference configurations, deployment on low-precision CIM hardware reduces inference energy by 38\% compared to a GPU baseline.
sentences.zh: 此外，在匹配的模型与推断配置下，在低精度 CIM 硬件上部署相较 GPU 基线降低 38\% 的推断能量。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that DWP enables robust and energy-efficient neural network deployment on resource-constrained edge devices with inherent hardware uncertainties.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，DWP 能够在固有硬件不确定性的资源受限边缘设备上实现稳健且节能的神经网络部署。

title_en: Diversity-Driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Nested Pareto Set Learning
title_zh: 通过嵌套 Pareto 集学习进行多样性驱动离线多目标优化

sentences.en: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has emerged as a powerful approach to solving complex optimization problems involving multiple objectives.
sentences.zh: 多目标优化（MOO）已成为解决涉及多目标的复杂优化问题的强大方法。

sentences.en: In many practical scenarios, function evaluations are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, necessitating optimization solely based on a fixed offline dataset.
sentences.zh: 在许多实际场景中，函数评估不可用或代价高昂，必须仅基于固定离线数据集进行优化。

sentences.en: In this setting, known as offline MOO, the goal is to find out the Pareto set without access to the true objective functions.
sentences.zh: 在这一被称为离线 MOO 的情境中，目标是在无法访问真实目标函数的情况下找到 Pareto 集。

sentences.en: This setting suffers from the out-of-distribution (OOD) issue, where the surrogate model is not accurate for unseen designs.
sentences.zh: 这一情境遭受分布外（OOD）问题，其中代理模型对未见设计不准确。

sentences.en: Due to the OOD issue, surrogate errors may cause the optimizer to select solutions that do not lie on the true Pareto front and are biased toward its extremes.
sentences.zh: 由于 OOD 问题，代理误差可能使优化器选择不位于真实 Pareto 前沿上且偏向其极端的解。

sentences.en: To address this, this paper proposes Diversity-driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization (DOMOO), which aims to find out a diverse and high-quality set of solutions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，本文提出多样性驱动离线多目标优化（DOMOO），它旨在发现多样且高质量的解法集。

sentences.en: First, DOMOO incorporates an accumulative risk control module that estimates the potential risk of candidate solutions and alleviates the OOD issue between the training data and the generated solutions.
sentences.zh: 首先，DOMOO 纳入一个累积风险控制模块，它估计候选解的潜在风险并缓解训练数据与生成解之间的 OOD 问题。

sentences.en: In addition, a nested Pareto set learning (PSL) strategy is proposed to jointly learn preference and PSL parameters, then optimize them, enabling adaptation to diverse Pareto front geometries.
sentences.zh: 此外，提出一种嵌套 Pareto 集学习（PSL）策略，联合学习偏好与 PSL 参数，然后优化它们，支持适应多样的 Pareto 前沿几何。

sentences.en: To further enhance solution quality, we design a diversity-driven selection strategy that extracts a representative and well-distributed set of final solutions.
sentences.zh: 为进一步提升解质量，我们设计一种多样性驱动选择策略，提取一个有代表性且分布良好的最终解集。

sentences.en: To achieve this diversity-driven selection strategy, we propose $\text{IGD}_\text{offline}$, a tailored indicator for the offline setting that considers both diversity and convergence, and avoids the bias of hypervolume indicator.
sentences.zh: 为实现这种多样性驱动选择策略，我们提出 $\text{IGD}_\text{offline}$，一个针对离线情境的量身定制指标，它同时考虑多样性与收敛性，并避免超体积指标的偏差。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that DOMOO achieves the best average rank across tasks in both convergence and diversity among the compared methods.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，DOMOO 在收敛性与多样性方面在所比较方法中取得最佳平均排名。

title_en: Diversity-Preserved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Visual Synthesis
title_zh: 保持多样性的分布匹配蒸馏，实现快速视觉合成

sentences.en: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) facilitates few-step image generation by aligning a distilled student with a reference multi-step teacher.
sentences.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）通过将对齐蒸馏学生与参考多步教师，促进几步图像生成。

sentences.en: In practice, however, optimizing DMD can reduce sample diversity in few-step synthesis, and existing remedies typically rely on perceptual or adversarial regularization, leading to stability and scalability challenges during training.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，优化 DMD 会减少几步合成的样本多样性，而现有的补救措施通常依赖感知或对抗正则化，导致训练期间的稳定性与可扩展性挑战。

sentences.en: Here, we describe diversity-preserved DMD (DP-DMD), a role-separated distillation method inspired by the complementary roles of early and late denoising steps.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们描述保持多样性的 DMD（DP-DMD），一种受早期与晚期去噪步骤互补作用启发的角色分离蒸馏方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, the first distillation step is trained with a teacher-derived target-prediction objective  (e.g., v-prediction) to preserve sample diversity, while the remaining steps are optimized with the standard DMD loss to refine perceptual quality.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，第一个蒸馏步骤用教师派生的目标预测目标（例如 v 预测）训练以保持样本多样性，而其余步骤用标准 DMD 损失优化以精炼感知质量。

sentences.en: DP-DMD, with no perceptual or adversarial regularization, no additional modules, and no teacher-generated reference samples, preserves sample diversity while maintaining competitive visual quality under few-step sampling, providing a simple and stable alternative to other DMD variants.
sentences.zh: DP-DMD 无感知或对抗正则化、无额外模块、无教师生成的参考样本，在几步采样下保持样本多样性，同时维持有竞争力的视觉质量，为其他 DMD 变体提供简单而稳定的替代方案。

title_en: Divide and Conquer: Reliable Multi-View Evidential Learning for Deepfake Detection
title_zh: 分而治之：用于深度伪造检测的可靠多视图证据学习

sentences.en: With the evolution of generative models, deepfakes have achieved near-perfect semantic realism, leaving forensic traces only in subtle structural anomalies.
sentences.zh: 随着生成模型的演进，深度伪造已实现近乎完美的语义真实感，仅在微妙的结构异常中留下法证痕迹。

sentences.en: However, existing single-view paradigms often fail to generalize, as dominant semantic features overwhelm subtle artifact cues within entangled representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的单视角范式常常难以泛化，因为占主导的语义特征压倒了纠缠表示中微妙的伪影线索。

sentences.en: This imbalance leads to overconfident yet brittle predictions—a phenomenon we term the Semantic Masking Effect.
sentences.zh: 这种不平衡导致过度自信而脆弱的预测——我们将这一现象称为语义遮蔽效应。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a reliable framework called Divide-and-Conquer Multi-View Evidential Learning (DiCoME) for Deepfake Detection.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个名为分而治之多视角证据学习（DiCoME）的可靠深度伪造检测框架。

sentences.en: In the "Divide'' phase, we employ Geometric View Purification to decompose the entangled representation space through principled geometric projection.
sentences.zh: 在“分”阶段，我们采用几何视角净化，通过有原则的几何投影分解纠缠的表示空间。

sentences.en: This process suppresses semantic interference within artifact-sensitive representations, forming the foundation for decorrelated yet complementary semantic and artifact views.
sentences.zh: 这一过程抑制伪影敏感表示内的语义干扰，形成去相关但互补的语义与伪影视角的基础。

sentences.en: In the "Conquer'' phase, we leverage Uncertainty-Aware Evidential Learning to synthesize these distinct views.
sentences.zh: 在“治”阶段，我们利用不确定性感知证据学习综合这些不同视角。

sentences.en: By explicitly modeling the "epistemic conflict'' between semantic and artifact cues, this mechanism provides calibrated uncertainty estimates instead of forcing rigid deterministic decisions.
sentences.zh: 通过显式建模语义与伪影线索之间的“认知冲突”，这一机制提供校准的不确定性估计，而非强制僵化的确定性决策。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in generalization performance, while providing reliable uncertainty estimation for trustworthy deepfake detection.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的大量实验表明，我们的方法在泛化性能上一致超越现有方法，同时为可信的深度伪造检测提供可靠的不确定性估计。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/kxl0825/DiCoME.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/kxl0825/DiCoME.git 获取。

title_en: Divide and Contrast: Learning Robust Temporal Features without Augmentation
title_zh: 分解与对比：无需数据增强学习鲁棒时间特征

sentences.en: Self-supervised learning for time-series representation aims to reduce reliance on labeled data while maintaining strong downstream performance, yet many existing approaches incur high computational costs or rely on assumptions that do not hold across diverse temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 用于时间序列表示的自监督学习旨在减少对标记数据的依赖，同时保持强下游性能，然而许多现有方法招致高计算成本或依赖跨多样时间动态不成立的假设。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Divide and Contrast (Di-COT), an unsupervised framework that avoids data augmentation and multiple encoder passes by contrasting informative substructures within a window rather than individual timesteps.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入分与对比（Di-COT），一个无监督框架，它通过对比窗口内有信息量的子结构而非单个时间步来避免数据增广与多次编码器通过。

sentences.en: Di-COT stochastically partitions each window into a small number of overlapping sub-blocks per iteration, enabling efficient and meaningful contrast while mitigating false positives during temporal transitions.
sentences.zh: Di-COT 在每次迭代中将每个窗口随机划分为少量重叠子块，在缓解时间转换期间误报的同时实现高效而有意义的对比。

sentences.en: To further improve scalability, we adopt a contrastive objective whose computation depends on the batch size and the number of sub-blocks, making loss computation independent of sequence length.
sentences.zh: 为进一步改善可扩展性，我们采用一个计算依赖批量大小与子块数量的对比目标，使损失计算与序列长度无关。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on six large-scale real-world datasets, as well as the UCR and UEA benchmarks, demonstrate that Di-COT learns transferable representations while achieving state-of-the-art performance with substantially reduced training time.
sentences.zh: 在六个大规模真实世界数据集以及 UCR 与 UEA 基准上的大量实验表明，Di-COT 在实现最先进性能的同时以大幅减少的训练时间学习可迁移表示。
