title_en: Divide and Learn: Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization at Scale
title_zh: 分解与学习：大规模多目标组合优化

sentences.en: Multi-objective combinatorial optimization seeks Pareto-optimal solutions over exponentially large discrete spaces, yet existing methods sacrifice generality, scalability, or theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 多目标组合优化寻求在指数级大的离散空间中寻找 Pareto 最优解，然而现有方法牺牲通用性、可扩展性或理论保证。

sentences.en: We reformulate it as an online learning problem over a decomposed decision space, solving position-wise bandit subproblems via adaptive expert-guided sequential construction.
sentences.zh: 我们将其重新表述为分解决策空间上的在线学习问题，通过自适应专家引导的顺序构造求解逐位置老虎机子问题。

sentences.en: This formulation admits regret bounds of $O(d\sqrt{T \log T})$ depending on subproblem dimensionality \(d\) rather than combinatorial space size.
sentences.zh: 这一表述允许遗憾界为 $O(d\sqrt{T \log T})$，仅取决于子问题维度 d 而非组合空间大小。

sentences.en: On standard benchmarks, our method achieves 80--98\% of specialized solvers performance while achieving  two to three orders of magnitude improvement in sample and computational efficiency over Bayesian optimization methods.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上，我们的方法实现专门求解器性能的 80-98\%，同时在样本与计算效率上相对贝叶斯优化方法实现两到三个数量级的改进。

sentences.en: On real-world hardware-software co-design for AI accelerators with expensive simulations, we outperform competing methods under fixed evaluation budgets.
sentences.zh: 在带昂贵模拟的 AI 加速器真实世界软硬件协同设计上，我们在固定评估预算下超越竞争方法。

sentences.en: The advantage grows with problem scale and objective count, establishing bandit optimization over decomposed decision spaces as a principled alternative to surrogate modeling or offline training for multi-objective optimization.
sentences.zh: 该优势随问题规模与目标数量增长，确立对分解决策空间的老虎机优化作为多目标优化中代理建模或离线训练的有原则替代。

title_en: Divide-and-Denoise: A Game-Theoretic Method for Fairly Composing Diffusion Models
title_zh: 分解与去噪：公平组合扩散模型的博弈论方法

sentences.en: With the widespread availability of pre-trained diffusion models, there are many options for which models to use and how to use them together.
sentences.zh: 随着预训练扩散模型的广泛可用，对于使用哪些模型以及如何一起使用它们有许多选择。

sentences.en: Making these decisions depends highly on both the user's goals and the expertise of each model.
sentences.zh: 做出这些决策高度取决于用户的目标与每个模型的专业能力。

sentences.en: Taking this into account, we propose coordinating models as one would a specialized workforce--through a fair yet efficient division of labor.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，我们提议像协调专门职工队伍一样协调模型——通过公平而高效的劳动力分工。

sentences.en: Divide-and-Denoise uses multiple pre-trained diffusion models, each defined over the same space, to refine a noisy sample over time.
sentences.zh: 分与去噪（Divide-and-Denoise）使用多个在相同空间上定义的预训练扩散模型，随时间精炼含噪样本。

sentences.en: At every timestep, we alternate between (i) dividing the sample into regions in a way that satisfies our game-theoretic criteria and (ii) denoising a region with the assigned model in a way that respects our alignment criteria.
sentences.zh: 在每个时间步，我们在（i）以满足我们博弈论准则的方式将样本划分为区域，与（ii）以尊重我们对齐准则的方式用指定模型去噪一个区域之间交替。

sentences.en: This leads to a new composite denoising process that evolves together with a division process.
sentences.zh: 这导致一个新的复合去噪过程，它与划分过程一同演化。

sentences.en: Since ground truth for how models should interact is typically not available in our setup, we measure how well Divide-and-Denoise coordinates a team of single-concept text-to-image diffusion models relative to a multi-concept model.
sentences.zh: 由于在我们的设定中通常无法获得模型应如何交互的真值，我们度量分与去噪相对于多概念模型，协调一组单概念文生图扩散模型团队的效果。

sentences.en: Across several image quality metrics including the GenEval benchmark, our method generates images that capture the strengths of each model, outperforming baselines and resolving common failures like missing objects and mismatched attributes.
sentences.zh: 在包括 GenEval 基准在内的几个图像质量指标上，我们的方法生成捕获每个模型优势的图像，超越基线并解决缺失对象与属性不匹配等常见失败。

title_en: Diving into Kronecker Adapters: Component Design Matters
title_zh: 深入 Kronecker 适配器：组件设计至关重要

sentences.en: Kronecker adapters have emerged as a promising approach for fine-tuning large-scale models, enabling high-rank updates through tunable component structures.
sentences.zh: Kronecker 适配器已成为微调大规模模型的有前景方法，通过可调的组件结构实现高秩更新。

sentences.en: However, existing work largely treats the component structure as a fixed or heuristic design choice, leaving the dimensions and number of Kronecker components underexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有工作在很大程度上将组件结构视为固定或启发式的设计选择，使 Kronecker 组件的维度与数量未获充分探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we identify component structure as a key factor governing the capacity of Kronecker adapters.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们识别出组件结构是支配 Kronecker 适配器能力的关键因素。

sentences.en: We perform a fine-grained analysis of both the dimensions and number of Kronecker components.
sentences.zh: 我们对 Kronecker 组件的维度与数量都进行细粒度分析。

sentences.en: In particular, we show that the alignment between Kronecker adapters and full fine-tuning depends on  component configurations.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我们表明 Kronecker 适配器与全微调之间的对齐取决于组件配置。

sentences.en: Guided by these insights, we propose Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA).
sentences.zh: 在这些洞见的引导下，我们提出组件设计的 Kronecker 适配器（CDKA）。

sentences.en: We further provide parameter-budget–aware configuration guidelines and a tailored training stabilization strategy for practical deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供参数预算感知的配置指南以及面向实际部署的量身定制训练稳定化策略。

sentences.en: Experiments across various architectures and modalities demonstrate the effectiveness of CDKA.
sentences.zh: 跨各种架构与模态的实验证明了 CDKA 的有效性。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/rainstonee/CDKA}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/rainstonee/CDKA 获取。

title_en: Divisiveness-Consistent Label Distribution Learning
title_zh: 与分歧程度一致的标签分布学习

sentences.en: Label Distribution Learning (LDL) is an effective learning paradigm for predicting entire conditional label distributions, improving the trustworthiness of predictions in risk-sensitive tasks.
sentences.zh: 标签分布学习（LDL）是一种预测完整条件标签分布的有效学习范式，提高了风险敏感任务中预测的可信度。

sentences.en: Although previous LDL methods achieve satisfactory performance on conventional evaluation metrics, they generally overlook the divisiveness within label distributions, i.e., the propensity of label distribution to exhibit dissension between semantically opposing labels, which is an essential indicator of the practical decision risk.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的 LDL 方法在常规评估指标上取得令人满意的性能，但它们普遍忽视标签分布内的分歧性，即标签分布在语义对立标签之间表现异议的倾向，这是实际决策风险的一个重要指标。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose a divisiveness‑consistent label distribution learning framework to quantify and preserve the divisiveness information.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个一致性分歧保持（divisiveness-consistent）的标签分布学习框架，以量化和保持分歧信息。

sentences.en: First, we formalize a divisiveness measure that satisfies the axiomatic property of polarity monotonicity to quantify the divisiveness information.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们形式化一个满足极性单调性公理性质的分歧度量来量化分歧信息。

sentences.en: Second, we theoretically demonstrate the inconsistency between conventional loss functions and divisiveness error.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们在理论上证明常规损失函数与分歧误差之间的不一致性。

sentences.en: Besides, in order to address the adversarial gradient problem arising from directly minimizing the divisiveness error, we propose a pairwise divisiveness loss as an unbiased estimator of the original divisiveness error.
sentences.zh: 此外，为解决直接最小化分歧误差引起的对抗梯度问题，我们提出一个成对分歧损失，作为原始分歧误差的无偏估计器。

sentences.en: Experiments confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 实验证实了所提出方法的有效性。

title_en: DIYHealth Suite: Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Health Management at Home
title_zh: DIYHealth Suite：居家健康管理的数据集、模型与基准

sentences.en: Generative AI is reshaping healthcare, yet most existing advances rely on hospital-grade devices, which limits their accessibility and potential for health management outside clinical settings.
sentences.zh: 生成式 AI 正在重塑医疗保健，然而大多数现有进展依赖医院级设备，这限制了它们在临床环境之外的可及性与健康管理潜力。

sentences.en: With the proliferation of portable devices and telemedicine, healthcare is shifting toward home-based Diagnosis-It-Yourself (DIY) care.
sentences.zh: 随着便携设备与远程医疗的普及，医疗保健正转向基于家庭的“自我诊断”（DIY）护理。

sentences.en: Despite this promise, several distinctive challenges remain: (i) home-collected data are heterogeneous, exacerbated by the absence of standardized large-scale datasets; (ii) models require adaptation to variable task demands and evolving individual conditions; (iii) the broad spectrum of home care tasks lacks a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation.
sentences.zh: 尽管有此前景，仍有几个独特的挑战：（i）居家收集的数据是异构的，且因缺乏标准化大规模数据集而加剧；（ii）模型需要适配可变的任务需求与演化的个体状况；（iii）广泛的居家护理任务缺乏统一的基准以进行系统评估。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present **DIYHealth Suite**, a comprehensive framework designed to address these challenges through a tailored dataset, model, and benchmark.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 **DIYHealth Suite**，一个通过量身定制的数据集、模型与基准应对这些挑战的综合框架。

sentences.en: We first curate **DIYHealth-900K**, a large-scale multimodal dataset capturing diverse real-world home care scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们首先策展 **DIYHealth-900K**，一个捕获多样真实世界居家护理场景的大规模多模态数据集。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose **DIYHealthGPT**, an adaptive foundation model for home-based health management, powered by the novel Hybrid Hyper Low-Rank Adaptation technique.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出 **DIYHealthGPT**，一个由新颖的混合超低秩适配技术驱动的居家健康管理自适应基础模型。

sentences.en: Finally, we establish **DIYHealthBench**, the first benchmark to evaluate foundation models on home care tasks.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们建立 **DIYHealthBench**，首个在居家护理任务上评估基础模型的基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIYHealthGPT delivers state-of-the-art performance over both general-purpose and medical-specific baselines on 11 home care tasks in both open-QA and closed-QA settings, laying the groundwork for the next generation of personalized health management at home.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，DIYHealthGPT 在 11 个居家护理任务的开放式问答与闭式问答情境中，相较于通用与医疗特定基线都实现最先进性能，为下一代个性化居家健康管理奠定基础。

title_en: DLEBench: Evaluating Small-scale Object Editing Ability for Instruction-based Image Editing Model
title_zh: DLEBench：评估指令式图像编辑模型的小尺度物体编辑能力

sentences.en: Significant progress has been made in the field of Instruction-based Image Editing Models (IIEMs).
sentences.zh: 指令式图像编辑模型（IIEM）领域已取得显著进展。

sentences.en: However, while these models demonstrate plausible adherence to instructions and strong reasoning ability on current benchmarks, their ability to edit small objects remains underexplored, despite its importance for precise local editing and refining details in both real and generated images.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然这些模型在当前的基准上展现出貌似合理的指令遵从与强推理能力，但它们编辑小对象的能力仍未充分探索，尽管它在真实与生成图像中对精确局部编辑与细节精炼至关重要。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce DeepLookEditBench (DLEBench), the first benchmark dedicated to assessing the abilities of IIEMs in editing small-scale objects.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 DeepLookEditBench（DLEBench），首个致力于评估 IIEM 编辑小规模对象能力的基准。

sentences.en: Specifically, we construct a challenging testbed comprising 1889 samples across seven instruction types.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们构建一个包含七种指令类型、1889 个样本的挑战性试验台。

sentences.en: In these samples, target objects occupy only 1%-10% of the image area, covering complex scenarios such as partial occlusion and multi-object editing.
sentences.zh: 在这些样本中，目标对象仅占据图像面积的 1%-10%，涵盖诸如部分遮挡与多对象编辑的复杂场景。

sentences.en: To ensure robust evaluation on this benchmark, we propose an evaluation protocol with refined score rubrics to minimize subjectivity and ambiguity in two criteria: Instruction Following and Visual Consistency.
sentences.zh: 为在此基准上确保稳健评估，我们提出一个带精炼评分细则的评估协议，以在指令遵循与视觉一致性两个准则上最小化主观性与模糊性。

sentences.en: This protocol also introduces a dual-mode evaluation framework (Tool-driven and Oracle-guided Modes) addressing the misalignment between LMM-as-a-Judge and human judgments on DLEBench.
sentences.zh: 该协议还引入一个双模式评估框架（工具驱动与预言机引导模式），解决 LMM-as-a-Judge 与人类判断在 DLEBench 上的错位。

sentences.en: Empirical results on 10 IIEMs reveal significant performance gaps in small-scale object editing, highlighting the need for specialized benchmarks to advance this ability.
sentences.zh: 在 10 个 IIEM 上的实证结果揭示小规模对象编辑中的显著性能差距，凸显对专门基准以推进该能力的需求。

title_en: dLLM-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models with Adaptive Caching
title_zh: dLLM-Cache：通过自适应缓存加速扩散大语言模型

sentences.en: Autoregressive Models (ARMs) have long dominated the landscape of Large Language Models.
sentences.zh: 自回归模型（ARM）长期主导大语言模型的版图。

sentences.en: Recently, a new paradigm has emerged in the form of diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs), which generate text by iteratively denoising masked segments.
sentences.zh: 近来，一种以扩散为基础的大语言模型（dLLM）形式的新范式出现，它通过迭代去噪掩码片段生成文本。

sentences.en: This approach has shown significant advantages and potential.
sentences.zh: 这种方法已显示出显著优势与潜力。

sentences.en: However, dLLMs suffer from high inference latency.
sentences.zh: 然而，dLLM 遭受高推理延迟之苦。

sentences.en: Traditional ARM acceleration techniques, such as Key-Value caching, are incompatible with dLLMs due to their bidirectional attention mechanism.
sentences.zh: 诸如键值缓存的传统 ARM 加速技术，由于 dLLM 的双向注意力机制而与它们不兼容。

sentences.en: To address this specific challenge, our work begins with a key observation that dLLM inference involves a static prompt and a partially dynamic response, where most tokens remain stable across adjacent denoising steps.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一具体挑战，我们的工作始于一个关键观察，即 dLLM 推断涉及一个静态提示与一个部分动态的响应，其中大多数词元在相邻去噪步骤间保持稳定。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose dLLM-Cache, a training-free adaptive caching framework that combines long-interval prompt caching with partial response updates guided by feature similarity.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出 dLLM-Cache，一个免训练的自适应缓存框架，它将长间隔提示缓存与由特征相似性引导的部分响应更新相结合。

sentences.en: This design enables efficient reuse of intermediate computations without compromising model performance.
sentences.zh: 这一设计支持高效复用中间计算，而不损害模型性能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on representative dLLMs, including LLaDA 8B and Dream 7B, show that dLLM-Cache achieves up to *9.1*$\times$ FLOPs reduction on LongBench-HotpotQA while maintaining competitive output quality.
sentences.zh: 在包括 LLaDA 8B 与 Dream 7B 的代表性 dLLM 上的大量实验表明，dLLM-Cache 在 LongBench-HotpotQA 上实现至多 *9.1$\times$* 的 FLOPs 减少，同时保持有竞争力的输出质量。

sentences.en: Notably, our method brings dLLM inference latency close to that of ARMs under many settings.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的方法在许多设定下将 dLLM 推理延迟降至接近 ARM 的水平。

sentences.en: *The code for this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/maomaocun/dLLM-cache*.
sentences.zh: *本工作的代码公开于：https://github.com/maomaocun/dLLM-cache*。

title_en: DLLMQuant: A Post-Training Quantization Framework Tailored for Diffusion-Based Large Language Models
title_zh: DLLMQuant：为扩散大语言模型量身定制的训练后量化框架

sentences.en: Diffusion-based large language models (DLLMs) have shown promise for non-autoregressive text generation, but their deployment is constrained by large model sizes and heavy computational costs.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的大语言模型（DLLM）已显示出非自回归文本生成的前景，但其部署受到大模型规模与重计算成本的限制。

sentences.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ), a widely used method for compressing and accelerating Large Language Models (LLMs), suffers from severe accuracy degradation and reduced generalization performance when directly applied to DLLMs (e.g., AWQ suffers a 16% accuracy drop on LLADA under W4A4).
sentences.zh: 后训练量化（PTQ）是压缩与加速大语言模型（LLM）的广泛使用的方法，当直接应用于 DLLM（例如 AWQ 在 W4A4 下于 LLADA 上遭受 16% 准确率下降）时会遭受严重准确率退化与泛化性能降低。

sentences.en: This paper explores how the unique mechanisms of Dynamic Language Models (DLLMs) conflict with quantization, identifying three core issues: 1) During the iterative generation process of DLLMs, dynamic masking ratios are inherently involved, leading to notable differences in token distributions across decoding steps.
sentences.zh: 本文探讨动态语言模型（DLLM）的独特机制如何与量化冲突，识别出三个核心问题：1）在 DLLM 的迭代生成过程中，固有地涉及动态掩码比率，导致解码步骤之间词元分布的显著差异。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, these distinct distributions are not sufficiently captured by current PTQ calibration approaches;
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这些不同的分布未被当前的 PTQ 校准方法充分捕获；

sentences.en: 2) Quantization errors propogate and accumalte progressively during iterations in DLLMs, leading to a gradual decline in the performance of quantized models as decoding steps advance;
sentences.zh: 2）量化误差在 DLLM 的迭代过程中逐步传播并累积，随着解码步骤推进导致量化模型性能逐渐下降；

sentences.en: 3) The stability of unmasked tokens, combined with the probabilistic nature of masked tokens, gives rise to an overall feature distribution that is uncoordinated and unsuitable for PTQ.
sentences.zh: 3）未掩码词元的稳定性与掩码词元的概率性质相结合，产生一个不协调且不适合 PTQ 的整体特征分布。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose DLLMQuant, a PTQ framework tailored for DLLMs, which incorporates three novel techniques: 1) Temporal-Mask Adaptive Sampling (TMAS), a calibration method that accounts for both time and mask factors, with the capacity to capture distributions across timesteps.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 DLLMQuant，一个为 DLLM 量身定制的 PTQ 框架，纳入三种新颖技术：1）时间掩码自适应采样（TMAS），一种同时考虑时间与掩码因素的校准方法，能够捕获跨时间步的分布。

sentences.en: 2) Interaction-Aware Activation Quantization (IA-AQ), which utilizes bidirectional attention scores to identify important tokens, and prioritizes these tokens when minimizing quantization error.
sentences.zh: 2）交互感知激活量化（IA-AQ），它利用双向注意力分数识别重要词元，并在最小化量化误差时优先这些词元。

sentences.en: 3) Certainty-Guided Quantization (CGQ) incorporates mask status and token scores as core weighting criteria for error compensation, enabling PTQ to better align with the unique weight distribution of DLLMs.
sentences.zh: 3）确定性引导量化（CGQ）将掩码状态与词元分数作为误差补偿的核心加权准则，使 PTQ 更好地与 DLLM 独特的权重分布对齐。

sentences.en: Experiments show that DLLMQuant achieves significant performance gains (e.g., over 10-point accuracy improvement on GSM8K for LLADA under 4-bit quantization) while enhancing efficiency.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，DLLMQuant 实现显著的性能增益（例如在 4 位量化下 LLADA 于 GSM8K 上超过 10 分的准确率改进），同时提高效率。

title_en: DLM-Scope: Mechanistic Interpretability of Diffusion Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
title_zh: DLM-Scope：通过稀疏自编码器实现扩散语言模型的机制可解释性

sentences.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a standard tool for mechanistic interpretability in autoregressive large language models (LLMs), enabling researchers to extract sparse, human-interpretable features and intervene on model behavior.
sentences.zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为自回归大语言模型（LLM）机制可解释性的标准工具，使研究者能够提取稀疏、人类可解释的特征并干预模型行为。

sentences.en: Recently, as diffusion language models (DLMs) have become an increasingly powerful and promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, it is essential to develop tailored mechanistic interpretability tools for this emerging class of models.
sentences.zh: 近来，随着扩散语言模型（DLM）成为自回归 LLM 日益强大且有前景的替代方案，为这一新兴模型类别开发量身定制的机制可解释性工具至关重要。

sentences.en: In this work, we present **DLM-Scope**, the first SAE-based interpretability framework for DLMs, and demonstrate that trained Top-K SAEs can faithfully extract sparse, interpretable features.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们呈现 **DLM-Scope**，首个用于 DLM 的基于 SAE 的可解释性框架，并证明训练后的 Top-K SAE 能够忠实地提取稀疏、可解释的特征。

sentences.en: Notably, we find that inserting SAEs affects DLMs differently from autoregressive LLMs: while SAE insertion in LLMs typically incurs a loss penalty, in DLMs it can reduce cross-entropy loss when applied to early layers, a phenomenon absent or markedly weaker in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们发现插入 SAE 对 DLM 的影响不同于自回归 LLM：虽然 SAE 插入在 LLM 中通常招致损失惩罚，但在 DLM 中，当应用于早期层时它可以降低交叉熵损失，而这一现象在 LLM 中不存在或显著较弱。

sentences.en: Additionally, SAE features in DLMs enable more effective diffusion-time interventions, often outperforming LLM steering.
sentences.zh: 此外，DLM 中的 SAE 特征支持更有效的扩散时干预，常常优于 LLM 转向（steering）。

sentences.en: Moreover, we pioneer new SAE-based research directions for DLMs: we show that SAEs provide useful signals for DLM decoding order, and that SAE features remain stable during DLM post-training.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们开创了 DLM 的基于 SAE 的新研究方向：我们表明 SAE 为 DLM 解码顺序提供有用信号，并且 SAE 特征在 DLM 后训练期间保持稳定。

sentences.en: Overall, our work establishes a foundation for mechanistic interpretability in DLMs and highlights the potential of applying SAEs to DLM-related tasks and algorithms.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的工作为 DLM 的机制可解释性奠定了基础，并凸显将 SAE 应用于 DLM 相关任务与算法的潜力。

title_en: DLM: Unified Decision Language Models for Offline Multi-Agent Sequential Decision Making
title_zh: DLM：用于离线多智能体序贯决策的统一决策语言模型

sentences.en: Building scalable and reusable multi-agent decision policies from offline datasets remains a challenge in offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), as existing methods often rely on fixed observation formats and action spaces that limit generalization.
sentences.zh: 从离线数据集构建可扩展且可复用的多智能体决策策略，仍然是离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的一个挑战，因为现有方法通常依赖固定观察格式与限制泛化的动作空间。

sentences.en: In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer a flexible modeling interface that can naturally accommodate heterogeneous observations and actions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大语言模型（LLM）提供灵活的建模接口，可以自然地容纳异构观察与动作。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose the Decision Language Model (DLM), which formulates multi-agent decision making as a dialogue-style sequence prediction problem under the centralized training with decentralized execution paradigm.
sentences.zh: 受此激励，我们提出决策语言模型（DLM），它在集中式训练与去中心化执行范式中，将多智能体决策表述为对话式序列预测问题。

sentences.en: DLM is trained in two stages: a supervised fine-tuning phase, which leverages dialogue-style datasets for centralized training with inter-agent context and generates executable actions from offline trajectories, followed by a group relative policy optimization phase to enhance robustness to out-of-distribution actions through lightweight reward functions.
sentences.zh: DLM 分两个阶段训练：一个监督微调阶段，利用对话式数据集进行带智能体间上下文的集中式训练，并从离线轨迹生成可执行动作；随后是一个组相对策略优化阶段，通过轻量级奖励函数增强对分布外动作的稳健性。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that a unified DLM outperforms strong offline MARL baselines and LLM-based conversational decision-making methods, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios across tasks.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的实验表明，统一的 DLM 超越强离线 MARL 基线与基于 LLM 的对话式决策方法，同时在跨任务未见场景上展现强大的零样本泛化。

title_en: DLO-Lab: Benchmarking Deformable Linear Object Manipulations with Differentiable Physics
title_zh: DLO-Lab：利用可微物理评测可变形线状物体操作

sentences.en: We address the challenge of enabling robots to manipulate deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes, cables, and rubber bands.
sentences.zh: 我们应对让机器人操作绳索、电缆与橡皮筋等可变形线性对象（DLO）的挑战。

sentences.en: Prior work has primarily focused on narrow, task-specific problems, often relying on real-world demonstrations or handcrafted heuristics.
sentences.zh: 先前工作主要聚焦于狭窄的、任务特定的问题，常常依赖现实世界演示或手工构造的启发式方法。

sentences.en: Such approaches, however, struggle to scale to the wide variety of materials and tasks encountered in practice, and collecting sufficiently diverse real-world data is often impractical.
sentences.zh: 然而，此类方法难以扩展到实践中遇到的广泛材料与任务，而收集足够多样的现实世界数据常常不切实际。

sentences.en: Additionally, existing simulation environments offer limited support for the broad spectrum of material behaviors necessary for generalizable DLO manipulation.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有的模拟环境对可泛化 DLO 操作所需的广泛材料行为提供有限支持。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce a differentiable simulator explicitly designed for versatile DLO manipulation.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入一个专为多样化 DLO 操作设计的可微模拟器。

sentences.en: Our simulator models a wide range of material properties—including (in)extensibility,  elasticity, bending plasticity, and complex interactions with other objects—providing a robust foundation for learning and evaluating manipulation skills.
sentences.zh: 我们的模拟器建模广泛的材料性质——包括（不可）延伸性、弹性、弯曲塑性与与其他对象的复杂交互——为学习与评估操作技能提供稳健基础。

sentences.en: Building on this simulator, we propose a benchmark suite of representative tasks that highlight the unique challenges of DLO manipulation.
sentences.zh: 在此模拟器之上，我们提出一个突出 DLO 操作独特挑战的代表性任务基准套件。

sentences.en: The successful execution of these tasks is often hindered by the topological complexity and grasp sensitivity inherent to DLOs.
sentences.zh: 这些任务的成功执行常常受到 DLO 固有的拓扑复杂度与抓取敏感性的阻碍。

sentences.en: Therefore, we introduce a specialized DLO agent that explicitly manages these challenges by proposing strategic grasping points and decomposing long-horizon tasks to maximize control authority.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入一个专门的 DLO 智能体，它通过提出战略性抓取点并将长视界任务分解以最大化控制权威，显式管理这些挑战。

sentences.en: Finally, we evaluate various policy-learning algorithms using our framework, alongside sim-to-real transfer experiments, demonstrating our platform's potential to advance DLO manipulation.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们使用我们的框架评估各种策略学习算法，连同模拟到现实迁移实验，展示我们平台推动 DLO 操作的潜力。

sentences.en: Project page: https://dlo-lab-26.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://dlo-lab-26.github.io/。

title_en: DMCO: Budget-Aware Co-Optimization of Data Cleaning and AutoML
title_zh: DMCO：预算感知的数据清洗与自动机器学习协同优化

sentences.en: Data cleaning and automated machine learning (AutoML) are both crucial for reliable learning systems, yet are commonly treated as independent or sequential stages.
sentences.zh: 数据清洗与自动机器学习（AutoML）对于可靠学习系统都至关重要，然而它们通常被视为独立或顺序的阶段。

sentences.en: This separation ignores their strong interaction and leads to inefficient use of limited computational budgets.
sentences.zh: 这种分离忽视了它们之间的强交互，并导致有限计算预算的低效利用。

sentences.en: We propose DMCO, a unified framework that jointly optimizes data cleaning and model construction under a fixed resource budget.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DMCO，一个在固定资源预算下联合优化数据清洗与模型构建的统一框架。

sentences.en: DMCO reformulates the traditional two-stage pipeline into a time-sliced process, where data cleaning and AutoML are interleaved and adaptively scheduled.
sentences.zh: DMCO 将传统的两阶段流水线重新表述为时间切片过程，其中数据清洗与 AutoML 交错进行并自适应调度。

sentences.en: We introduce a gradient-based data cleaning sampling strategy with theoretical guarantees for minimizing gradient estimation variance, and integrates it with loss-driven sampling and progressive AutoML fitting to continuously leverage intermediate data quality improvements.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个带最小化梯度估计方差理论保证的基于梯度的数据清洗采样策略，并将其与损失驱动采样与渐进 AutoML 拟合整合，以持续利用中间数据质量改进。

sentences.en: Experiments on six real-world datasets show that DMCO consistently outperforms standalone data cleaning and AutoML baselines on both classification and regression tasks, as measured by F1 score and MSE.
sentences.zh: 在六个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，DMCO 在分类与回归任务上都一致超越独立的数据清洗与 AutoML 基线（以 F1 分数与 MSE 衡量）。

sentences.en: Under limited budgets, DMCO achieves up to 82.19% of the performance of full data cleaning with exhaustive AutoML, while remaining robust across different AutoML frameworks.
sentences.zh: 在有限预算下，DMCO 实现穷尽 AutoML 下完整数据清洗性能的至多 82.19%，同时在不同 AutoML 框架间保持稳健。

title_en: DNA: Uncovering Universal Latent Forgery Knowledge
title_zh: DNA：揭示通用潜在伪造知识

sentences.en: As generative AI achieves hyper-realism, superficial artifact detection has become obsolete.
sentences.zh: 随着生成式 AI 实现超真实感，表面伪影检测已变得过时。

sentences.en: While prevailing methods rely on resource-intensive fine-tuning of black-box backbones, we propose that forgery detection capability is already encoded within pre-trained models rather than requiring end-to-end retraining.
sentences.zh: 虽然主流方法依赖资源密集的黑盒主干微调，但我们提出伪造检测能力已编码在预训练模型中，而非需要端到端重训。

sentences.en: To elicit this intrinsic capability, we propose the discriminative neural anchors (DNA) framework, which employs a coarse-to-fine excavation mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为引出这种内在能力，我们提出判别性神经锚点（DNA）框架，它采用由粗到细的挖掘机制。

sentences.en: First, by analyzing feature decoupling and attention distribution shifts, we pinpoint critical intermediate layers where the focus of the model logically transitions from global semantics to local anomalies.
sentences.zh: 首先，通过分析特征解耦与注意力分布偏移，我们定位模型的焦点从全局语义逻辑地转移到局部异常的关键中间层。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we introduce a triadic fusion scoring metric paired with a curvature-truncation strategy to strip away semantic redundancy, precisely isolating the forgery-discriminative units (FDUs) inherently imprinted with sensitivity to forgery traces.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们引入一个三元融合评分指标，配以曲率截断策略以剥离语义冗余，精确隔离天生印有伪造痕迹敏感性的伪造判别单元（FDU）。

sentences.en: Moreover, we introduce HIFI-Gen, a high-fidelity synthetic benchmark built upon the very latest models, to address the lag in existing datasets.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入 HIFI-Gen，一个建立在最新模型之上、用于应对现有数据集滞后问题的高保真合成基准。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that by solely relying on these anchors, DNA achieves superior detection performance even under few-shot conditions.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，仅依赖这些锚点，DNA 即使在少样本条件下也能实现卓越的检测性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it exhibits remarkable robustness across diverse architectures and against unseen generative models, validating that waking up latent neurons is more effective than extensive fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在多样架构与未知生成模型面前展现出显著的稳健性，验证了唤醒潜在神经元比广泛微调更有效。

title_en: DNACHUNKER: Learnable Tokenization for DNA Language Models
title_zh: DNACHUNKER：DNA 语言模型的可学习词元化

sentences.en: DNA language models are increasingly used to represent genomic sequence, yet their effectiveness depends critically on how raw nucleotides are converted into model inputs.
sentences.zh: DNA 语言模型正日益用于表示基因组序列，然而其有效性关键取决于原始核苷酸如何被转换为模型输入。

sentences.en: Unlike natural language, DNA offers no canonical boundaries, making fixed tokenizations a brittle design choice under shifts, indels, and local repeats.
sentences.zh: 与自然语言不同，DNA 不提供规范边界，使固定词元化在偏移、插入缺失与局部重复下成为脆弱的计设选择。

sentences.en: We introduce DNAChunker, a masked DNA language model that incorporates a learnable adaptive segmentation module to produce context-dependent, variable-length units.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DNAChunker，一个掩码 DNA 语言模型，它纳入一个可学习的自适应分割模块来产生上下文相关、可变长度的单元。

sentences.en: Building on a dynamic segmentation procedure, DNAChunker learns to allocate finer granularity to functionally enriched regions while compressing repetitive or redundant sequence.
sentences.zh: 在动态分割过程的基础上，DNAChunker 学会为功能富集区域分配更细的粒度，同时压缩重复或冗余序列。

sentences.en: We pretrain DNAChunker on the human reference genome and evaluate it across five benchmarks, where it consistently improves over strong fixed-tokenization baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在人类参考基因组上预训练 DNAChunker，并在五个基准上进行评估，在那里它一致改善强固定词元化基线。

sentences.en: Further analyses and ablations indicate that unlike fixed tokenizations, segmentation is learned in a biologically-informed, mutation-resilient manner.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析与消融表明，与固定词元化不同，分割是以生物学知情、突变稳健的方式学到的。

title_en: dnaHNet: A Scalable and Hierarchical Foundation Model for Genomic Sequence Learning
title_zh: dnaHNet：用于基因组序列学习的可扩展分层基础模型

sentences.en: Genomic foundation models have the potential to decode DNA syntax, yet face a fundamental tradeoff.
sentences.zh: 基因组基础模型有潜力解码 DNA 语法，然而面临根本权衡。

sentences.en: Standard subword tokenizers fragment biologically meaningful motifs such as codons and regulatory elements, while nucleotide-level models preserve biological coherence but incur prohibitive computational costs for long contexts.
sentences.zh: 标准的子词词元化器碎片化诸如密码子与调控元件的生物学有意义基序，而核苷酸级模型保持生物学连贯性，但对长上下文招致过高计算成本。

sentences.en: We introduce dnaHNet, a state-of-the-art tokenizer-free autoregressive model that segments and models genomic sequences end to end.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 dnaHNet，一个最先进的无词元化器自回归模型，它端到端地分割并建模基因组序列。

sentences.en: Using a differentiable dynamic chunking mechanism, dnaHNet compresses raw nucleotides into latent tokens adaptively, balancing compression with predictive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 利用可微动态分块机制，dnaHNet 自适应地将原始核苷酸压缩为潜在词元，在压缩与预测准确性之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Pretrained on prokaryotic genomes, dnaHNet outperforms leading architectures including StripedHyena2 in scaling and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在原核基因组上预训练后，dnaHNet 在扩展与效率方面超越包括 StripedHyena2 在内的领先架构。

sentences.en: This recursive chunking yields quadratic FLOP reductions, enabling $>3 \times$ inference speedup over Transformers.
sentences.zh: 这种递归分块产生二次 FLOP 减少，使推理相比 Transformer 实现 $>3\times$ 的加速。

sentences.en: On zero-shot tasks, dnaHNet achieves superior performance in predicting protein variant fitness and gene essentiality, while automatically discovering hierarchical biological structures without supervision.
sentences.zh: 在零样本任务上，dnaHNet 在预测蛋白质变异适应度与基因必需性方面取得卓越性能，同时无监督地自动发现层级生物结构。

sentences.en: These results establish dnaHNet as a scalable, interpretable framework for next-generation genomic modeling.
sentences.zh: 这些结果确立了 dnaHNet 作为下一代基因组建模的可扩展、可解释框架。

title_en: Do Activation Verbalization Methods Convey Privileged Information?
title_zh: 激活语言化方法是否传递特权信息？

sentences.en: Recent interpretability methods have proposed to translate LLM internal representations into natural language descriptions using a second *verbalizer* LLM.
sentences.zh: 近期的可解释性方法提议使用第二个*言语化器* LLM 将 LLM 内部表示翻译为自然语言描述。

sentences.en: This is intended to illuminate how the target model represents and operates on inputs.
sentences.zh: 这旨在阐明目标模型如何表示并对输入进行运算。

sentences.en: But do such *activation verbalization* approaches actually provide *privileged* knowledge about the internal workings of the target model, or do they merely convey information about the inputs provided to it?
sentences.zh: 但此类*激活言语化*方法是否真的提供关于目标模型内部运作的*特权*知识，或者它们仅传达提供给它的输入信息？

sentences.en: We critically evaluate popular verbalization methods and datasets used in prior work and find that one can perform well on such benchmarks without access to target model internals, suggesting that these datasets are not ideal for evaluating verbalization methods.
sentences.zh: 我们批判性地评估先前工作使用的流行言语化方法与数据集，并发现在没有目标模型内部访问的情况下也可以在这些基准上表现出色，表明这些数据集不适合评估言语化方法。

sentences.en: We then run controlled experiments which reveal that verbalizations often reflect the parametric knowledge of the verbalizer LLM that generated them, rather than the knowledge of the target LLM whose activations are decoded.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们运行受控实验，这些实验揭示言语化常常反映生成它们的言语化器 LLM 的参数知识，而非其激活被解码的目标 LLM 的知识。

sentences.en: Taken together, our results indicate a need for targeted benchmarks and experimental controls to rigorously assess whether verbalization methods provide meaningful insights into the operations of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们的结果表明需要有针对性的基准与实验控制，以严格评估言语化方法是否提供对 LLM 运算的有意义洞见。

title_en: Do Audio LLMs Listen or Read? Analyzing and Mitigating Paralinguistic Failures with VoxParadox
title_zh: 音频大语言模型在听还是在读？利用 VoxParadox 分析并缓解副语言信息处理失败

sentences.en: Audio large language models (Audio LLMs) demonstrate strong performance on speech understanding tasks, yet their ability to understand paralinguistic information remains limited.
sentences.zh: 音频大语言模型（Audio LLM）在语音理解任务上展现出强劲性能，然而它们理解副语言信息的能力仍然有限。

sentences.en: To systematically quantify this issue, we introduce **VoxParadox**, an adversarial benchmark with 2,000 verified examples, spanning 10 paralinguistic tasks, created with controlled speech synthesis to intentionally mismatch transcript claims and speaking style, enabling direct measurement of speech paralinguistic understanding.
sentences.zh: 为系统量化这一问题，我们引入 **VoxParadox**，一个包含 2,000 个经验证示例、横跨 10 个副语言任务的对抗性基准，通过受控语音合成有意制造转录内容与说话风格的不匹配，能够直接测量语音副语言理解。

sentences.en: Evaluation of a diverse set of Audio LLMs reveals consistently low accuracy on acoustic ground truth and a strong tendency to follow language-implied (incorrect) answers.
sentences.zh: 对一组多样 Audio LLM 的评估揭示出在声学真值上持续低准确率，以及遵循语言暗示（错误）答案的强倾向。

sentences.en: To understand the cause of this gap, we perform layer-wise probing and find that (i) paralinguistic cues can degrade in deeper encoder layers and at the encoder--LLM interface, and (ii) even when such cues are available in audio tokens, the language model frequently ignores them.
sentences.zh: 为理解这一差距的原因，我们进行逐层探测，发现（i）副语言线索可能较深层编码器层以及编码器-LLM 接口处退化，并且（ii）即使此类线索在音频词元中可用，语言模型也常常忽略它们。

sentences.en: To address these problems, we propose **Prompt-Conditioned Layer Mixer (PCLM)**, which adaptively combines information from multiple audio layers based on the input prompt, and pair it with **Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)** to explicitly prefer acoustically supported options over language-implied alternatives.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出**提示条件层混合器（PCLM）**，它基于输入提示自适应地组合多个音频层的信息，并将其与**直接偏好优化（DPO）**配对，以显式偏好声学支持的选项而非语言暗示的替代。

sentences.en: These methods substantially improve Audio LLM paralinguistic understanding, improving Audio Flamingo 3 from **17.40%** to **65.20%** on VoxParadox, and from **37.74%** to **54.78%** on MMSU paralinguistic subset.
sentences.zh: 这些方法大幅提升 Audio LLM 的副语言理解，将 Audio Flamingo 3 在 VoxParadox 上从 **17.40%** 提升到 **65.20%**，在 MMSU 副语言子集上从 **37.74%** 提升到 **54.78%**。

sentences.en: Our project page is available at https://voxparadox.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面可在 https://voxparadox.github.io/ 获取。

title_en: Do Language Models Track Entities Across State Changes?
title_zh: 语言模型能否跨状态变化追踪实体？

sentences.en: Entity tracking (ET), the ability to keep track of states, is a fundamental skill that underlies complex reasoning.
sentences.zh: 实体跟踪（ET），即跟踪状态的能力，是支撑复杂推理的基本技能。

sentences.en: An increasing amount of work investigates how transformer language models (LMs) solve entity binding *without* state changes.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的工作研究 Transformer 语言模型（LM）如何在*无*状态变化的情况下解决实体绑定。

sentences.en: However, there is limited understanding of how non-toy LMs address ET problems of realistic difficulties expressed in natural language.
sentences.zh: 然而，对非玩具级 LM 如何解决以自然语言表达的具有现实难度的 ET 问题，理解仍然有限。

sentences.en: To this end, we investigate the mechanisms underlying ET in more complex scenarios featuring multiple state-changing operations.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们研究在具有多个状态变化操作的更复杂场景中 ET 的底层机制。

sentences.en: We find that LMs do not incrementally track world states across tokens or query-relevant states across layers, but simply aggregate relevant information in parallel at the last token when the query becomes evident.
sentences.zh: 我们发现 LM 并不跨词元增量跟踪世界状态，也不跨层跟踪查询相关状态，而只是在查询变得明显时，于最后一个词元并行聚合相关信息。

sentences.en: We further investigate mechanisms of individual operations (`PUT`, `REMOVE`, `MOVE`) to characterize this non-incremental ET mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步研究单个操作（PUT、REMOVE、MOVE）的机制，以刻画这种非增量 ET 机制。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, LMs implement the `REMOVE` operation with a fragile global suppression tag; this global removal mechanism predicts various failure modes that we confirm behaviorally.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，LM 用脆弱的全局抑制标签实现 REMOVE 操作；这种全局移除机制预测了我们在行为上确认的各种失败模式。

sentences.en: We provide a mechanistic solution of nullifying this tag to partially address this issue.
sentences.zh: 我们提供一种使此标签失效的机制性解决方案，以部分解决这一问题。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings reveal that LMs solve a fundamentally sequential task using a non-sequential strategy.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现揭示 LM 用一种非顺序策略解决一个根本上是顺序的任务。

sentences.en: More broadly, our work illustrates how behavioral and mechanistic analyses can fruitfully interact.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的工作说明了行为与机制分析如何富有成效地互动。

sentences.en: Behavioral results inform mechanistic hypotheses, and insights from mechanistic analyses help build stronger behavioral evaluations by predicting failure modes missing from existing evaluations.
sentences.zh: 行为结果为机制性假设提供信息，而机制分析的洞见通过预测现有评估中缺失的失败模式，帮助构建更强的行为评估。

title_en: Do LLMs Signal When They’re Right? Evidence from Neuron Agreement
title_zh: 大语言模型是否会在答对时发出信号？来自神经元一致性的证据

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) commonly boost reasoning via sample-evaluate-ensemble decoders (e.g., majority voting), achieving label free gains without ground truth.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通常通过样本-评估-集成解码器（例如多数投票）提升推理，在无真值的金标准下实现标签免费增益。

sentences.en: However, prevailing strategies score candidates using only external outputs such as token probabilities, entropies, or self evaluations, and these signals can be poorly calibrated after post training.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流策略仅使用外部输出（如词元概率、熵或自我评估）对候选评分，而这些信号在后训练后可能校准不佳。

sentences.en: We instead analyze internal behavior based on neuron activations and uncover three findings: (1) external signals are low dimensional projections of richer internal dynamics; (2) correct responses activate substantially fewer unique neurons than incorrect ones throughout generation; and (3) activations from correct responses exhibit stronger cross sample agreement, whereas incorrect ones diverge.
sentences.zh: 我们转而分析基于神经元激活的内部行为，并发现三个发现：（1）外部信号是更丰富内部动态的低维投影；（2）在整个生成过程中，正确响应激活的唯一神经元显著少于不正确响应；以及（3）正确响应的激活表现出更强的跨样本一致性，而不正确响应则分化。

sentences.en: Motivated by these observations, we propose Neuron Agreement Decoding (NAD), an unsupervised best of N method that selects candidates using activation sparsity and cross sample neuron agreement, operating solely on internal signals and without requiring comparable textual outputs.
sentences.zh: 受这些观察启发，我们提出神经元一致性解码（NAD），一种无监督最佳 N 方法，它使用激活稀疏性与跨样本神经元一致性选择候选，仅依赖内部信号且无需可比较的文本输出。

sentences.en: NAD enables early correctness prediction within the first 32 generated tokens and supports aggressive early stopping.
sentences.zh: NAD 支持在前 32 个生成词元内进行早期正确性预测，并支持激进的最佳停止。

sentences.en: Across math and science benchmarks with verifiable answers, NAD matches majority voting; on open ended coding benchmarks where majority voting is inapplicable, NAD consistently outperforms Avg@64.
sentences.zh: 在具有可验证答案的数学与科学基准上，NAD 匹敌多数投票；在多数投票不适用的开放式编码基准上，NAD 一致超越 Avg@64。

sentences.en: By pruning unpromising trajectories early, NAD reduces token usage by 99% with minimal loss in generation quality, showing that internal signals provide reliable, scalable, and efficient guidance for label free ensemble decoding.
sentences.zh: 通过尽早剪除无前景的轨迹，NAD 将词元使用减少 99%，同时生成质量损失极小，表明内部信号为无标签集成解码提供可靠、可扩展且高效的指导。

title_en: Do LLMs “Feel”? Emotion Circuits Discovery and Control
title_zh: 大语言模型有“感受”吗？情绪回路的发现与控制

sentences.en: As the demand for emotional intelligence in large language models (LLMs) grows, a key challenge lies in understanding the internal mechanisms that give rise to emotional expression and in controlling emotions in generated text.
sentences.zh: 随着对大语言模型（LLM）情商需求的增长，一个关键挑战在于理解产生情绪表达的内部机制以及控制生成文本中的情绪。

sentences.en: This study addresses three core questions: (1) Do LLMs contain context-agnostic mechanisms shaping emotional expression?
sentences.zh: 本研究应对三个核心问题：（1）LLM 是否包含塑造情绪表达的上下文无关机制？

sentences.en: (2) What form do these mechanisms take?
sentences.zh: （2）这些机制采取何种形式？

sentences.en: (3) Can they be harnessed for universal emotion control?
sentences.zh: （3）它们能否被利用于通用情绪控制？

sentences.en: We first construct a controlled dataset, $\textit{SEV}$ (Scenario–Event with Valence), to elicit comparable internal states across emotions.
sentences.zh: 我们首先构建一个受控数据集 \textit{SEV}（Scenario-Event with Valence），以引出跨情绪的可比内部状态。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we extract context-agnostic emotion directions that reveal consistent, cross-context encoding of emotion (Q1).
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提取上下文无关的情绪方向，揭示情绪的一致跨上下文编码（Q1）。

sentences.en: We identify neurons and attention heads that locally implement emotional computation through analytical decomposition and causal analysis, and validate their causal roles via ablation and enhancement interventions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过解析分解与因果分析识别局部实现情绪计算的神经元与注意力头，并通过消融与增强干预验证它们的因果作用。

sentences.en: Next, we quantify each sublayer's causal influence on the model’s final emotion representation and integrate the identified local components into coherent global emotion circuits that drive emotional expression (Q2).
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们量化每个子层对模型最终情绪表示的因果影响，并将识别的局部组件整合成驱动情绪表达的连贯全局情绪回路（Q2）。

sentences.en: Directly modulating these circuits achieves 99.65% emotion-expression accuracy on the test set, surpassing prompting- and steering-based methods (Q3).
sentences.zh: 直接调制这些回路在测试集上实现 99.65% 的情绪表达准确率，超越基于提示与转向的方法（Q3）。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study to uncover and validate emotion circuits in LLMs, offering new insights into interpretability and controllable emotional intelligence.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个在 LLM 中揭示并验证情绪回路的系统性研究，为可解释性与可控情商提供新洞见。

title_en: Do Neural Operators Forget Geometry? The Forgetting Hypothesis in Deep Operator Learning
title_zh: 神经算子会遗忘几何吗？深度算子学习中的遗忘假说

sentences.en: Neural operators perform well on structured domains, yet their behaviour on irregular geometries remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 神经算子在结构化域上表现良好，然而它们在不规则几何上的行为仍未被充分理解。

sentences.en: We show that this limitation is not merely an encoding issue, but a depth-wise failure mode inherent to deep operator architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这一局限不仅仅是编码问题，而是深度算子架构固有的逐深度失败模式。

sentences.en: We formalise the *Geometric Forgetting Hypothesis*: due to the Markovian structure of operator layers and their reliance on global mixing mechanisms, neural operators progressively lose access to domain geometry as depth increases.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化*几何遗忘假说*：由于算子层的马尔可夫结构及其对全局混合机制的依赖，神经算子随深度增加逐渐失去对域几何的访问。

sentences.en: Using layer-wise geometric probing, we demonstrate that both spectral and attention-based operators systematically lose geometric fidelity.
sentences.zh: 使用逐层几何探测，我们证明基于谱与基于注意力的算子都系统性丧失几何保真度。

sentences.en: We show that this geometric forgetting degrades accuracy, stability, and generalisation.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这种几何遗忘退化准确率、稳定性与泛化。

sentences.en: To counteract it, we introduce a lightweight *geometry memory injection* mechanism that restores geometric constraints at intermediate depths with minimal architectural overhead.
sentences.zh: 为抵消它，我们引入一种轻量级*几何记忆注入*机制，它以极小的架构开销在中间深度恢复几何约束。

sentences.en: This simple intervention consistently mitigates forgetting and exposes a *geometric shortcut* instability in transformer-based operators, revealing that geometric retention is a structural requirement rather than a design choice.
sentences.zh: 这种简单干预一致地缓解遗忘，并在基于 Transformer 的算子中暴露一种*几何捷径*不稳定性，揭示几何保持是结构性要求而非设计选择。

title_en: Do Sparse Autoencoders Identify Reasoning Features in Language Models?
title_zh: 稀疏自编码器能否识别语言模型的推理特征？

sentences.en: We study how reliably sparse autoencoders (SAEs) support claims about reasoning-related internal features in large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）在多大程度上可靠支持关于大语言模型中与推理相关的内部特征的主张。

sentences.en: We first give a stylized analysis showing that sparsity-regularized decoding can preferentially retain stable low-dimensional correlates while suppressing high-dimensional within-behavior variation, motivating the possibility that contrastively selected "reasoning" features may concentrate on cue-like structure when such cues are coupled with reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 我们首先给出一个风格化分析，表明稀疏正则化解码可以优先保留稳定的低维相关量，同时抑制高维行为内变化，从而支持这样的可能性：当此类线索与推理轨迹耦合时，对比选择出的“推理”特征可能集中于线索类结构。

sentences.en: Building on this perspective, we propose a falsification-based evaluation framework that combines causal token injection with LLM-guided counterexample construction.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们提出一个基于证伪的评估框架，结合因果词元注入与 LLM 引导的反例构造。

sentences.en: Across 22 configurations spanning multiple model families, layers, and reasoning datasets, we find that many contrastively selected candidates are highly sensitive to token-level interventions, with 45%–90% activating after injecting only a few associated tokens into non-reasoning text.
sentences.zh: 在横跨多个模型家族、层与推理数据集的 22 个配置中，我们发现许多对比选择的候选对词元级干预高度敏感，在向非推理文本中仅注入少数关联词元后就有 45%-90% 被激活。

sentences.en: For the remaining context-dependent candidates, LLM-guided falsification produces targeted non-reasoning inputs that trigger activation and meaning-preserving paraphrases of top-activating reasoning traces that suppress it.
sentences.zh: 对于其余依赖上下文的候选，LLM 引导的证伪产生触发激活的针对性非推理输入，以及抑制激活的顶层激活推理轨迹的意义保持释义。

sentences.en: A small steering study yields minimal changes on the evaluated benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 一项小型转向研究在评估的基准上产生极小的变化。

sentences.en: Overall, our results suggest that, in the settings we study, sparse decompositions can favor low-dimensional correlates that co-occur with reasoning, underscoring the need for falsification when attributing high-level behaviors to individual SAE features.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，在我们研究的情境中，稀疏分解可能偏好与推理共现的低维相关量，强调在将高层行为归因于单个 SAE 特征时需要证伪。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/GeorgeMLP/reasoning-probing.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/GeorgeMLP/reasoning-probing 获取。

title_en: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
title_zh: 文本编辑能否泛化到视觉生成？评测统一多模态模型中的跨模态知识编辑

sentences.en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose multimodal intelligence.
sentences.zh: 统一多模态模型（UMM）已成为通用多模态智能的有前景范式。

sentences.en: As they are deployed in real-world applications, effectively updating internal knowledge becomes critical.
sentences.zh: 随着它们在现实应用中的部署，有效更新内部知识变得至关重要。

sentences.en: While knowledge editing has matured for text-only models, it remains unclear whether edits that successfully modify textual outputs also transfer to image generation in UMMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然知识编辑已在仅文本模型中成熟，但成功修改文本输出的编辑是否也迁移到 UMM 的图像生成仍不清楚。

sentences.en: To study this question, we introduce UniKE, the first benchmark for cross-modality knowledge editing in UMMs, comprising 2,971 edit subjects spanning attribute and relation edits.
sentences.zh: 为研究这一问题，我们引入 UniKE，首个用于 UMM 跨模态知识编辑的基准，包含涵盖属性与关系编辑的 2,971 个编辑主体。

sentences.en: Using VQA-based visual verification, we reveal a striking modality gap: text-side efficacy can reach approximately 92\%, whereas the best overall VQA accuracy under direct image generation is only 18.5\%.
sentences.zh: 使用基于 VQA 的视觉验证，我们揭示一个惊人的模态差距：文本侧有效性可达到约 92\%，而直接图像生成下的最佳整体 VQA 准确率仅为 18.5\%。

sentences.en: We further propose Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing, which explicitly activates edited knowledge before generation and improves overall VQA accuracy for all evaluated model-editor pairs, with gains up to 18.6 percentage points.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出推理增强参数编辑，它在生成前显式激活编辑后的知识，并为所有评估的模型-编辑器对改善整体 VQA 准确率，增益至多 18.6 个百分点。

sentences.en: Mechanistic analysis shows that this gap is associated with partial alignment between edited textual representations and the conditioning pathways for visual generation, where edits sufficient for text outputs may remain too weak or misaligned to steer image synthesis.
sentences.zh: 机制分析表明，这一差距与编辑后的文本表示和视觉生成调控通路之间的部分对齐相关，对于文本输出足够的编辑对于引导图像合成可能仍然太弱或错位。

sentences.en: These findings show that textual knowledge edits do not guarantee reliable cross-modality transfer and motivate modality-aware editing methods.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，文本知识编辑不能保证可靠的跨模态迁移，并推动模态感知编辑方法的发展。

sentences.en: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据可在 https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE 获取。

title_en: Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants
title_zh: Transformer 需要三个投影吗？对 QKV 变体的系统研究

sentences.en: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role.
sentences.zh: Transformer 已成为各种 AI 任务的标准解决方案，其中查询、键与值（QKV）注意力公式起核心作用。

sentences.en: However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，这三个投影的个体贡献以及省略其中一些的影响仍未被充分理解。

sentences.en: We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection).
sentences.zh: 我们系统评估三种投影共享约束：a) Q-K=V（共享键值），b) Q=K-V（共享查询键），以及 c) Q=K=V（单一投影）。

sentences.en: The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings.
sentences.zh: 后两种变体产生对称注意力图；为应对这一点，我们还通过 2D 位置编码探索不对称注意力。

sentences.en: Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer.
sentences.zh: 通过跨合成任务、视觉（MNIST、CIFAR、TinyImageNet、异常检测）与语言建模（在 10B 词元上训练的 300M 与 1.2B 参数模型）的实验，我们发现我们的 Transformer 与 QKV Transformer 表现相当，偶尔更好。

sentences.en: In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50\% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation.
sentences.zh: 在语言建模中，Q-K=V 投影共享在仅 3.1% 困惑度退化的情况下实现 50\% 的 KV 缓存减少。

sentences.en: Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%—enabling practical on-device inference.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，投影共享与头共享（GQA/MQA）互补：将 Q-K=V 与 GQA-4 结合可实现 87.5% 的缓存减少，而 Q-K=V + MQA 实现 96.9%——支持实用的设备端推理。

sentences.en: We further show that Q--K=V preserves quality because keys and values can share representational space, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明 Q-K=V 保持质量，因为键与值可以共享表示空间，而 Q=K-V 破坏注意力方向性。

sentences.en: Our results establish projection sharing as a new optimization axis for memory-efficient transformers, especially for edge deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果确立了投影共享作为内存高效 Transformer（尤其是边缘部署）的一个新优化轴。

title_en: Do Vision and Text Cues Exhibit Evidential Coupling? UFO: A Benchmark for Compositional Multimodal Reasoning in Unified Models
title_zh: 视觉与文本线索是否存在证据耦合？UFO：统一模型组合式多模态推理基准

sentences.en: Unified Foundation Models (UFMs), which support interleaved multimodal generation and understanding, have been proposed as a promising paradigm for reasoning about dynamic world states, yet it remains unclear whether the visual content they generate functions as grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning or merely as auxiliary output.
sentences.zh: 统一基础模型（UFM）支持交错的多模态生成与理解，已被提议作为推理动态世界状态的有前景范式，然而它们生成的视觉内容作为后续推理的立足证据还是仅仅作为辅助输出，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks largely evaluate generation and understanding as separate capabilities and do not test their functional dependence during reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有基准在很大程度上将生成与理解作为独立能力评估，并未测试它们在推理中的功能依赖。

sentences.en: We introduce UFO, a benchmark designed to evaluate whether UFMs generate and use image and text cues as evidence for compositional multimodal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 UFO，一个旨在评估 UFM 是否生成并使用图像与文本线索作为组合多模态推理证据的基准。

sentences.en: UFO spans three state-transition regimes, state determination, state reconstruction, and state augmentation, which correspond to progressively smaller transformations of the underlying world state.
sentences.zh: UFO 横跨三个状态转换区间，即状态确定、状态重建与状态增强，它们对应于底层世界状态逐步缩小的变换。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals a significant modality gap, as models often achieve high prediction accuracy even when the generated visual cues exert limited influence on their decisions, indicating weakened evidential coupling and a reliance on textual shortcuts rather than robust cross-modal grounding.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示显著的模态差距，因为即使生成的视觉线索对模型决策施加有限影响，模型也常常实现高预测准确率，表明证据耦合减弱以及对文本捷径而非稳健跨模态立足的依赖。

title_en: Do We Need Adam? Surprisingly Strong and Sparse Reinforcement Learning with SGD in LLMs
title_zh: 我们需要 Adam 吗？大语言模型中使用 SGD 的强化学习出乎意料地强大且稀疏

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL from verifiable reward (RLVR), has become a crucial phase of training large language models (LLMs) and a key focus of current scaling efforts.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL），尤其是来自可验证奖励的 RL（RLVR），已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）的关键阶段，也是当前扩展工作的重点。

sentences.en: However, optimization practices in RL largely follow those of next-token-prediction stages (e.g., pretraining and supervised fine-tuning), despite the fundamental differences between RL and these stages emphasized by recent work.
sentences.zh: 然而，RL 中的优化实践在很大程度上沿用下一词元预测阶段（例如预训练与监督微调）的做法，尽管近期工作强调了 RL 与这些阶段之间的根本差异。

sentences.en: One such practice is the use of the AdamW optimizer, which is widely adopted for training large-scale transformers despite its high memory overhead.
sentences.zh: 其中一种实践是使用 AdamW 优化器，它尽管内存开销高，仍被广泛用于训练大规模 Transformer。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that both momentum and adaptive learning rate of AdamW are less influential in RL than in SFT, leading us to hypothesize that RL benefits less from Adam’s per-parameter adaptive learning rates and momentum.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，AdamW 的动量与自适应学习率在 RL 中的影响力都小于在 SFT 中，这使我们假设 RL 从 Adam 的逐参数自适应学习率与动量中获益较少。

sentences.en: Confirming our hypothesis, our experiments demonstrate that the substantially more memory-efficient SGD, which is known to perform poorly in supervised learning of large-scale transformers, matches or even outperforms AdamW in RL for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 证实我们的假设，我们的实验表明，内存效率显著更高的 SGD（已知在大规模 Transformer 的监督学习中表现不佳）在 LLM 的 RL 中匹敌甚至超越 AdamW。

sentences.en: Remarkably, full fine-tuning with SGD updates fewer than 0.02% of model without any sparsity-promoting regularization, more than 1,000 times fewer than AdamW. Our analysis offers potential reasons for this update sparsity.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，使用 SGD 的全微调在没有任何稀疏性促进正则化的情况下更新了不到 0.02\% 的模型，比 AdamW 少 1,000 倍以上。我们的分析为这种更新稀疏性提供了可能的原因。

sentences.en: Our findings provide fresh insights into the optimization dynamics of RL in LLMs and demonstrate that RL can be substantially more parameter-efficient than previously recognized.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现为 LLM 中 RL 的优化动态提供了新洞见，并表明 RL 可以比先前认识到的更大幅度地更参数高效。

title_en: Do-Prompt: Causal Interventions Meet Variational Prompt Bottlenecks
title_zh: Do-Prompt：因果干预与变分提示瓶颈相结合

sentences.en: Multi-modal prompt learning is a parameter-efficient approach to adapting large vision-language models to downstream classification tasks.
sentences.zh: 多模态提示学习是一种将大型视觉-语言模型适配到下游分类任务的参数高效方法。

sentences.en: However, prompts can inadvertently evolve into a high-capacity pathway that encodes environment-dependent spurious correlations, which are predictive only in the source domain and thereby undermine transferability.
sentences.zh: 然而，提示可能无意中演变成编码环境相关虚假相关的高容量通路，这些相关仅在源领域具有预测性，从而破坏可迁移性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, this paper introduces **Do-Prompt**, a *compress-and-intervene* framework that brings together variational bottlenecks and causal interventions for robust prompt tuning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，本文引入 **Do-Prompt**，一个将变分瓶颈与因果干预结合用于稳健提示调优的*压缩与干预*框架。

sentences.en: We model prompts as stochastic latent variables and impose a *variational prompt bottleneck* to explicitly regulate the information transmitted through prompts, effectively mitigating their tendency to memorize spurious nuisance cues.
sentences.zh: 我们将提示建模为随机潜在变量，并施加一个*变分提示瓶颈*，显式规范通过提示传输的信息，有效缓解它们记忆虚假干扰线索的倾向。

sentences.en: Building on this capacity constraint, we propose lightweight *prompt-level interventions* by perturbing the environment-related prompt components and enforcing prediction consistency under these *do*-style perturbations.
sentences.zh: 在此容量约束的基础上，我们提出轻量级的*提示级干预*，通过扰动环境相关提示组件，并在这些*do*式扰动下强制预测一致性。

sentences.en: This synergistic integration encourages reliance on task-stable, invariant semantics rather than spurious prompt content.
sentences.zh: 这种协同整合鼓励依赖任务稳定、不变语义而非虚假提示内容。

sentences.en: Notably, Do-Prompt is plug-and-play compatible with existing multi-modal prompt tuning pipelines and introduces negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，Do-Prompt 与现有的多模态提示调优流水线即插即用兼容，并引入可忽略的计算开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on base-to-novel generalization, cross-dataset transfer, and ImageNet distribution shifts demonstrate consistent performance gains, with particularly notable improvements on datasets exhibiting pronounced domain or texture biases.
sentences.zh: 在基础到新颖泛化、跨数据集迁移与 ImageNet 分布偏移上的大量实验展示了一致的性能增益，在表现出显著领域或纹理偏差的数据集上尤其显著。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Doc-to-LoRA: Learning to Instantly Internalize Contexts
title_zh: Doc-to-LoRA：学习即时内化上下文

sentences.en: Long input sequences are central to in-context learning, document understanding, and multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 长输入序列是大语言模型（LLM）中上下文学习、文档理解与多步推理的核心。

sentences.en: However, the quadratic attention cost of Transformers makes inference memory-intensive and slow.
sentences.zh: 然而，Transformer 的二次注意力成本使推理内存密集且缓慢。

sentences.en: While context distillation (CD) can transfer information into model parameters, per-prompt distillation is impractical due to training costs and latency.
sentences.zh: 虽然上下文蒸馏（CD）可以将信息转移到模型参数中，但逐提示蒸馏因训练成本与延迟而不切实际。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose Doc-to-LoRA (D2L), a lightweight hypernetwork that meta-learns to perform approximate CD within a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出 Doc-to-LoRA（D2L），一个元学习在单次前向传播内执行近似 CD 的轻量级超网络。

sentences.en: Given an unseen prompt, D2L generates a LoRA adapter for a target LLM, enabling subsequent queries to be answered without re-consuming the original context, reducing latency and KV-cache memory consumption during target LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 给定一个未见提示，D2L 为目标 LLM 生成一个 LoRA 适配器，使后续查询无需重新消费原始上下文即可被回答，从而减少目标 LLM 推理期间的延迟与 KV 缓存内存消耗。

sentences.en: On a long-context needle-in-a-haystack task, D2L successfully learns to map contexts into adapters that store the needle information, achieving near-perfect zero-shot accuracy at sequence lengths exceeding the target LLM’s native context window by more than 4x.
sentences.zh: 在一个长上下文大海捞针任务上，D2L 成功学会将上下文映射为存储针信息的适配器，在超过目标 LLM 原生上下文窗口 4 倍以上的序列长度上实现近乎完美的零样本准确率。

sentences.en: On real-world QA datasets with limited compute, D2L outperforms standard CD while significantly reducing peak memory consumption and update latency.
sentences.zh: 在计算有限的真实世界 QA 数据集上，D2L 在显著减少峰值内存消耗与更新延迟的同时超越标准 CD。

sentences.en: We envision that D2L can facilitate rapid adaptation of LLMs, opening up the possibility of frequent knowledge updates and personalized chat behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们设想 D2L 能够促进 LLM 的快速适配，为频繁知识更新与个性化聊天行为开辟可能。

sentences.en: Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/doc-to-lora.
sentences.zh: 代码与检查点可在 https://github.com/SakanaAI/doc-to-lora 获取。

title_en: DocHop: Benchmarking Out-of-domain Multi-hop Reasoning in Information-Dense Documents
title_zh: DocHop：评测信息密集文档中的域外多跳推理

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on structured visual understanding tasks such as chart and document question answering.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图表与文档问答等结构化视觉理解任务上取得了强劲性能。

sentences.en: However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these domains in isolation, leaving underexplored a key capability: whether models can use textual context to determine how chart evidence should be selected, interpreted, and aggregated.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有基准通常孤立评估这些领域，使一个关键能力研究不足：模型能否使用文本上下文来确定图表证据应如何被选择、解释与聚合。

sentences.en: We introduce DocHop, a benchmark for integrated chart--context reasoning in document-style images.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DocHop，一个用于文档风格图像中集成图表-上下文推理的基准。

sentences.en: In DocHop, the document narrative specifies multi-step compositional constraints, while charts provide the corresponding data values.
sentences.zh: 在 DocHop 中，文档叙事指定多步组合约束，而图表提供相应的数据值。

sentences.en: Questions are grounded on a semantic reference label defined in the narrative, requiring models to resolve target entities from context before aggregating evidence across multiple charts.
sentences.zh: 问题立足在叙事中定义的语义参考标签上，要求模型在跨多个图表聚合证据之前先从上下文解析目标实体。

sentences.en: To enable systematic evaluation, we construct DocHop via a stochastic logic-first generation pipeline with controllable reasoning depth and visual density, covering 1,876 examples across six task categories.
sentences.zh: 为支持系统评估，我们通过随机逻辑优先生成流水线构建 DocHop，具有可控的推理深度与视觉密度，涵盖六个任务类别的 1,876 个示例。

sentences.en: Experiments on a wide range of proprietary and open-source MLLMs show a substantial gap to human performance: annotators achieve over 90% accuracy, while the best model reaches only 60.18%.
sentences.zh: 对广泛专有与开源 MLLM 的实验显示与人类性能的巨大差距：标注者实现超过 90% 的准确率，而最佳模型仅达到 60.18%。

sentences.en: Reasoning-enhanced models consistently show improved results, but performance degrades as reasoning complexity increases.
sentences.zh: 推理增强的模型一致显示改进的结果，但随着推理复杂度的增加性能下降。

sentences.en: Overall, DocHop provides a controlled testbed for challenging multi-hop document reasoning.
sentences.zh: 总之，DocHop 为挑战多跳文档推理提供受控试验台。

title_en: DOCKSMITH: Scaling Reliable Coding Environments via an Agentic Docker Builder
title_zh: DOCKSMITH：通过智能体式 Docker 构建器扩展可靠编程环境

sentences.en: Reliable Docker-based environment construction is a dominant bottleneck for scaling execution-grounded training and evaluation of software engineering agents.
sentences.zh: 可靠的基于 Docker 的环境构建是扩展软件工程智能体执行立足训练与评估的主要瓶颈。

sentences.en: We introduce DockSmith, a specialized agentic Docker builder designed to address this challenge.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DockSmith，一个专门应对这一挑战的智能体 Docker 构建器。

sentences.en: DockSmith treats environment construction not merely as a preprocessing step, but as a core agentic capability that exercises long-horizon tool use, dependency reasoning, and failure recovery, yielding supervision that transfers beyond Docker building itself.
sentences.zh: DockSmith 不仅将环境构建视为预处理步骤，而是将其视为一种核心智能体能力，锻炼长视界工具使用、依赖推理与失败恢复，产生超越 Docker 构建本身的可迁移监督。

sentences.en: DockSmith is trained on large-scale, execution-grounded Docker-building trajectories produced by a SWE-Factory--style pipeline augmented with a loop-detection controller and a cross-task success memory.
sentences.zh: DockSmith 在 SWE-Factory 风格流水线生产的大规模执行立足 Docker 构建轨迹上训练，该流水线辅以循环检测控制器与跨任务成功记忆。

sentences.en: Training a 30B-A3B model on these trajectories achieves open-source state-of-the-art performance on Multi-Docker-Eval, with 39.72\% Fail-to-Pass and 58.28\% Commit Rate.
sentences.zh: 在这些轨迹上训练一个 30B-A3B 模型，在 Multi-Docker-Eval 上实现开源最先进性能，Fail-to-Pass 为 39.72\%，提交率为 58.28\%。

sentences.en: Moreover, DockSmith improves out-of-distribution performance on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, demonstrating the broader agentic benefits of environment construction.
sentences.zh: 此外，DockSmith 改善 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的分布外性能，展示环境构建的更广泛智能体效益。

sentences.en: Our model and Docker-building trajectories are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/JiaranZhang/DockSmith.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型与 Docker 构建轨迹公开于 https://huggingface.co/JiaranZhang/DockSmith。

title_en: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
title_zh: DocOS：迈向图形界面智能体中主动的文档引导操作

sentences.en: While Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have shown promising performance in automated device interaction, they primarily depend on static parametric knowledge from pre-training or instruction tuning.
sentences.zh: 虽然图形用户界面（GUI）智能体在自动化设备交互中展现出有前景的性能，但它们主要依赖来自预训练或指令调优的静态参数化知识。

sentences.en: This reliance fundamentally limits their ability to handle long-tailed tasks that require explicit procedural knowledge absent from model parameters, often forcing agents to resort to inefficient and brittle trial-and-error exploration.
sentences.zh: 这种依赖从根本上限制了它们处理长尾任务的能力，这些任务需要模型参数中不存在的显式程序性知识，常常迫使智能体诉诸低效且脆弱的试错探索。

sentences.en: To mitigate this limitation, we introduce Proactive Document-Guided Action for GUI agents in dynamic, open-web environments, a novel paradigm that mirrors human problem-solving by enabling agents to autonomously search for relevant documentation to resolve long-tailed tasks.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一局限，我们在动态、开放网络环境中引入面向 GUI 智能体的主动文档引导动作，这是一种通过使智能体自主搜索相关文档来解决长尾任务、从而映照人类问题解决方式的新范式。

sentences.en: To evaluate agents' capability in this paradigm, we propose DocOS, a benchmark designed to assess document-guided problem solving in fully interactive environments.
sentences.zh: 为在此范式中评估智能体的能力，我们提出 DocOS，一个旨在评估完全交互环境中文档引导问题求解的基准。

sentences.en: DocOS requires agents to autonomously navigate a web browser, locate relevant online documentation, comprehend procedural instructions, and faithfully ground them into executable GUI actions.
sentences.zh: DocOS 要求智能体自主导航网络浏览器、定位相关在线文档、理解程序性指令，并忠实地将它们立足为可执行的 GUI 动作。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments reveal that progress is strictly constrained by dual bottlenecks: agents struggle to reliably locate relevant information during proactive search and frequently fail to faithfully ground retrieved instructions into precise actions, pointing toward document-guided interaction as a crucial pathway for enabling self-evolving GUI agents in dynamic environments.
sentences.zh: 大量实验揭示，进展受到双重瓶颈的严格约束：智能体在主动搜索期间难以可靠定位相关信息，并常常无法将检索到的指令忠实地立足为精确动作，这表明文档引导交互是启用动态环境中自演化 GUI 智能体的关键路径。

title_en: DocVAL: Validated Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Grounded Document VQA
title_zh: DocVAL：经验证的思维链蒸馏，实现有据可依的文档视觉问答

sentences.en: Document visual question answering requires models not only to answer questions correctly, but also to precisely localize answers within complex document layouts.
sentences.zh: 文档视觉问答要求模型不仅正确回答问题，还要精确地在复杂文档布局中定位答案。

sentences.en: While large vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong spatial grounding, their inference cost and latency limit real-world deployment; on the other hand, compact VLMs are efficient but suffer substantial localization degradation under standard fine-tuning or distillation.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）实现强空间立足，但它们的推理成本与延迟限制现实部署；另一方面，紧凑 VLM 高效但在标准微调或蒸馏下遭受显著的定位退化。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose **DocVAL**, a validated chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation framework that transfers explicit spatial reasoning from large teacher models to compact, deployable student VLMs.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 **DocVAL**，一个将显式空间推理从大型教师模型迁移到紧凑、可部署学生 VLM 的已验证思维链（CoT）蒸馏框架。

sentences.en: DocVAL combines **(1)** teacher-generated spatial CoT supervision, **(2)** a rule-based dual-mode validator that filters low-quality training signals and provides fine-grained, pixel-level corrective feedback, and **(3)** a validation-driven two-stage training procedure with iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: DocVAL 结合（1）教师生成的空间 CoT 监督，（2）一个基于规则的双模式验证器，它过滤低质量训练信号并提供细粒度、像素级纠正反馈，以及（3）一个带迭代精炼的验证驱动两阶段训练过程。

sentences.en: Text detection is used only as training-time scaffolding for supervision and validation, enabling the final student to operate as a pure VLM without OCR or detection at inference.
sentences.zh: 文本检测仅用作训练时的监督与验证脚手架，使最终学生能够在推理时作为纯 VLM 运行，无需 OCR 或检测。

sentences.en: Across multiple document understanding benchmarks, the proposed **DocVAL** yields consistent improvements of up to **6-7 ANLS** points over comparable compact VLMs.
sentences.zh: 在多个文档理解基准上，所提出的 **DocVAL** 相较可比的紧凑 VLM 带来至多 **6-7 ANLS** 分的一致改进。

sentences.en: We further introduce mean Average Precision (mAP) as a localization metric for document question answering and report strong spatial grounding performance under this new evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入平均精确率（mAP）作为文档问答的定位指标，并在这一新评估下报告强空间立足性能。

sentences.en: We release **95K validator-verified CoT traces** and show that high-quality, validated supervision is more effective than scaling unfiltered data, enabling efficient and trustworthy document grounding.
sentences.zh: 我们发布 **95K 条验证器验证的 CoT 轨迹**，并表明高质量、已验证的监督比扩展未过滤数据更有效，从而支持高效且可信的文档立足。

title_en: Does a Hybrid Space-Aware Randomized Defense Improve Empirical and Certified Adversarial Robustness?
title_zh: 混合空间感知随机防御能否改善经验与可认证对抗鲁棒性？

sentences.en: We introduce Hybrid Space-aware Stochastic Convolution Attention Noise (HySCAN), a hybrid randomized defense that helps close the long-standing gap between provable robustness under ℓ2 certificates and empirical robustness against strong ℓ∞ attacks, while maintaining strong generalization across diverse imaging benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们引入混合空间感知随机卷积注意力噪声（HySCAN），一种混合随机防御，它帮助弥合 ℓ2 证书下的可证明稳健性与对强 ℓ∞ 攻击的经验稳健性之间长期存在的差距，同时在多样成像基准上保持强泛化。

sentences.en: HySCAN jointly explores complementary sources of stochasticity at both training and inference: (i) implicit weight-space randomness via stochastic-aware Random Weights, and (ii) explicit feature-space randomness via Stochastic Attention Noise Injection modules.
sentences.zh: HySCAN 在训练与推理时联合探索互补的随机性来源：（i）通过随机感知随机权重的隐式权空间随机性，以及（ii）通过随机注意力噪声注入模块的显式特征空间随机性。

sentences.en: By incorporating randomness at both the parameter and representation levels, HySCAN enables meaningful certified guarantees while improving empirical robustness in practice.
sentences.zh: 通过将随机性纳入参数与表示两个层面，HySCAN 实现有意义的认证保证，同时在实践中改善经验稳健性。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on diverse imaging datasets, e.g., CelebA, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1k, HAM10000, and NIH Chest X-ray, demonstrate that HySCAN outperforms existing certified and empirical defenses, improving certified robustness by up to ≈ 9.6% and empirical robustness by up to ≈ 5% without reducing clean accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在多样成像数据集（例如 CelebA、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1k、HAM10000 与 NIH 胸部 X 光）上的综合实验表明，HySCAN 超越现有的认证与经验防御，在不降低干净准确率的情况下将认证稳健性提升至多约 9.6%，将经验稳健性提升至多约 5%。

title_en: Does AI Reviewer See the Full Picture? Attacking and Defending Multimodal Peer Review
title_zh: AI 审稿人看到了全貌吗？多模态同行评审的攻击与防御

sentences.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) into scientific peer-review workflows introduces novel and significant risks for adversarial manipulation, especially given the multimodal nature of scientific papers where figures, not just text, convey core evidence.
sentences.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）与多模态 LLM（MLLM）整合进科学同行评审工作流，引入了新颖且重要的对抗性操纵风险，尤其是考虑到科学论文的多模态性质，其中图表（而不仅仅是文本）传达核心证据。

sentences.en: This creates a significant gap: current robustness studies on AI peer-review are overwhelmingly text-only.
sentences.zh: 这制造了一个显著空白：当前对 AI 同行评审的稳健性研究绝大多数是仅文本的。

sentences.en: Moreover, the problem is distinct from standard jailbreaking, as a peer-review attack seeks to induce a domain-specific, targeted failure (e.g., “inflate this score”) rather than a general safety policy violation, for which no practical defenses exist.
sentences.zh: 此外，该问题不同于标准越狱，因为同行评审攻击旨在诱导领域特定、有针对性的失效（例如“抬高这个分数”）而非一般安全策略违规，而对此不存在实用防御。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce PaperGuard, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically evaluate and defend AI-generated peer-review against these domain-specific, cross-modal attacks.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 PaperGuard，首个旨在系统评估并防御针对这些领域特定、跨模态攻击的 AI 生成同行评审的全面基准。

sentences.en: Our framework is built on three pillars: (1) a new multimodal peer-review dataset spanning multiple scientific domains; (2) a unified suite of attacks, including black-box prompt injections and white-box perturbations, specifically designed to target both text (GCG) and figures (PGD); and (3) a practical defense, motivated by the long-context challenge of academic papers, that uses chunk-based embedding search to efficiently localize and mitigate harmful instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架建于三大支柱之上：（1）一个横跨多个科学领域的新多模态同行评审数据集；（2）一个统一攻击套件，包括黑盒提示注入与白盒扰动，专门设计为同时针对文本（GCG）与图表（PGD）；以及（3）一个实用防御，它受学术论文长上下文挑战的启发，使用基于块的嵌入搜索高效定位并缓解有害指令。

sentences.en: Our extensive experiments, conducted across state-of-the-art models, confirm that AI reviewers are pervasively vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我们跨最先进模型进行的大量实验确认，AI 审稿人普遍脆弱。

sentences.en: PaperGuard establishes the foundational benchmark, protocols, and actionable defense necessary to pioneer trustworthy, attack-resilient AI-assisted scholarly reviewing.
sentences.zh: PaperGuard 确立了开创可信、抗攻击 AI 辅助学术评审所必需的基础基准、协议与可操作防御。
