title_en: Does Math Reasoning Improve General LLM Capabilities? Understanding Transferability of LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 数学推理能否提升大语言模型通用能力？理解大语言模型推理的可迁移性

sentences.en: Math reasoning has become the poster child of progress in large language models (LLMs), with new models rapidly surpassing human-level performance on benchmarks like MATH and AIME.
sentences.zh: 数学推理已成为大语言模型（LLM）进展的典范代表，新模型在 MATH 与 AIME 等基准上迅速超越人类水平。

sentences.en: But as math leaderboards improve week by week, it is worth asking: do these gains reflect broader problem-solving ability or just narrow overfitting?
sentences.zh: 但随着数学排行榜逐周提升，值得一问：这些增益是否反映了更广泛的问题求解能力，还是仅仅是狭窄的过拟合？

sentences.en: To answer this question, we evaluate over 20 open-weight reasoning-tuned models across a broad suite of tasks, including math, scientific QA, agent planning, coding, and standard instruction-following.
sentences.zh: 为回答这一问题，我们跨广泛任务套件评估 20 多个开放权重推理调优模型，包括数学、科学 QA、智能体规划、编码与标准指令遵循。

sentences.en: We surprisingly find that most models that succeed in math fail to transfer their gains to other domains.
sentences.zh: 我们惊讶地发现，大多数在数学上成功的模型未能将其增益迁移到其他领域。

sentences.en: To rigorously study this phenomenon, we conduct controlled experiments using math-only data with two widely-used methods: Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Supervised Finetuning (SFT) with detailed ablations.
sentences.zh: 为严格研究这一现象，我们使用仅数学数据与两种广泛使用的方法进行受控实验：强化学习（RL）与带详细消融的监督微调（SFT）。

sentences.en: On top of the observation that RL-tuned models transfer better than SFT-tuned models, we identify on-policy fine-tuning as the key mechanism underlying cross-domain transfer, regardless of whether the training signal comes from RL or supervised learning.
sentences.zh: 除了 RL 调优模型比 SFT 调优模型迁移得更好的观察之外，我们将策略内微调确定为跨领域迁移的关键机制，无论训练信号来自 RL 还是监督学习。

sentences.en: Latent-space representation and token-space distribution shift analyses reveal that off-policy SFT induces substantial representation and output drift, while on-policy RL preserves general-domain structure.
sentences.zh: 潜在空间表示与词元空间分布偏移分析揭示，离策略 SFT 诱导显著的表示与输出漂移，而在策略 RL 保持一般领域结构。

sentences.en: Our results suggest a need to rethink the post-training recipes, particularly the reliance on off-policy SFT-distilled data to advance reasoning models.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明需要重新思考后训练配方，尤其是对离策略 SFT 蒸馏数据的依赖，以推进推理模型的发展。

title_en: Does Reasoning Improve Seeing? Understanding When Vision-Language Models Benefit from Thinking
title_zh: 推理能否改善视觉？理解视觉语言模型何时受益于思考

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) now support both direct Instruct and explicit-reasoning Thinking modes, yet practitioners still lack principled ways to decide when reasoning actually improves performance, or how much computation to spend at test time, so we investigate whether VLMs encode meta-cognitive signals for adaptive inference.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）现在同时支持直接指示（Instruct）与显式推理（Thinking）模式，然而实践者仍然缺乏有原则的方法来决定推理何时真正改善性能，或在测试时花费多少计算量，因此我们研究 VLM 是否编码元认知信号用于自适应推断。

sentences.en: We derive oracle labels for two properties: (1) reasoning helpfulness, namely whether explicit reasoning improves accuracy, and (2) desired generation length, the minimal token budget needed for a correct answer.
sentences.zh: 我们为两个性质推导预言机标签：（1）推理有用性，即显式推理是否改善准确率，以及（2）期望生成长度，即正确答案所需的最小词元预算。

sentences.en: Probing final-layer representations in InternVL and Qwen3-VL models, we find Thinking models encode these signals more linearly than Instruct models, suggesting that reasoning-oriented training enhances meta-cognitive structure.
sentences.zh: 通过探测 InternVL 与 Qwen3-VL 模型的最终层表示，我们发现 Thinking 模型比 Instruct 模型更线性地编码这些信号，表明面向推理的训练增强元认知结构。

sentences.en: Head-wise attribution reveals two circuits: length-control heads in lower layers and reasoning/difficulty heads in higher layers.
sentences.zh: 逐头归因揭示两个回路：较低层中的长度控制头与较高层中的推理/难度头。

sentences.en: Causal interventions confirm these roles across benchmarks: scaling length heads controls output length with minimal accuracy loss, while scaling reasoning heads enables a perception-reasoning trade-off, improving accuracy by up to 5.3\%.
sentences.zh: 因果干预在基准上确认这些作用：缩放长度头以最小准确率损失控制输出长度，而缩放推理头实现感知-推理权衡，将准确率提升至多 5.3\%。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that reasoning-tuned VLMs develop localized, manipulable circuits for meta-cognitive control, enabling test-time steering of computation and reasoning without retraining.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，经过推理调优的 VLM 发展出局部化、可操纵的元认知控制回路，支持无需重训的测试时计算与推理引导。

title_en: Does Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Improve Generalization of LLM Agents?  An Empirical Study
title_zh: 强化微调能否改善大语言模型智能体的泛化？一项实证研究

sentences.en: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) has shown promise for training LLM agents to perform multi-turn decision-making based on environment feedback.
sentences.zh: 强化微调（RFT）在训练 LLM 智能体根据环境反馈执行多轮决策方面展现出前景。

sentences.en: However, most existing evaluations remain largely in-domain—training and testing are conducted in the same environment or even on the same tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有评估在很大程度上仍是域内的——训练与测试在相同环境中甚至相同任务上进行。

sentences.en: In real-worlddeployment, agents may operate in unseen environments with different background knowledge, observation spaces, and action interfaces.
sentences.zh: 在现实部署中，智能体可能在具有不同背景知识、观察空间与动作接口的未见环境中运行。

sentences.en: To characterize the generalization profile of RFT under such shifts, we conduct a systematic study along three axes: (1) within-environment generalization across task difficulty, (2) cross-environment transfer to unseen environments, and (3) sequential multi-environment training to quantify transfer and forgetting.
sentences.zh: 为刻画此类偏移下 RFT 的泛化概况，我们沿三个轴进行系统性研究：（1）跨任务难度的环境内泛化，（2）向未见环境的跨环境迁移，以及（3）顺序多环境训练以量化迁移与遗忘。

sentences.en: Our results show that RFT generalizes well across task difficulty within an environment, but exhibits unstable transfer to unseen environments, which correlates with shifts in both semantic priors and observation/action interfaces.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，RFT 在环境内跨任务难度泛化良好，但对未见环境表现出不稳定的迁移，这与语义先验以及观察/动作接口的偏移相关。

sentences.en: In contrast, sequential training yields promising downstream gains with minimal upstream forgetting, and mixture training across environments improves the overall balance.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，顺序训练产生有前景的下游增益与最小的上游遗忘，而跨环境的混合训练改善整体平衡。

sentences.en: We further provide detailed analyses and deeper insights, and hope our work helps the community develop and deploy generalizable LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供详细分析与更深洞见，并希望我们的工作帮助社区开发并部署可泛化的 LLM 智能体。

title_en: Does Your Reasoning Model Implicitly Know When to Stop Thinking?
title_zh: 你的推理模型是否隐式知道何时停止思考？

sentences.en: Recent advancements in large reasoning models (LRMs) have greatly improved their capabilities on complex reasoning tasks through Long Chains of Thought (CoTs).
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）的近期进展通过长思维链（CoT）大幅改善它们在复杂推理任务上的能力。

sentences.en: However, this approach often results in substantial redundancy, impairing computational efficiency and causing significant delays in real-time applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法常常导致大量冗余，损害计算效率并在实时应用中造成显著延迟。

sentences.en: Recent studies show that longer reasoning chains are frequently uncorrelated with correctness and can even be detrimental to accuracy.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，更长的推理链常常与正确性无关，甚至可能损害准确率。

sentences.en: In a further in-depth analysis of this phenomenon, we surprisingly uncover and empirically verify that LRMs implicitly know the appropriate time to stop thinking, while this capability is obscured by current sampling paradigms.
sentences.zh: 在对这一现象的进一步深入分析中，我们惊讶地发现并经验验证，LRM 隐式知道停止思考的适当时机，而这一能力被当前采样范式所遮蔽。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Aware Guided Efficient Reasoning), a novel sampling paradigm that unleashes this efficient reasoning potential.
sentences.zh: 受此激励，我们引入 SAGE（自感知引导高效推理），一个释放这一高效推理潜力的新颖采样范式。

sentences.en: Furthermore, integrating SAGE as mixed sampling into group-based reinforcement learning (SAGE-RL) enables SAGE-RL to effectively incorporate SAGE-discovered efficient reasoning patterns into standard pass@1 inference, markedly enhancing both the reasoning accuracy and efficiency of LRMs across multiple challenging mathematical benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 此外，将 SAGE 作为混合采样整合进基于分组的强化学习（SAGE-RL），使 SAGE-RL 能够有效将 SAGE 发现的高效推理模式纳入标准 pass@1 推断，在多个具有挑战性的数学基准上显著增强 LRM 的推理准确率与效率。

title_en: Domain Adaptation with Adaptive $f$-Divergence: Tighter Variational Representation and Generalization Bounds
title_zh: 利用自适应 $f$-散度进行域适配：更紧的变分表示与泛化界

sentences.en: We study unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) where measuring cross-domain discrepancy is critical.
sentences.zh: 我们研究无监督领域适配（UDA），其中度量跨领域差异至关重要。

sentences.en: Most UDA approaches fix a single $f$-divergence a priori, which can be suboptimal across heterogeneous shifts.
sentences.zh: 大多数 UDA 方法先验地固定单个 f 散度，这在异构偏移下可能是次优的。

sentences.en: We propose a framework that (i) tightens the variational lower bound of an $f$-divergence by inserting a learnable, monotone $L$-Lipschitz transform $\tau$ (Tighter-VR), and (ii) selects the divergence family adaptively from data via a likelihood-based criterion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个框架，它（i）通过插入一个可学习的、单调的 $L$-Lipschitz 变换 $\tau$ 收紧 $f$-散度的变分下界（Tighter-VR），并且（ii）通过基于似然的准则从数据自适应地选择散度族。

sentences.en: The resulting estimator yields more informative and statistically efficient discrepancy estimates while recovering prior fixed-divergence methods as special cases.
sentences.zh: 所得的估计器产生更有信息量且统计更高效的距离估计，同时将先前的固定散度方法恢复为特例。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we derive a target-risk bound whose three components are a transformed source risk, a Tighter-VR discrepancy between domains, and an ideal-hypothesis residual; we further provide finite-sample guarantees using standard complexity measures.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们推导一个目标风险界，其三个分量为变换源风险、域间 Tighter-VR 距离与理想假设残差；我们进一步使用标准复杂度度量提供有限样本保证。

sentences.en: Empirically, on Office-31, Office-Home, Digits, and VisDA-2017, our method consistently improves accuracy over strong baselines, showing that coupling Tighter-VR with adaptive divergence selection is useful for UDA.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，在 Office-31、Office-Home、Digits 与 VisDA-2017 上，我们的方法一致改善强基线之上的准确率，表明将 Tighter-VR 与自适应散度选择耦合对 UDA 是有用的。

title_en: Domain Adaptive Object Detection via Dynamic Causal Refinement
title_zh: 通过动态因果细化实现域自适应物体检测

sentences.en: Domain Adaptive Object Detection (DAOD) addresses the challenge of transferring object detectors from labeled source domains to unlabeled target domains.
sentences.zh: 领域自适应目标检测（DAOD）应对将目标检测器从标记源领域迁移到未标记目标领域的挑战。

sentences.en: Existing domain adaptation methods primarily rely on feature distribution alignment, which enhances domain-invariant features (statistical invariance) but also inadvertently increases inherent domain-common spurious factors (e.g., common environmental contexts), which act as shortcut features rather than the true causal factors for object classification.
sentences.zh: 现有的领域适配方法主要依赖特征分布对齐，它增强领域不变特征（统计不变性），但也无意中增加固有领域共有虚假因素（例如常见环境上下文），这些因素充当捷径特征而非物体分类的真实因果因素。

sentences.en: We propose Dynamic Causal Refinement (DCR), a novel framework that establishes a closed-loop feedback mechanism between data augmentation and model optimization to progressively refine causal features.
sentences.zh: 我们提出动态因果精炼（DCR），一个在数据增广与模型优化之间建立闭环反馈机制以逐步精炼因果特征的新框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design Semantic Prediction Consistency (SPC) to filter domain-specific spurious factors and establish a robust statistical invariance, and Discrepancy-Guided Causal Refinement (DGCR) to actively suppress the dependence on domain-common spurious factors via spectral perturbation for causal refinement.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计语义预测一致性（SPC）以过滤领域特定虚假因素并建立稳健的统计不变性，以及差异引导因果精炼（DGCR）通过谱扰动主动抑制对领域共有虚假因素的依赖，以实现因果精炼。

sentences.en: This process encourages the detector to suppress its reliance on shortcut features and instead prioritize semantically meaningful causal representations.
sentences.zh: 这一过程鼓励检测器抑制对捷径特征的依赖，转而优先语义有意义的因果表示。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts significantly.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著超越最先进对应方法。

title_en: Domain Restriction via SAE Multi-Layer Transitions
title_zh: 通过稀疏自编码器多层转移实现领域限制

sentences.en: The general-purpose nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) presents a significant challenge for domain-specific applications, often leading to out-of-domain (OOD) interactions that undermine the provider's intent.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的通用性质对领域特定应用提出重大挑战，常常导致违背提供方意图的分布外（OOD）交互。

sentences.en: Existing methods for detecting such scenarios treat the LLM as an uninterpretable black box and overlook the internal processing of inputs.
sentences.zh: 检测此类场景的现有方法将 LLM 视为不可解释的黑盒，并忽视对输入的内部处理。

sentences.en: In this work we show that layer transitions provide a promising avenue for extracting domain-specific signature.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明层转换为提取领域特定特征提供了有前景的途径。

sentences.en: Specifically, we present several lightweight ways of learning on internal dynamics encoded using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) that exhibit great capability in distinguishing OOD texts.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出若干种在编码于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的内部动态上学习的轻量级方法，它们在区分 OOD 文本方面展现出卓越能力。

sentences.en: Building on top of SAEs representation transitions enables us to better interpret the LLM internal evolution of input processing and shed light on its decisions.
sentences.zh: 在 SAE 表示转换的基础上，使我们能够更好地解释 LLM 输入处理的内部演化，并阐明其决策。

sentences.en: We provide a comprehensive analysis of the method and benchmark it with the gemma-2 2B and 9B models.
sentences.zh: 我们对该方法进行综合分析，并用 gemma-2 2B 与 9B 模型进行基准测试。

sentences.en: Our results emphasize the efficacy of the internal process in capturing fine-grained input-related details.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果强调了内部过程在捕获细粒度输入相关细节方面的有效性。

title_en: Domain Transfer Becomes Identifiable via a Single Alignment
title_zh: 通过单次对齐使域迁移可辨识

sentences.en: Domain transfer (DT) maps source to target distributions and supports tasks such as unsupervised image-to-image translation, single-cell analysis, and cross-platform medical imaging.
sentences.zh: 领域迁移（DT）将源分布映射到目标分布，并支持无监督图像到图像翻译、单细胞分析与跨平台医学成像等任务。

sentences.en: However, DT is fundamentally ill-posed: push-forward mappings are generally non-identifiable, as measure-preserving automorphisms (MPAs) preserve marginals while altering cross-domain correspondences, leading to content-misaligned translation.
sentences.zh: 然而，DT 从根本上是不适定的：推动映射一般是不可辨识的，因为保测自同构（MPA）保持边缘分布同时改变跨领域对应关系，导致内容错位的翻译。

sentences.en: Recent work shows that MPAs can be eliminated by jointly transferring multiple corresponding source/target conditional distributions, but supervision signals labeling such conditionals are not always available in practice.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，MPA 可以通过联合迁移多个对应的源/目标条件分布来消除，但标记此类条件的监督信号在实践中并不总是可用。

sentences.en: We develop an alternative route to DT identifiability.
sentences.zh: 我们开发一条实现 DT 可辨识性的替代路径。

sentences.en: Under a structural sparsity condition on the Jacobian support pattern, we show that distribution matching together with a single paired anchor sample suffices to identify the ground-truth transfer---requiring substantially less supervision than prior approaches.
sentences.zh: 在 Jacobian 支撑模式的构造性稀疏条件下，我们表明分布匹配加上单一配对锚点样本足以辨识真值迁移——所需的监督量远少于先前方法。

sentences.en: To enable practical high-dimensional learning, we further propose an efficient Jacobian sparsity regularizer based on randomized masked finite differences, yielding a scalable surrogate without explicit Jacobian evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为支持实用高维学习，我们进一步提出一个基于随机掩码有限差分的高效 Jacobian 稀疏正则化器，产生无需显式 Jacobian 评估的可扩展替代。

sentences.en: Empirical results on synthetic and real-world DT tasks validate the theory.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界 DT 任务上的实证结果验证了该理论。

title_en: Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction for Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型的域偏移感知共形预测

sentences.en: Large language models have achieved impressive performance across diverse tasks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型已在多样任务上实现令人印象深刻的性能。

sentences.en: However, their tendency to produce overconfident and factually incorrect outputs, known as hallucinations, poses risks in real world applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们产生过度自信且事实上错误输出（称为幻觉）的倾向在现实应用中构成风险。

sentences.en: Conformal prediction provides finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees, but standard conformal prediction breaks down under domain shift, often leading to under-coverage and unreliable prediction sets.
sentences.zh: 共形预测提供有限样本、分布自由的覆盖保证，但标准共形预测在领域偏移下失效，常常导致欠覆盖与不可靠的预测集。

sentences.en: We propose a new framework called Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction (DS-CP).
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新框架，称为领域偏移感知共形预测（DS-CP）。

sentences.en: Our framework adapts conformal prediction to large language models under domain shift, by systematically reweighting calibration samples based on their proximity to the test prompt, thereby preserving validity while enhancing adaptivity.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架通过基于校准样本与测试提示的接近度系统地重新加权校准样本，将共形预测适配到大语言模型的领域偏移，从而在增强自适应性的同时保持有效性。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis and experiments on the MMLU benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method delivers more reliable coverage than standard conformal prediction, especially under substantial distribution shifts, while maintaining efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析与在 MMLU 基准上的实验表明，所提出的方法比标准共形预测提供更可靠的覆盖，尤其是在显著分布偏移下同时保持效率。

sentences.en: This provides a practical step toward trustworthy uncertainty quantification for large language models in real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 这为大语言模型在现实部署中的可信不确定性量化迈出实用一步。

title_en: DomED: Redesigning Ensemble Distillation for Domain Generalization
title_zh: DomED：为域泛化重新设计集成蒸馏

sentences.en: Domain generalization aims to improve model performance on unseen, out-of-distribution (OOD) domains, yet existing methods often overlook the crucial aspect of uncertainty quantification in their predictions.
sentences.zh: 领域泛化旨在改善模型在未见、分布外（OOD）领域上的性能，然而现有方法常常忽视其预测中不确定性量化的关键方面。

sentences.en: While ensemble learning combined with knowledge distillation offers a promising avenue, naively combining these techniques is non-trivial and remains largely unexplored in the context of domain generalization.
sentences.zh: 虽然集成学习与知识蒸馏结合提供了有前景的途径，但天真地组合这些技术是非平凡的，并且在领域泛化语境中在很大程度上仍未探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we systematically investigate different ensemble and distillation strategies for domain generalization tasks and design a tailored data allocation scheme.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们系统地研究领域泛化任务的不同集成与蒸馏策略，并设计一个量身定制的数据分配方案。

sentences.en: This approach trains teacher models on distinct subsets of domains and performs distillation on complementary (unseen) subsets, thereby fostering model diversity and training efficiency.
sentences.zh: 这种方法在不同领域的子集上训练教师模型，并在互补（未见）子集上执行蒸馏，从而培养模型多样性并提高训练效率。

sentences.en: Moreover, our theoretical analysis demonstrates that distilling from teachers on unseen domains effectively filters out domain-specific spurious correlations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的理论分析表明，从未见领域的教师进行蒸馏可以有效滤除领域特定的虚假相关。

sentences.en: To address the accuracy degradation often observed with standard uncertainty distillation, we further develop a novel technique that decouples uncertainty distillation from the standard distillation process, enabling accurate uncertainty estimation without compromising model accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为解决标准不确定性蒸馏中常常观察到的准确率退化问题，我们进一步开发一种新颖技术，将不确定性蒸馏与标准蒸馏过程解耦，从而在不妨碍模型准确率的情况下实现准确的不确定性估计。

sentences.en: Our proposed method, *Domain-aware Ensemble Distillation* (DomED), is extensively evaluated against state-of-the-art domain generalization and ensemble distillation techniques across multiple benchmarks, achieving competitive accuracies and substantially improved uncertainty estimates.
sentences.zh: 我们提出的方法 *领域感知集成蒸馏*（DomED）在多个基准上与最先进的领域泛化与集成蒸馏技术进行广泛评估，取得有竞争力的准确率与大幅改善的不确定性估计。

title_en: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference
title_zh: 别丢掉 Dropout：优化层稀疏性以实现高效大语言模型训练与推理

sentences.en: Layer dropout (a.k.a.\ stochastic depth) has been shown to enable faster training, higher accuracy, and robustness to zero-shot layer pruning in both language and vision transformers.
sentences.zh: 层 dropout（又称随机深度）已被证明在语言与视觉 Transformer 中都能实现更快的训练、更高的准确率以及对零样本层剪枝的稳健性。

sentences.en: However, as models and datasets have scaled, dropout---particularly layer dropout---has largely disappeared from LLM pre-training recipes.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着模型与数据集的扩展，dropout——尤其是层 dropout——已基本从 LLM 预训练配方中消失。

sentences.en: While some prior work has reported that dropout can degrade accuracy, no comprehensive study has quantified, let alone mitigated, this effect.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些先前工作报道 dropout 会降低准确率，但没有任何全面研究量化、更不用说缓解这一效应。

sentences.en: In this study, we show that layer dropout **should** be used in state-of-the-art LLM training, establishing best practices and scaling analysis for both training and post-training benefits.
sentences.zh: 在本研究中，我们表明层 dropout **应当**被用于最先进的 LLM 训练，为训练与后训练收益建立最佳实践与扩展分析。

sentences.en: Concretely, with optimal layer distribution, time schedule, and optimizer hyperparameters, LLM can achieve lower or similar validation loss while saving upto 20\% of training FLOPs.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，通过最优的层分布、时间调度与优化器超参数，LLM 可以实现更低或相当的验证损失，同时节省至多 20\% 的训练 FLOPs。

sentences.en: Moreover, layer dropout enables significant post-training optimizations, such as early exit, intermediate-layer skipping, and self-speculative decoding, yielding up to 1.4x inference speedup with negligible accuracy loss.
sentences.zh: 此外，层 dropout 支持显著的后训练优化，例如早退、中间层跳过与自投机解码，实现至多 1.4\times 的推理加速，准确率损失可忽略。

sentences.en: All pre-training experiments were run on Cerebras CS-3 systems.
sentences.zh: 所有预训练实验均在 Cerebras CS-3 系统上运行。

title_en: Don't Force the Fit: Bounded Log-Likelihood Loss for Enhanced Reasoning in Large Language Models
title_zh: 不要强行拟合：利用有界对数似然损失增强大语言模型推理

sentences.en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is central to aligning large language models (LLMs) with instruction following and task-specific reasoning.
sentences.zh: 监督微调（SFT）是对齐大语言模型（LLM）与指令遵循及任务特定推理的核心。

sentences.en: Despite its success, SFT optimizes token-level likelihoods under the implicit assumption that strictly fitting all tokens in expert demonstrations induces the desired downstream behavior.
sentences.zh: 尽管成功，SFT 在一个隐式假设下优化词元级似然，即严格拟合专家演示中的所有词元会诱导期望的下游行为。

sentences.en: However, in reasoning tasks where correctness is defined by logical validity or final outcomes rather than exact token realizations, this assumption can lead to optimization misalignment.
sentences.zh: 然而，在正确性由逻辑有效性或最终结果而非精确词元实现定义的推理任务中，这一假设可能导致优化错位。

sentences.en: We empirically observe that low-probability tokens in reasoning demonstrations often correspond to realization-specific or stylistic variations, and that reducing their influence during training consistently improves generalization on reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在经验上观察到，推理演示中的低概率词元常常对应实现特定或风格变化，并且在训练期间降低它们的影响一致改善推理基准上的泛化。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose the *Bounded Log-Likelihood Loss* (BLL-Loss), a simple and parameter-free alternative to standard likelihood training that bounds gradient contributions from low-probability tokens while preserving conventional optimization behavior.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞见激励，我们提出*有界对数似然损失*（BLL-Loss），一种对标准似然训练的简单且免参数替代方案，它在保持常规优化行为的同时限制低概率词元的梯度贡献。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical insights and extensive empirical results demonstrating that BLL-Loss improves reasoning generalization across diverse model scales and challenging benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们提供理论洞见与广泛实证结果，表明 BLL-Loss 在多样模型规模与挑战性基准上改善推理泛化。

title_en: Don't Forget Why You Started: Tackling Dual Forgetting in Vision-Language Continual Learning
title_zh: 别忘了出发的原因：解决视觉语言持续学习中的双重遗忘

sentences.en: Continual learning of Vision-Language Model (VLM) aims to empower models with new expertise without compromising zero-shot capabilities.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的持续学习旨在为模型赋予新专业知识，同时不损害零样本能力。

sentences.en: However, this pursuit faces a critical “dual-forgetting” challenge: catastrophic forgetting of newly acquired classes (Incremental Knowledge Forgetting, IKF) and erosion of foundational zero-shot capabilities (Pre-trained Knowledge Forgetting, PKF).
sentences.zh: 然而，这一追求面临关键的“双重遗忘”挑战：对新获类别的灾难性遗忘（增量知识遗忘，IKF）与基础零样本能力的侵蚀（预训练知识遗忘，PKF）。

sentences.en: Existing evaluations often ignore PKF or assess it via confounded protocols where positive transfer on semantically similar domains creates an illusion of retention, masking severe foundational degradation.
sentences.zh: 现有评估常常忽视 PKF，或通过混淆协议评估它，其中对语义相似领域的正迁移制造保留的假象，掩盖严重的基础退化。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Dual-Forgetting-Aware Class-Incremental Learning (DFA-CIL) framework and the Similarity-Calibrated Retention (SCR) metric.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出双重遗忘感知类增量学习（DFA-CIL）框架与相似性校准保留（SCR）指标。

sentences.en: Unlike standard averaging, SCR uses the frozen pre-trained feature space to inversely weight performance by semantic similarity, mitigating confounding gains to stress-test foundational stability.
sentences.zh: 与标准平均不同，SCR 使用冻结的预训练特征空间按语义相似性反向加权性能，缓解混淆性增益以压力测试基础稳定性。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose DFA-MoE, a functionally heterogeneous Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出 DFA-MoE，一种功能异构的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法。

sentences.en: DFA-MoE decouples optimization objectives by assigning a momentum-enhanced contrastive expert for feature alignment, and separate plasticity experts combining classification with auxiliary contrastive learning to adapt to new tasks while retaining historical knowledge.
sentences.zh: DFA-MoE 通过为特征对齐分配一个动量增强对比专家，并分配将分类与辅助对比学习相结合、从而在保留历史知识的同时适配新任务的独立可塑性专家，来解耦优化目标。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that our framework reveals the hidden fragility of existing methods and achieves a state-of-the-art balance in preserving both incremental and pre-trained knowledge.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的框架揭示现有方法的隐藏脆弱性，并在保留增量与预训练知识方面实现最先进的平衡。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/RL-MIND/DFA-MoE.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/RL-MIND/DFA-MoE 获取。

title_en: Don't Ignore the Tail: Decoupled Distillation Produces Top Maths Students on an Academic Budget
title_zh: 别忽略尾部：解耦蒸馏以学术预算培养顶尖数学学生模型

sentences.en: The core learning signal used in language model distillation is the standard Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the student and teacher distributions.
sentences.zh: 语言模型蒸馏中使用的核心学习信号是学生与教师分布之间的标准 Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度。

sentences.en: Traditional KL divergence tends to be dominated by the teacher’s highest-probability modes, thereby diminishing the influence of less-probable yet potentially informative components of the output distribution.
sentences.zh: 传统 KL 散度往往被教师的最高概率模式主导，从而削弱输出分布中概率较低但可能蕴含信息的分量的影响。

sentences.en: We propose a new tail-aware divergence that decouples the contribution of the teacher model's top-$K$ predicted probabilities from that of lower-probability predictions, while maintaining the same computational profile as the KL Divergence.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新的尾部感知散度，它将教师模型 top-$K$ 预测概率的贡献与较低概率预测的贡献解耦，同时保持与 KL 散度相同的计算特征。

sentences.en: Our decoupled approach reduces the impact of teacher modes and, consequently, increases the contribution of the distribution's tail.
sentences.zh: 我们的解耦方法降低教师模式的影响，从而增加分布尾部的贡献。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our modified distillation method yields competitive performance in both pre-training and supervised distillation for mathematical reasoning of decoder models across various datasets.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们修改后的蒸馏方法在解码器模型数学推理的预训练与监督蒸馏中，跨各种数据集产生有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the distillation process is efficient and can be performed on modest academic budgets for large datasets, drastically reducing the computational costs typically associated with large-scale distillation.
sentences.zh: 此外，蒸馏过程高效，可以在适度学术预算下对大数据集执行，大幅降低通常与大规模蒸馏相关的计算成本。

title_en: Don't Overthink with Pixels: Efficient Reasoning for Segmentation
title_zh: 别在像素上过度思考：用于分割的高效推理

sentences.en: Existing reasoning segmentation approaches typically fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using image-text pairs and corresponding mask labels.
sentences.zh: 现有的推理分割方法通常使用图像-文本对与相应掩码标签微调多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。

sentences.en: While recent efforts leverage reinforcement fine-tuning to further enhance reasoning ability, they often suffer from overthinking and produce uniformly verbose reasoning chains irrespective of task complexity.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期工作利用强化微调进一步增强推理能力，但它们常常遭受过度思考之苦，并产生统一冗长的推理链而不考虑任务复杂度。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we propose PixelThink, a simple yet effective scheme that integrates externally estimated task difficulty and internally measured model uncertainty to regulate reasoning generation within a reinforcement learning paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 PixelThink，一种简单而有效的方案，它在强化学习范式中整合外部估计的任务难度与内部测量的模型不确定性，以规范推理生成。

sentences.en: The model learns to compress reasoning length in accordance with scene complexity and predictive confidence.
sentences.zh: 模型学会根据场景复杂度与预测置信度压缩推理长度。

sentences.en: To support comprehensive evaluation, we introduce ReasonSeg-Diff, an extended benchmark with annotated reasoning references and difficulty scores, along with a suite of metrics designed to assess segmentation accuracy, reasoning quality, and efficiency jointly.
sentences.zh: 为支持综合评估，我们引入 ReasonSeg-Diff，一个带注释推理参考与难度分数的扩展基准，以及一套旨在联合评估分割准确率、推理质量与效率的指标。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves segmentation performance  but also significantly reduces inference latency by 30.4%, cutting token usage by 48.2%.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法不仅改善分割性能，还显著降低推理延迟 30.4%，将词元使用削减 48.2%。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Don't Reinvent the Wheel, Just Realign the Spokes: Resource-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning via Rank-Wise Expert Assembly
title_zh: 无需重造轮子，只需重对齐辐条：通过逐秩专家组装实现资源高效的联邦微调

sentences.en: Federated fine-tuning presents a promising avenue for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to downstream tasks while preserving data privacy.
sentences.zh: 联邦微调为在保护数据隐私的同时将大语言模型（LLM）适配到下游任务提供了有前景的途径。

sentences.en: However, the prohibitive computational and communication overhead of LLM adaptation inhibits its deployment on resource-constrained edge devices.
sentences.zh: 然而，LLM 适配的过高计算与通信开销阻碍了它在资源受限边缘设备上的部署。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose SmartFed, a resource-efficient framework that circumvents expensive training from scratch by intelligently reusing knowledge embedded in existing LoRA modules.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 SmartFed，一个资源高效框架，它通过智能地复用现有 LoRA 模块中嵌入的知识来规避昂贵的从零训练。

sentences.en: To fully exploit this potential and ensure scalability, we introduce the Mixture of Rank-Wise Experts (MoRE).
sentences.zh: 为充分挖掘这一潜力并确保可扩展性，我们引入按秩专家混合（MoRE）。

sentences.en: MoRE decomposes LoRA modules into fine-grained rank-level experts, which are selectively activated based on input semantics and resource budgets.
sentences.zh: MoRE 将 LoRA 模块分解为细粒度的秩级专家，这些专家基于输入语义与资源预算被选择性激活。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to optimize resource utilization, we propose Elastic Expert Quota Allocation (EEQA), a strategy that adaptively distributes expert capacity across parameter matrices based on their contribution to model performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，为优化资源利用，我们提出弹性专家配额分配（EEQA），一种根据参数矩阵对模型性能的贡献自适应分配专家容量的策略。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SmartFed significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both model performance and training efficiency.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的大量评估表明，SmartFed 在模型性能与训练效率两方面都显著超越最先进方法。

title_en: Don't Walk the Line: Boundary Guidance for Filtered Generation
title_zh: 别沿线走：用于过滤式生成的边界引导

sentences.en: Generative models are increasingly paired with safety classifiers that filter harmful or undesirable outputs.
sentences.zh: 生成模型正日益与过滤有害或不合意输出的安全分类器配对。

sentences.en: A common strategy is to fine-tune the generator to reduce the probability of being filtered, but this can be suboptimal: it often pushes the model toward producing samples near the classifier’s decision boundary, increasing both false positives and false negatives.
sentences.zh: 一种常见策略是微调生成器以降低被过滤的概率，但这可能是次优的：它常常将模型推向产生接近分类器决策边界的样本，同时增加假阳性与假阴性。

sentences.en: We propose Boundary Guidance, a reinforcement learning fine-tuning method that explicitly steers generation away from the classifier’s margin.
sentences.zh: 我们提出边界引导，一种显式引导生成远离分类器间隔的强化学习微调方法。

sentences.en: On a benchmark of jailbreak, ambiguous, and long-context prompts, Boundary Guidance improves the safety while maintaining or improving the utility of outputs, as judged by LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations.
sentences.zh: 在一个越狱、模糊与长上下文提示的基准上，边界引导在由 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估判断下，改善安全性，同时保持或改善输出的效用。

sentences.en: Comprehensive ablations across model scales and reward designs demonstrate the robustness of our approach.
sentences.zh: 跨模型规模与奖励设计的综合消融展示了我们方法的稳健性。

title_en: Doppler Prompting for Stable mmWave-based Human Pose Estimation
title_zh: 多普勒提示：实现稳定的毫米波人体姿态估计

sentences.en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) enables privacy-preserving, illumination-robust human pose estimation (HPE), with each mmWave frame represented as a range--angle--Doppler tensor, providing spatial magnitude for localization and Doppler signatures for motion-related cues.
sentences.zh: 毫米波（mmWave）支持保护隐私、对照明稳健的人体姿态估计（HPE），每个 mmWave 帧被表示为距离-角度-多普勒张量，为定位提供空间幅度，为运动相关线索提供多普勒特征。

sentences.en: However, existing mmWave-based HPE methods either underutilize or naïvely fuse Doppler signatures with spatial magnitude, disregarding their distinct physical semantics.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于 mmWave 的 HPE 方法要么未充分利用、要么天真地融合多普勒特征与空间幅度，忽视它们不同的物理语义。

sentences.en: As a result, non-human Doppler signatures can be misinterpreted as human motion cues, leading to jittery trajectories.
sentences.zh: 因此，非人体多普勒特征可能被误解为人体运动线索，导致抖动的轨迹。

sentences.en: We propose \textbf{PULSE}, which converts Doppler signatures into confidence-aware motion prompts and injects them into spatial magnitude reasoning through constrained interactions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \textbf{PULSE}，它将多普勒特征转换为置信感知的运动提示，并通过受约束的交互将它们注入空间幅度推理。

sentences.en: By screening Doppler prompts before they influence prediction, PULSE first suppresses spurious spectral motion cues and then uses the screened prompts to stabilize prediction.
sentences.zh: 通过在提示影响预测之前筛选多普勒提示，PULSE 首先抑制虚假光谱运动线索，然后使用筛选后的提示稳定预测。

sentences.en: Across three datasets spanning single- and multi-person settings, PULSE consistently improves pose accuracy and temporal stability, indicating that controlled Doppler prompting is a practical direction for stable mmWave HPE.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖单人与多人情境的三个数据集上，PULSE 一致改善姿态准确率与时间稳定性，表明受控多普勒提示是稳定 mmWave HPE 的实用方向。

sentences.en: Codes are available in supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 代码可在补充材料中获取。

title_en: DOT-MoE: Differentiable Optimal Transport for MoEfication
title_zh: DOT-MoE：用于 MoE 化的可微最优输运

sentences.en: The scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven significant performance gains but created substantial challenges in inference efficiency.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的扩展推动了显著性能增益，但也在推理效率上制造了重大挑战。

sentences.en: While Mixture of Experts (MoEs) architectures address this by decoupling model size from inference cost, training MoEs from scratch is often unstable and compute intensive.
sentences.zh: 虽然混合专家（MoE）架构通过将模型规模与推理成本解耦来解决这一问题，但从零训练 MoE 常常不稳定且计算密集。

sentences.en: Conversion of pre-trained dense models into sparse MoEs has emerged as an alternative solution; however, existing methods typically rely on heuristic neuron clustering or random splitting to partition Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) into experts.
sentences.zh: 将预训练稠密模型转换为稀疏 MoE 已作为一种替代方案出现；然而，现有方法通常依赖启发式神经元聚类或随机拆分来将前馈网络（FFN）划分为专家。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose DOT-MoE, a novel framework that formulates the decomposition of dense layers as a Differentiable Optimal Transport (DOT) problem.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 DOT-MoE，一个将稠密层分解表述为可微最优输运（DOT）问题的新框架。

sentences.en: Instead of static heuristics, we model neuron assignment as a balanced transport problem, utilizing differentiable Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations to enforce strict expert capacity constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们不用静态启发式，而是将神经元分配建模为平衡输运问题，利用可微 Sinkhorn-Knopp 迭代强制严格的专家容量约束。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we utilize Straight-Through Estimators (STE) to jointly learn the discrete neuron-to-expert assignment and the token-to-expert routing policy end-to-end.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们利用直通估计器（STE）联合端到端学习离散的神经元到专家分配与词元到专家路由策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple architectures and benchmarks demonstrate that DOT-MoE significantly outperforms structured pruning, heuristic clustering, and random-split baselines, retaining 90% of the original dense model's performance while reducing active parameters by 50%.
sentences.zh: 跨多个架构与基准的大量实验表明，DOT-MoE 显著超越结构化剪枝、启发式聚类与随机拆分基线，在将活跃参数减少 50% 的同时保留原始稠密模型性能的 90%。

title_en: Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model
title_zh: 双重异常值鲁棒的在线无限隐马尔可夫模型

sentences.en: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified.
sentences.zh: 我们在流式数据包含离群值且模型被误设时，推导在线无限隐马尔可夫模型（iHMM）的稳健更新规则。

sentences.en: Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF.
sentences.zh: 借鉴广义贝叶斯推断的近期进展，我们通过后验影响函数（PIF）定义稳健性，并给出在线 iHMM 具有有界 PIF 的条件。

sentences.en: Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching.
sentences.zh: 施加稳健性不可避免地诱导状态切换的适配延迟。

sentences.en: Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法称为批处理稳健 iHMM（BR-iHMM），它用两个额外的可调参数平衡自适应性与稳健性。

sentences.en: Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods.
sentences.zh: 在限价订单数据、小时电力需求与合成高维线性系统上，BR-iHMM 相较竞争的在线贝叶斯方法将单步超前预测误差降低至多 67%。

sentences.en: Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.
sentences.zh: 连同有界 PIF 的理论保证，我们的结果凸显了我们方法在预测与可解释在线学习两方面的实用性。

title_en: Doubly Regularized Markov Decision Processes for Robust Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用于鲁棒强化学习的双重正则化马尔可夫决策过程

sentences.en: Empirical successes show that regularization improves the stability and efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL), with applications in robotics and post-training of large language models.
sentences.zh: 实证成功表明，正则化改善强化学习（RL）的稳定性与效率，在机器人技术与大语言模型后训练中都有应用。

sentences.en: Yet, theoretical analyses of regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs) have mostly been confined to the standard RL setting.
sentences.zh: 然而，正则化马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的理论分析大多局限于标准 RL 情境。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate regularized MDPs through the lens of robust RL.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过稳健 RL 的视角研究正则化 MDP。

sentences.en: We introduce a doubly regularized MDP framework that combines policy and dynamics regularizations, enabling robust policy learning while naturally accommodating continuous action spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个双重正则化 MDP 框架，它结合策略与动力学正则化，支持稳健策略学习，同时自然地容纳连续动作空间。

sentences.en: Within this framework, we develop an optimism-based online algorithm and provide the first finite-sample regret guarantees in both tabular and linear settings.
sentences.zh: 在此框架内，我们开发一个基于乐观主义的在线算法，并在表格与线性情境中提供首个有限样本遗憾保证。

sentences.en: Our results show that algorithms for doubly regularized MDPs are as sample-efficient as well-studied robust MDP algorithms, while additionally benefiting from the flexibility of soft policies.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，双重正则化 MDP 的算法与充分研究的稳健 MDP 算法具有相同的样本效率，同时额外受益于软策略的灵活性。

sentences.en: We further design practical algorithmic variants for both settings and demonstrate empirically that our approach efficiently and effectively handles function approximation and exploration in large state-action spaces, achieving robust performances.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步为两种情境设计实用算法变体，并在大状态-动作空间中经验表明我们的方法高效且有效地处理函数逼近与探索，实现稳健性能。

title_en: Doubly Robust Distributionally Robust Offline Contextual Pricing
title_zh: 双重鲁棒且分布鲁棒的离线上下文定价

sentences.en: Offline contextual pricing often relies on logged observational data, but faces challenges from distributional shifts between training and deployment environments.
sentences.zh: 离线上下文定价常常依赖记录在案的观测数据，但面临训练与部署环境之间分布偏移的挑战。

sentences.en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled approach to off-policy evaluation and learning (OPE/L).
sentences.zh: 分布稳健优化（DRO）为离策略评估与学习（OPE/L）提供有原则的方法。

sentences.en: However, existing methods are mostly limited to discrete actions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法大多限于离散动作。

sentences.en: Recent work has explored DRO for continuous treatments using inverse propensity weighting (IPW), while such IPW-based estimators can be sensitive to the convergence rate of propensity score estimates, particularly when estimated nonparametrically, which may lead to larger estimation errors and regret.
sentences.zh: 近期工作已探索使用逆倾向加权（IPW）对连续治疗进行 DRO，而此类基于 IPW 的估计器可能对倾向得分估计的收敛速率敏感，尤其是当非参数估计时，可能导致更大的估计误差与遗憾。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a doubly robust (DR) framework for distributionally robust OPE/L in continuous pricing settings.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们为连续定价情境中的分布稳健 OPE/L 开发一个双重稳健（DR）框架。

sentences.en: For evaluation, we propose a localized DR estimator that addresses the computational challenges of worst-case expectations by fitting only a small number of regressions, comparable to standard non-robust DR, while achieving semiparametric efficiency under mild product rate conditions.
sentences.zh: 对于评估，我们提出一个局部化 DR 估计器，它通过仅拟合少量回归（与标准非稳健 DR 相当）来应对最坏情况期望的计算挑战，同时在温和乘积率条件下实现半参数效率。

sentences.en: For learning, we leverage the inherent smoothness of demand noise to handle pricing-specific discontinuities in revenue outcomes (e.g., threshold-based purchase decisions), establishing a finite-sample regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}_p(T^{-s/(2s+1)})$ for smoothness orders $s=1,2$.
sentences.zh: 对于学习，我们利用需求噪声的固有平滑性来处理定价特定的收入结果不连续性（例如基于阈值的购买决策），为平滑阶 s=1,2 建立（O~_p(T^(-s/(2s+1)))）的有限样本遗憾界。

sentences.en: This bound improves upon existing regret rates in existing DRO-based off-policy learning (OPL) for continuous treatments.
sentences.zh: 这一界改进了现有基于 DRO 的连续治疗离策略学习（OPL）的遗憾速率。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments under various levels of distribution shift validate our proposed framework.
sentences.zh: 在多种分布偏移水平下的大量实验验证了我们的框架。

title_en: DOUBT: Decoupled Object-level Understanding and Bridging via vMF-based Trustworthiness for Hallucination Detection in MLLMs
title_zh: DOUBT：通过基于 vMF 的可信度解耦物体级理解与衔接，实现多模态大语言模型幻觉检测

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) frequently produce hallucinations (i.e., assertions that contradict the image or facts), undermining reliability in high-risk applications.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）常常产生幻觉（即与图像或事实矛盾的断言），破坏高风险应用的可靠性。

sentences.en: Existing detection approaches typically feed images and texts jointly and estimate hallucination scores by measuring the consistency of model outputs.
sentences.zh: 现有的检测方法通常联合馈送图像与文本，并通过度量模型输出的一致性估计幻觉分数。

sentences.en: However, because the visual module often lags behind the language module in understanding and reasoning, MLLMs can repeatedly produce similar yet incorrect answers, yielding deceptively high measured trustworthiness and therefore missed detections.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于视觉模块在理解与推理上常常滞后于语言模块，MLLM 可能反复产生相似却错误的答案，产生欺骗性的高测量可信度，从而导致漏检。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a simple yet effective model-agnostic method, dubbed Decoupled Object-level Understanding and Bridging via vMF-based Trustworthiness (DOUBT).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出一个简单而有效的模型无关方法，称为基于 vMF 可信度的解耦对象级理解与桥接（DOUBT）。

sentences.en: DOUBT i) elicits richer object-aware responses by decoupling object recognition from relational reasoning via a two-step prompting scheme (Object-level Understanding and Bridging, OUB), and ii) measures reliability with a von Mises–Fisher (vMF)-based trustworthiness metric that is more stable than semantic-entropy metrics under small-sample regimes.
sentences.zh: DOUBT i）通过两步提示方案（对象级理解与桥接，OUB）将对象识别与关系推理解耦来引出更丰富的对象感知响应，并且 ii）用比语义熵指标在小样本区间更稳定的基于 von Mises-Fisher（vMF）的可信度指标度量可靠性。

sentences.en: Specifically, OUB first prompts the model to list recognized objects, and then conditions chain-of-thought reasoning on those objects to produce object-bridged responses.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，OUB 首先提示模型列出识别出的对象，然后使思维链推理以这些对象为条件，产生对象桥接的响应。

sentences.en: For trustworthiness estimation, we replace conventional measures with the proposed vMF-based metric, which is robust even under low-sample settings and exhibits smoother behavior than prior techniques.
sentences.zh: 对于可信度估计，我们用所提出的基于 vMF 的指标取代常规度量，该指标即使在低样本情境下也稳健，并表现出比先前技术更平滑的行为。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DOUBT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering a robust and generalizable solution for hallucination detection in MLLMs.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的大量实验与消融研究表明，DOUBT 一致超越最先进基线，为 MLLM 中的幻觉检测提供稳健且可泛化的解决方案。

title_en: DP-KFC: Data-Free Preconditioning for Privacy-Preserving Deep Learning
title_zh: DP-KFC：用于隐私保护深度学习的无数据预条件

sentences.en: Differentially private optimization suffers from a fundamental geometric mismatch: deep networks have highly anisotropic loss landscapes, yet DP-SGD injects isotropic noise.
sentences.zh: 差分私有优化遭受基本几何不匹配：深网络具有高度各向异性的损失景观，而 DP-SGD 注入各向同性噪声。

sentences.en: Second-order preconditioning can resolve this, but estimating curvature typically requires private data (consuming privacy budget) or public data (introducing distribution shift).
sentences.zh: 二阶预条件可以解决这一问题，但估计曲率通常需要私有数据（消耗隐私预算）或公开数据（引入分布偏移）。

sentences.en: We show that the Fisher Information Matrix decouples into *architectural sensitivity*, recoverable via synthetic noise, and *input correlations*, approximable from modality-specific frequency statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们表明 Fisher 信息矩阵可以解耦为*架构敏感性*（可通过合成噪声恢复）与*输入相关*（可由模态特定频率统计逼近）。

sentences.en: We propose DP-KFC, which constructs KFAC preconditioners by probing networks with structured synthetic noise, requiring neither private nor public data.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DP-KFC，它通过用结构化合成噪声探测网络来构建 KFAC 预条件器，既无需私有数据也无需公开数据。

sentences.en: Empirically, DP-KFC consistently outperforms DP-SGD and adaptive baselines across diverse modalities in strong privacy regimes ($\varepsilon \leq 3$).
sentences.zh: 在经验上，DP-KFC 在强隐私区间（$\varepsilon \leq 3$）内跨多样模态一致超越 DP-SGD 与自适应基线。

sentences.en: DP-KFC matches private-data preconditioners while public-data variants degrade by up to $4.8$ %, showing that curvature can be estimated without consuming privacy budget or introducing distribution shift.
sentences.zh: DP-KFC 匹配私有数据预条件器，而公开数据变体退化至多 4.8%，表明曲率可以在不消耗隐私预算或引入分布偏移的情况下被估计。

sentences.en: This enables privacy-preserving learning in specialized domains (e.g., medical applications) where regulatory constraints make data scarce.
sentences.zh: 这使专业领域（例如医疗应用）中的隐私保护学习成为可能，在那里监管约束使数据稀缺。

title_en: DPO Unchained: Your Training Algorithm is Secretly Disentangled in Human Choice Theory (and Its Loss' Convexity is Dispensable)
title_zh: 解放 DPO：你的训练算法在人类选择理论中其实已解耦，其损失的凸性并非必需

sentences.en: Normative theories allow one to elicit key parts of a ML algorithm from first principles, which is crucial at a time of championed scrutiny for ML work.
sentences.zh: 规范理论允许人们从第一性原理引出机器学习算法的关键部分，这在机器学习工作备受审视的时代至关重要。

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) cleverly bypasses reward modeling by making an explicit link with a specific normative model of human choice.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通过建立与特定规范人类选择模型的显式联系，巧妙地绕过了奖励建模。

sentences.en: Our paper elevates this connection to the full generality of DPO's normative framework.
sentences.zh: 我们的论文将这一联系提升到 DPO 规范框架的完整一般性。

sentences.en: Getting there requires reworking social choice theory's textbook path for a better RLHF/ML fit.
sentences.zh: 要达到这一目标，需要重新改造社会选择理论的教科书路径，以更好地适合 RLHF/ML。

sentences.en: It elevates the connection to a remarkably broad viewpoint on preference optimization, considering the current panorama of DPO follow-ups.
sentences.zh: 它将这一联系提升到偏好优化的一个非常宽广的视角，考虑到当前 DPO 后续工作的全景。

sentences.en: It also unveils unexpected riches for ML, chief among which the support for *non-convex* losses, the fact that *any* compliant ML analytical choice can be embedded with *any* human choice model, and a normative framework's umbrella wide enough to safeguard DPO's *extensions*
sentences.zh: 它还揭示了用于机器学习的意外财富，其中主要的包括对*非凸*损失的支持、*任何*合规的机器学习分析选择可以嵌入*任何*人类选择模型的事实，以及一个足够宽的规范框架伞来保障 DPO 的*扩展*（间隔、长度校正等）。

sentences.en: (margins, length correction, ...). A *toy* experiment ``far away'' from the DPO crowd is given.
sentences.zh: 给出了一个远离 DPO 人群的*玩具*实验。

title_en: DPsurv: Dual-Prototype Evidential Fusion for Uncertainty-Aware and Interpretable Whole Slide Image Survival Prediction
title_zh: DPsurv：通过双原型证据融合实现不确定性感知、可解释的全切片图像生存预测

sentences.en: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are widely used for cancer survival analysis because of their comprehensive histopathological information at both cellular and tissue levels, enabling quantitative, large-scale, and prognostically rich tumor feature analysis.
sentences.zh: 全切片图像（WSI）因其在细胞与组织两个层面的全面组织病理信息而被广泛用于癌症生存分析，支持定量、大规模且预后丰富的肿瘤特征分析。

sentences.en: However, most existing WSI survival analysis methods struggle with limited interpretability and often overlook predictive uncertainty in heterogeneous slide images.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的 WSI 生存分析方法在可解释性方面表现挣扎，并且常常忽视异质切片图像中的预测不确定性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose DPsurv, a dual-prototype whole-slide image evidential fusion network that outputs uncertainty-aware survival intervals, and enables interpretable survival results through patch prototype distribution assignment, component prototype evidence reasoning, and component-wise relative risk aggregation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 DPsurv，一个双原型全切片图像证据融合网络，它输出不确定性感知的生存区间，并通过斑块原型分布分配、组件原型证据推理与组件级相对风险聚合实现可解释的生存结果。

sentences.en: Experiments on five publicly available datasets demonstrate strong discriminative performance and well-calibrated predictions, validating its effectiveness and reliability.
sentences.zh: 在五个公开可用数据集上的实验展现出强判别性能与校准良好的预测，验证了其有效性与可靠性。

sentences.en: The interpretation of survival results provides transparency at the feature, reasoning, and decision levels, thereby enhancing the trustworthiness and interpretability of DPsurv.
sentences.zh: 生存结果的解释在特征、推理与决策层面提供透明度，从而增强 DPsurv 的可信度与可解释性。

authors.name: Pei Liu
authors.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

title_en: DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for Deep Research
title_zh: DR Tulu：利用不断演化的评分准则进行深度研究强化学习

sentences.en: Deep research agents perform multi-step research to produce long-form, well-attributed answers.
sentences.zh: 深度研究智能体执行多步研究，产生长格式、有良好标注的答案。

sentences.en: However, most open deep research agents are trained on easily verifiable short-form QA tasks via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which does not extend to realistic long-form tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数开放的深度研究智能体通过带可验证奖励的强化学习在易于验证的短格式 QA 任务上训练，这不适用于现实的长格式任务。

sentences.en: We address this with Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics (RLER), where rubrics are constructed and maintained to co-evolve with the policy model during training.
sentences.zh: 我们通过带演化评估准则的强化学习（RLER）应对这一问题，其中评估准则在训练期间与策略模型共同演化地被构建与维护。

sentences.en: This allows the rubrics to incorporate newly explored information from search and contrasting model responses, enabling better fact checking and more discriminative on-policy feedback.
sentences.zh: 这使得评估准则能够纳入来自搜索与对比模型响应的新探索信息，实现更好的事实核查与更具判别性的策略内反馈。

sentences.en: Using RLER, we develop Deep Research Tulu (DR Tulu-8B), the first fully open model that is directly trained for open-ended, long-form deep research.
sentences.zh: 使用 RLER，我们开发 Deep Research Tulu（DR Tulu-8B），首个完全开放、直接针对开放式长格式深度研究训练的模型。

sentences.en: Across four long-form deep research benchmarks in science, healthcare, and general domains, DR Tulu-8B substantially outperforms existing open deep research agents (by 15.6% over Tongyi DR on average) and matches or exceeds proprietary deep research agents (by 0.7% over OpenAI DR on average), while being significantly smaller and cheaper per query (1000x cheaper than OpenAI DR per query).
sentences.zh: 在科学、医疗保健与通用领域的四个长格式深度研究基准上，DR Tulu-8B 大幅超越现有的开放深度研究智能体（平均超过 Tongyi DR 15.6%），并匹配或超越专有深度研究智能体（平均超过 OpenAI DR 0.7%），同时体积显著更小且每次查询更便宜（每次查询比 OpenAI DR 便宜 1000 倍）。

authors.name: Molly Park
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Washington

title_en: DR$^2$Seg: Decomposed Two-Stage Rollouts for Efficient Reasoning Segmentation in Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: DR$^2$Seg：通过分解式两阶段轨迹采样实现多模态大语言模型高效推理分割

sentences.en: Reasoning segmentation is an emerging vision-language task that requires reasoning over intricate text queries to precisely segment objects.
sentences.zh: 推理分割是一个新兴的视觉-语言任务，它要求对复杂文本查询进行推理以精确分割对象。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically suffer from overthinking, generating verbose reasoning chains that interfere with object localization in multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常遭受过度思考之苦，生成干扰多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中对象定位的冗长推理链。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose DR$^2$Seg, a self-rewarding framework that improves both reasoning efficiency and segmentation accuracy without requiring extra thinking supervision.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 DR$^2$Seg，一个自我奖励框架，它在无需额外思考监督的情况下同时改善推理效率与分割准确率。

sentences.en: DR$^2$Seg employs a two-stage rollout strategy that decomposes reasoning segmentation into multimodal reasoning and referring segmentation.
sentences.zh: DR$^2$Seg 采用两阶段 rollout 策略，将推理分割分解为多模态推理与指代分割。

sentences.en: In the first stage, the model generates a self-contained description that explicitly specifies the target object.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，模型生成一个自包含的描述，显式指定目标对象。

sentences.en: In the second stage, this description replaces the original complex query to verify its self-containment.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，该描述取代原始复杂查询以验证其自包含性。

sentences.en: Based on this design, two self-rewards are introduced to mitigate overthinking and the associated attention dispersion.
sentences.zh: 基于这一设计，引入两种自我奖励以缓解过度思考与相关的注意力弥散。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments conducted on 3B and 7B variants of Qwen2.5-VL, as well as on both SAM2 and SAM3, demonstrate that DR$^2$Seg consistently improves reasoning efficiency and overall segmentation accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 的 3B 与 7B 变体以及 SAM2 与 SAM3 上进行的大量实验表明，DR$^2$Seg 一致地改善推理效率与整体分割准确率。

sentences.en: The source code can be found at https://github.com/harrylin-hyl/DR2Seg.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/harrylin-hyl/DR2Seg 找到。
